programme.title: Stag Night - S06E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary and Tony set out to celebrate Gary's stag night after Dorothy decides that it's time Gary showed "real committment" by marrying her. Gary suggests to Dorothy that buying a dog together might be an alternative.

programme.title: Wedding - S06E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — The day of Gary and Dorothy's wedding arrives and both of them are having second thoughts. Tony, however, is ""on a promise"" if the wedding goes ahead.

programme.title: Jealousy - S06E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony becomes obsessively jealous when he thinks that Deborah fancies another man. Gary and Dorothy, Tony and Deborah spend a weekend in a caravan out in the country. Gary is trying to give up smoking.

programme.title: Watching TV - S06E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary, Dorothy, Tony and Deborah spend an evening watching television. At least, Tony tries to watch television. The other three seem hell bent on making Tony look like an idiot.

programme.title: Ten - S06E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony tries to talk Deborah into making love in unusual places. He also has to try to make a good impression on Deborah's mother. Dorothy talks Gary into seeing a relationship counsellor.

programme.title: Sofa - S06E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy talks Gary into getting rid of his 25-year-old sofa. Gary reminisces about the events his sofa has 'witnessed'.

programme.title: Intruders - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary wants to leave his girlfriend, Dorothy, but she decides to leave him first. Gary owns a flat and needs a lodger to help pay the mortgage. Unfortunately, he's got Dermot as a lodger and he's no help at all. A young woman named Deborah moves into the flat upstairs and Dermot immediately decides he's in love with her. The feeling isn't mutual though!

programme.title: The Bet - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary and Dermot play chess to decide who will win an evening of pleasure

programme.title: Alarms & Setbacks - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary tries to impress Deborah by installing a burglar alarm while Dermot tries to impress her by offering his body!

programme.title: Animals - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary suggests to Dorothy that they should have an ""open relationship"". Much to his surprise, she agrees. Dermot makes greater efforts to get somewhere with Deborah

programme.title: Sex & Violence - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dermot organises a romantic dinner for Deborah

programme.title: My Brilliant Career - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary thinks that he's been offered a new job so takes his staff out to dinner so that he can tell them that he's leaving! Will he be correct? Meanwhile, Dermot loses his job after he dangles a customer by the ankles.

programme.title: Gary & Tony - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dermot has left the flat and gone abroad so Gary advertises for a new lodger. After interviewing a string of very strange and weird applicants, Gary offers the room to a bloke called Tony. Also, Anthea asks Gary for a pay rise and gets locked in the stationery cupboard.

programme.title: Rent Boy - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony tries to impress Deborah by pretending that he can speak German - His plan backfires, however, when Debs gets a letter from a German customer and asks him to translate it for her! Gary begins to suspect that Tony is gay.

programme.title: How to Dump Your Girlfriend - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Deborah is ill, so Tony decides to look after her. Meanwhile, Tony decides that his girlfriend is getting too serious for his liking so sets about finding a way of dumping her without having to tell her face to face!

programme.title: Troublesome 12 Inch - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy demands an explanation when Tony sells one of her LP records, which is a 'rare' collectors' item worth £200, which is green in colour. Gary has to find a replacement! - The replacement LP is black, so Gary tries to paint it green! When Dorothy is not convinced, he has to pay her £200. Then, Tony tells him that there was a misprint in the catalogue - the green LP was only worth a few pounds!!!

programme.title: Going Nowhere - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary and Deborah are trapped in a lift together. Tony has bought an old van and equips it with an electric blanket - Can you guess why?!

programme.title: People Behaving Irritatingly - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony's brother has come to stay and so does his girlfriend. Gary ends up wanting to kill both of them. Then he finds out that her parents have a holiday villa which might be available for a free holiday. Now he'll have to be nice to them both!

programme.title: Lovers - S03E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary is upset when he discovers that he's had well below the average number of sexual partners for a man of his age, so goes to great lengths to prove to Dorothy that he's VERY experienced. Meanwhile, Deborah has split up with her boyfriend, making Tony thinks he's in with a chance!

programme.title: NCAAF 134 | NO EVENTS
programme.desc: NCAAF 134 | NO EVENTS

programme.title: Bed - S03E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — It's a wild and stormy night. Deborah can't sleep because the broken garden fence is flapping around in the wind, Dorothy can't because because she has an upset stomach. They solve these problems by sending Tony out in the storm to fix the fence and Gary out to find an all-night chemist.

programme.title: Casualties - S03E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Deborah has become very depressed, so she decides to sell her flat and leave the country (as you do!!!). To prevent her from leaving, Gary and Tony do everything they can think of to convince potential buyers that her flat is a terrible place to live!

programme.title: Weekend - S03E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony gets a job as a barman, working for Les. Gary and Dorothy compare fantasies.

programme.title: Cleaning Lady - S03E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy orders Gary to hire a cleaner because she is fed up with the dirty state of the flat. Gary agrees, reluctantly, and becomes obsessed with his new cleaning lady! Tony loses his job at the pub when Les's brother comes to stay, but finds a new job as a male model.

programme.title: Marriage - S03E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony resorts to bugging Deborah's flat in an attempt to find out what she sees in her new estate agent boyfriend. Gary takes Dorothy to the ""Pasta Pig"" for a romantic meal. Carried away by the wine and the atmosphere, he forgets himself and proposes! - Dorothy accepts!! Next morning, Gary has second thoughts but how can he escape marriage?

programme.title: Babies - S04E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Deborah leaves her keys with Tony so that he can let the gas engineer in to service her boiler. Tony can't resist the chance to have a peep in Deborah's underwear drawer, with disastrous consequences! Gary and Dorothy think they might have a baby - Dorothy begins to wonder whether Gary is mature enough to be a father.

programme.title: Infidelity - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Deborah tells Tony that she prefers people who help others, so he tries to become a Samaritan. Meanwhile, Gary suspects Dorothy of ""playing around"" and goes to great lengths to confirm his suspicions.

programme.title: Pornography - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary organises a dinner party which proves to be a total disaster while Tony's new girlfriend tells him that he'll have to get rid of his collection of soft-porn magazines or she'll leave him.

programme.title: Three Girlfriends - S04E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary's dad has come to stay so he has to find a partner to take to a party. Tony has three girlfriends at the same time and he's finding it difficult to keep them apart. He's also making Gary very jealous!

programme.title: Drunk - S04E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary is supposed to be having a romantic meal with Dorothy, but he gets held up in the pub with Tony. Then Les announces a ""Beers of the World"" promotion and Gary and Tony have to help with the tasting. Will he ever get to the romantic meal?

programme.title: In Bed with Dorothy - S04E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy has had an operation to remove her appendix so Gary insists that she stays with him so that he can look after her. He isn't happy when she shows no interest in having sex with him. Tony is discovered wearing spectacles.

programme.title: Playing Away - S04E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony has toothache but can't face a trip to the dentist. He decides on a 'do-it-yourself' extraction and ends up in great pain. Gary and Deborah have gone away on a weekend writing course. Tony calls Dorothy at the hospital and she comes round to help him. They end up in bed together.

programme.title: Hair - S05E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony is away travelling around Europe. Meanwhile, Gary and Dorothy have a very romantic time and Dorothy decides that she'll move in with Gary. She also decides that Tony will have to leave the flat if he moves in! Tony comes home with a beard and is shocked to find a tidy flat with a fridge full of food instead of lager. Gary agonises about ways of breaking the news to Tony that he'll have to leave the flat.

programme.title: The Good Pub Guide - S05E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Deborah has become interested in astrology. Tony thinks he can use this new interest as a way of getting her to sleep with him. Dorothy gives Gary a lesson in bad behaviour. Gary and Tony are horrified when they discover that Les has been sacked as manager of ""The Crown"". They're even more horrified when they learn that the new landlord plans to completely refurbish the pub. They set about finding a new 'local'. They also fill their flat with some strange mementoes of the 'old Crown'.

programme.title: Cowardice - S05E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary makes himself look like a coward in a 'road rage' incident so he hatches a plan to make himself look macho. He hires someone to pretend to pick a fight with him in the pub but ends up fighting the wrong man. Deborah has a female friend staying with her. Gary and Tony are convinced that she's going through a ""lesbian phase""!

programme.title: Your Mate v Your Bird - S05E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary has to decide between keeping Tony as a flatmate and living with Dorothy. He finally decides to ask Tony to leave. Tony moves to a room in ""The Crown"". Then Dorothy announces that she's decided to move in with Deborah! Tony tries to prove his love for Deborah with a do-it-yourself tattoo.

programme.title: Cardigan - S05E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary is upset when he's mistaken for George at the office. He decides to prove that he isn't becoming "middle aged" by taking Dorothy, Tony and Deborah to an all-night rave. The evening is a complete disaster!

programme.title: Rich and Fat - S05E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Everyone keeps telling Tony that he's getting fat, so he tries to lose weight. Tony discovers that Gary has £33,000 in his savings account and soon everyone knows about it. Dorothy 'persuades' Gary to make a donation to the hospital appeal fund but everyone is after Gary for a handout. He solves the problem by pretending that he's blown all of his money on expensive watches and Harrods lager.

programme.title: Home-Made Sauna - S05E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy and Deborah have gone away on a sailing weekend. Tony is building a sauna in the garden shed - a ""shedna"" as he calls it. Gary and Tony meet Paula and Carol, who are staying at the house next door for the weekend. They invite the girls round for a barbecue. Tony makes a play for Paula, but discovers that she's a happily married mother. Gary is seduced by Carol. When Deborah and Dorothy come home, Tony talks Debs into trying out the ""shedna"" with him, but it blows up before they can use it! Gary obviously keeps quiet about his weekend activities with Carol.

programme.title: Stag Night - S06E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary and Tony set out to celebrate Gary's stag night after Dorothy decides that it's time Gary showed "real committment" by marrying her. Gary suggests to Dorothy that buying a dog together might be an alternative.

programme.title: Wedding - S06E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — The day of Gary and Dorothy's wedding arrives and both of them are having second thoughts. Tony, however, is ""on a promise"" if the wedding goes ahead.

programme.title: Jealousy - S06E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony becomes obsessively jealous when he thinks that Deborah fancies another man. Gary and Dorothy, Tony and Deborah spend a weekend in a caravan out in the country. Gary is trying to give up smoking.

programme.title: Watching TV - S06E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary, Dorothy, Tony and Deborah spend an evening watching television. At least, Tony tries to watch television. The other three seem hell bent on making Tony look like an idiot.

programme.title: Ten - S06E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony tries to talk Deborah into making love in unusual places. He also has to try to make a good impression on Deborah's mother. Dorothy talks Gary into seeing a relationship counsellor.

programme.title: Sofa - S06E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy talks Gary into getting rid of his 25-year-old sofa. Gary reminisces about the events his sofa has 'witnessed'.

programme.title: Intruders - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary wants to leave his girlfriend, Dorothy, but she decides to leave him first. Gary owns a flat and needs a lodger to help pay the mortgage. Unfortunately, he's got Dermot as a lodger and he's no help at all. A young woman named Deborah moves into the flat upstairs and Dermot immediately decides he's in love with her. The feeling isn't mutual though!

programme.title: The Bet - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary and Dermot play chess to decide who will win an evening of pleasure

programme.title: Alarms & Setbacks - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary tries to impress Deborah by installing a burglar alarm while Dermot tries to impress her by offering his body!

programme.title: Animals - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary suggests to Dorothy that they should have an ""open relationship"". Much to his surprise, she agrees. Dermot makes greater efforts to get somewhere with Deborah

programme.title: Sex & Violence - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dermot organises a romantic dinner for Deborah

programme.title: My Brilliant Career - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary thinks that he's been offered a new job so takes his staff out to dinner so that he can tell them that he's leaving! Will he be correct? Meanwhile, Dermot loses his job after he dangles a customer by the ankles.

programme.title: Gary & Tony - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dermot has left the flat and gone abroad so Gary advertises for a new lodger. After interviewing a string of very strange and weird applicants, Gary offers the room to a bloke called Tony. Also, Anthea asks Gary for a pay rise and gets locked in the stationery cupboard.

programme.title: Rent Boy - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony tries to impress Deborah by pretending that he can speak German - His plan backfires, however, when Debs gets a letter from a German customer and asks him to translate it for her! Gary begins to suspect that Tony is gay.

programme.title: How to Dump Your Girlfriend - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Deborah is ill, so Tony decides to look after her. Meanwhile, Tony decides that his girlfriend is getting too serious for his liking so sets about finding a way of dumping her without having to tell her face to face!

programme.title: Troublesome 12 Inch - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Dorothy demands an explanation when Tony sells one of her LP records, which is a 'rare' collectors' item worth £200, which is green in colour. Gary has to find a replacement! - The replacement LP is black, so Gary tries to paint it green! When Dorothy is not convinced, he has to pay her £200. Then, Tony tells him that there was a misprint in the catalogue - the green LP was only worth a few pounds!!!

programme.title: Going Nowhere - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary and Deborah are trapped in a lift together. Tony has bought an old van and equips it with an electric blanket - Can you guess why?!

programme.title: People Behaving Irritatingly - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Tony's brother has come to stay and so does his girlfriend. Gary ends up wanting to kill both of them. Then he finds out that her parents have a holiday villa which might be available for a free holiday. Now he'll have to be nice to them both!

programme.title: Lovers - S03E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1992 · TV-PG — Gary is upset when he discovers that he's had well below the average number of sexual partners for a man of his age, so goes to great lengths to prove to Dorothy that he's VERY experienced. Meanwhile, Deborah has split up with her boyfriend, making Tony thinks he's in with a chance!

programme.title: Going Downklok - S04E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The guys spend time on a sub without women, and the conditions quickly deteriorate, prompting Pickles and Nathan to compete for the affections of their producer.

programme.title: Dethdinner - S04E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Breakup Klok - S04E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Skwisgaar look for a brand new sound that does not suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Selatcia takes Dethklok’s weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Church of the Black Klok - S04E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that has been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: The Curse of Dethklok - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok hires the world's only six-star chef to cook dinner for them before a show in Norway. They warn him of the Dethklok curse, where every employee they've hired, chefs included, has tragically died. Later, when their new chef is at near-death on life support following an unfortunate helicoptor mishap, the band is forced to make its own meals.

programme.title: Dethwater - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok frontman Nathan Explosion wants the band's next album to be the ultimate smash hit. So, to achieve this goal, he decides to have a recording session locked in a Russian nuclear submarine that is moving through the Mariana Trench - the deepest, darkest location in the Earth's crust itself. How brutal is that?!

programme.title: Happy Dethday (a.k.a. Birthdayface) - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — It's Murderface's birthday, and the rest of the band soon are faced with the difficult task of getting him a present. In fact, he actually ends up hating his party until they finally give him their gift.

programme.title: Dethtroll - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The band plays an ancient song which hasn't been heard in thousands of years which unexpectedly awakens a deadly Nordic lake troll and must compose the world's first death metal lullaby to return the beast to its slumber.

programme.title: Dethkomedy - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok decides to try their hand at standup comedy in order to avoid burning out on metal. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of the band learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate.

programme.title: Dethfam - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. They are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of the 'Parents of Dethklok' album, but soon realize the depth of their parents' anger. The guys learn an important lesson: there's nothing more brutal in this world than raising children.

programme.title: Performance Klok - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok has a huge fight on stage, which prompts the record label to hire a performance coach to keep the band together. The band falls in love with therapy for all the wrong reasons.

programme.title: Snakes n' Barrels - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Pickles decides to go on a reunion tour with his old band, Snakes 'n' Barrels. The government plots to use a new super-drug to erase Pickles' mind and 'reprogram' him, thereby destroying Dethklok from within.

programme.title: Mordland - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Mordhouse, the home of Dethklok, opens its gates to the public for the first time in celebration of International Dethfan Day. Will the band and their fans make it through the experience? Dethklok find themselves in potential trouble after two Internet geeks threaten to release the band's exclusive, one-time-only, fan song over the internet unless they give in to their demands.

programme.title: Fat Kid at the Detharmonic (a.k.a. FatKlok) - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Upon learning that they've once again earned too much money over the past year, the band tries to "donate" as much as they can to charity as a tax write-off. The guys also unwisely attempt fatherhood and play a landmark concert with the London Philharmonic Orchestra which ends with a killer laser light show.

programme.title: Skwisklok - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Skwisgaar hosts the "Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class" pay-per-view event to promote sales of his new guitar line, which includes models such as the Skwisarmyatar and the Antfarmatar. The rest of the guys get inspired to also try their hand at endorsement deals. Metal legend King Diamond guest stars as Ronald Von Monoldburg.

programme.title: Murdering Outside the Box - S01E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who has been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation start off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Go Forth and Die - S01E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Continually plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion decides to attempt to earn his GED.

programme.title: Bluesklok - S01E14
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — After a concert that Dethklok didn't perform, but just stood on the stage, they travel to Mississippi to learn about the blues.

programme.title: Religionklok - S01E15
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true calling.

programme.title: Dethkids - S01E16
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Dethclown - S01E17
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dr. Rockso and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Girlfriendklok - S01E18
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's new controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the entire band.

programme.title: Dethstars - S01E19
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The band is given a movie development deal.

programme.title: The Metalocalypse Has Begun - S01E20
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok receives death threats from fans right before the first live performance of Dethwater. Krosier and Ravenwood attempt to take Dethklok out, with the help of an old enemies brother... With the secret army on the horizon waiting for the right moment to strike, will Dethklok make it through this?

programme.title: Dethecution - S02E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok has withdrawn from the public eye, and fan suicide rates are climbing. The US government hatches a plan to bring the band out of hiding and restore world order.

programme.title: Dethlessons - S02E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Dethvengeance - S02E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The wounded, the scarred, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Dethdoubles - S02E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — After a massive shootout at a Duncan Hills Coffeeshop opening, Dethklok invest in the ultimate protection - another Dethklok. But are these dopplegangers really all that they seem?

programme.title: Dethfashion - S02E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok enters the fashion industry to promote their new clothing line, and in the the process experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Cleanzo - S02E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dr. Roxo (The Rock 'n Roll Clown, He does Cocaine) is on the lamb and Toki decides to hide him at Mordhouse. The band decides to stage an intervention for Roxo.

programme.title: Dethwedding - S02E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Pickles's brother is getting married and Dethklok are asked to appear at the wedding.

programme.title: PR Pickles - S02E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Pickles gets a new PR lady who inflates his fame, prompting jealousy from his bandmates.

programme.title: Dethcarraldo - S02E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The band travels to the Amazon and learns about the native brutality of Nathan's ancestors.

programme.title: Dethgov - S02E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Nathan serves a term as the temporary governor of Florida.

programme.title: Dethrace - S02E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — When William Murderface creates an auto event, Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive while Swisgaar and Toki try to get their licenses.

programme.title: Revengencers - S02E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok visits scarred and disfigured victims of recent bomb attacks.

programme.title: Klokblocked - S02E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — When Nathan learns his ex-girlfriend has found a new love, he decides to return to dating.

programme.title: Dethsources - S02E14
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The band is fed up with Ofdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Dethdad - S02E15
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Snakes n' Barrels II (1) / Snakes n' Barrels II (2) - S02E16
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — When Pickles discovers through an episode of Where are They Now Now? that Snakes 'N' Barrels has reunited without him for the "SOBERTOWN USA No Drugs Allowed Sober Rock and Roll Show", he and the rest of Dethklok travel to Los Angeles to put an end to the atrocity. Part one. / When Pickles discovers through an episode of Where are They Now Now? that Snakes 'N' Barrels has reunited without him for the "SOBERTOWN USA No Drugs Allowed Sober Rock and Roll Show", he and the rest of Dethklok travel to Los Angeles to put an end to the atrocity. Part two.

programme.title: Dethrecord - S02E18
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It’s up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Dethrelease (1) / Dethrelease (2) - S02E19
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok’s new album is released to the world. The Revengencers make their next move. Mordhouse is directly attacked by the Revengencers, during a concert after party. Part one. / Dethklok’s new album is released to the world. The Revengencers make their next move. Mordhouse is directly attacked by the Revengencers, during a concert after party. Part two.

programme.title: Renovationklok - S03E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Believing Ofdensen is dead, Dethklok is forced to become their own managers while dealing with repairs to the destroyed Mordhaus and trying to plan their biggest concert to date. Their efforts are stalled however when a past acquaintance cuts off their unlimited financial freedom to get revenge against the band.

programme.title: Tributeklok - S03E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok join a tribute band to reignite their passion for Rock'n'Roll.

programme.title: Dethhealth - S03E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The members of Dethklok use a variety of potentially dangerous home remedies in a desperate attempt to avoid a visit to the doctor's office.

programme.title: Dethmas - S03E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their mothers. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular rock and roll clown makes a holiday appearance.

programme.title: Fatherklok - S03E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — After multiple pregnancy lawsuits Skwisgaar begins to slip into a deep depression leaving him with the choice to search for his biological father. Meanwhile Murderface puts it upon himself to become Skwisgaar's father which slowly draws jealousy from both Pickles and Toki.

programme.title: Fertilityklok - S03E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Toki decides he wants to find his soulmate and goes to a match making service. Meanwhile, Murderface bets Skwisgaar that he can have more sex than him.

programme.title: Dethsiduals - S03E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — After a ridiculously pointless (and failed) lawsuit against their own band-mates and a devastating embarrassment in France, Murderface and Toki are suspended from the band. They later decide make a record label called "MurderTooth Records".

programme.title: Rehabklok - S03E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — While Pickles is back in rehab, the band replaces him with an automated beat keeping machine.

programme.title: Dethzazz - S03E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Toki tries to turn the life of his rock n' roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund into the ultimate Zazz Blammymatazz reunion. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clowns darkest secret, the secret that tore his career apart, the secret love of a girl he couldn't have. Rockzo disappears from the public, when we learn Toki CAN'T live without the clown, he recedes into a dark catatonia and Dethklok realizes that in order to save their band mate, they must save the clown.

programme.title: Doublebookedklok - S03E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok band manager Charles Offdensen's absence causes problems for the band when they accidentally double book a show in the Middle East.

programme.title: Fanklok - S04E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Nathan begins dating a hardcore Dethklok fan, against the advice of his bandmates. The rest of Dethklok takes up smoking.

programme.title: Diversityklok - S04E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Accusations of racism are leveled at the band, so they open an urban youth center to improve their image. Elsewhere, Toki starts a club but excludes Murderface.

programme.title: Prankklok - S04E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The guys pull pranks and go on vacation to celebrate the release of their album, but Nathan senses that something is not right with their latest release. Meanwhile, Skwisgaar and Toki plot revenge on Murderface for his pranks.

programme.title: Motherklok - S04E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Dethklok opens a Dethfair in Tomahawk, Wisconsin; Pickles goes into realty.

programme.title: Bookklok - S04E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Toki writes a tell-all book about Skwisgaar and becomes lead guitarist for the band, but the pressure may be more than he can handle. Elsewhere, Nathan buys a defibrillator as a toy.

programme.title: Writersklok - S04E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The band’s new female producer sends them on a vacation to help write songs for the new album. The getaway proves anything but relaxing, however, when they end up in a brutal country and are sold into sex slavery.

programme.title: Dethcamp - S04E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Toki goes to rock-and-roll camp and is bullied by other campers. But he soon finds an ally in a former Dethklok guitarist. Meanwhile, Skwisgaar and Murderface binge on candy and horror movies while Toki is away.

programme.title: Dethvanity - S04E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Murderface goes to Mexico for plastic surgery after he receives a dubious award. The rest of the guys, meanwhile, deal with the effects of aging and years of hard living.

programme.title: The End - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — Cormac McCarthy’s latest novel is unfinished and for some reason he turns to Mike Tyson to help him find the ending. But just as Mike settles in to tackle some of that dense, unflinching McCarthy prose, a Chupacabra attacks! Mike puts down the book and puts up his fists. Buenas noches, Senor Chupacabra.

programme.title: Ultimate Judgment Day - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — Someone at a well known computer company needs Mike Tyson’s help, but whom? And when the team arrives at the company headquarters, a highly publicized chess match between one of their supercomputers and Garry Kasparov complicates matters. So does Mike Tyson’s savage beating of Garry Kasparov.

programme.title: Heavyweight Champion of the Moon - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — Mike is a terrible driver and although they’ve all been accidents, he’s killed a lot of people. But when he discovers almost all of them were astronauts, Mike decides there’s only one logical explanation: He must be part of a secret government plot to kill astronauts, because of something they saw on the moon, something the government doesn’t want us to know! Literally before giving this theory a second thought, Mike steals a rocket and blasts off for the moon. In the end Mike learns from his auto insurer that he hasn’t been killing astronauts after all. It was a clerical error and most of the deaths were astronomers. And there can’t be a secret government plot to kill astronomers, right?

programme.title: Is Magic Real? - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — When an old wizard seems to have lost faith in the existence of magic, Mike thinks he can prove him wrong, if he can just find a leprechaun he met years ago, one night at a bar. Along the way, Mike manages to beat up illusionist Criss Angel AND actor Robert Redford, in separate incidents. And, in the end, Mike learns you don’t need to find a leprechaun, because there’s a leprechaun inside of us all.

programme.title: Mite Tyson - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — When Mike learns that the itchy bites all over his body are likely from "bird mites," he reluctantly tells Pigeon he has to move out. Pigeon doesn't take it well.

programme.title: Kidnapped! - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — When Pigeon can’t pay off a gambling debt, Gregor the gangster takes Mike’s daughter Yung Hee as collateral. Can Pigeon and Marquess get her back before Mike finds out she is missing? And why is Mike in Ohio giving a commencement speech?!

programme.title: House Haunters - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2014 · TV-14 — Mike and the gang are plunged into the terrifying world of real estate, when Gary and Caitlin, a couple relocating to Phoenix, asks for help in choosing a house.

programme.title: Night Moves - S01E09

Literally before giving this theory a second thought, Mike steals a rocket and blasts off for the moon. In the end Mike learns from his auto insurer that he hasn’t been killing astronauts after all.
