programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Up to his old tricks of scaring someone, MisterJaw picks upon a fisherman's decoy duck.

programme.title: Aloha, Hah Hah! - S01E16
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — MisterJaw goes on a Hawaiian excursion.

programme.title: Stand-in Room Only - S01E17
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — There's an ad in Variety from a studio that needs a stand-in for a shark in a new movie. MisterJaw applies for the job. He is not believable as a shark. However, he gets violent and gets the job. He finds that the stand-in does dangerous stunts. When MisterJaw rescues a tied-up girl from dynamite, the dynamite explodes. Next, he is supposed to scare a little old lady. Instead, she pounds him. He greets natives after swimming to an island, but they try to cook him. Determined, he holds out until the script calls for him to dive from a 500-foot tower into a bucket of water. The shark decides to retire from movie work.

programme.title: Never Shake Hands with a Piranha - S01E18
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw and Catfish encounter a Piranha

programme.title: Transistorized Shark - S01E19
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — MisterJaw is showing off and scares a fisherman, accidentally swallowing the fisherman's transistor radio. Now with a stomachache, he tries to find a radio repairman. Everywhere that MisterJaw goes, the radio plays a commercial. First, he offends a lady eating ice cream. Then, he "says" just the right thing during a bank holdup. He goes to Pogo Pogo Island to allow the batteries to run down. Tourists win a contest and flood the island.

programme.title: The Fishy Time Machine - S01E20
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw does a little time-traveling.

programme.title: The $6.95 Bionic Shark - S01E21
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Two Russians throw a mechanical shark overboard into the sea. Meanwhile, Misterjaw has found a new home: a resident's expensive swimming pool. When the owner comes to swim with his rubber horse, Misterjaw leaps out of the water and scares the owner and the rubber horse half to death. All seems calm until the owner rents the female, mechanical robot fish to clear up the matter. A swordfish attacks the robot and bends his sword. When the robot attacks a sea dragon, he finds himself outclassed. Now, Misterjaw attempts to "train" the shark to catch and eat tuna with humorous and disastrous results.

programme.title: Moulin Rogues - S01E22
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — While chasing Harry Halibut, Misterjaw ends up in France.

programme.title: Holiday in Venice - S01E23
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw and Catfish are enjoying a vacation in Venice until they run into two cats with their hunger pangs set on Catfish.

programme.title: Shark and the Beanstalk - S01E24
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw and Catfish have an encounter with the mythical giant.

programme.title: The Aquanuts - S01E25
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — MisterJaw and Catfish are captured by the Dix Sealand aquarium for public display!

programme.title: Cannery Caper - S01E26
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw and Catfish are trying to stop a local fishing company from catching all "their" fish, so they take over the cannery. Misterjaw tries his hand as the enterprise's president, with surprising (and amusing) results as he gets greedy. Eventually, the police show up and Misterjaw and Catfish are forced to run for it. Misterjaw runs into the cannery room and winds up as canned fish. Of course, Catfish saves him.

programme.title: Fish Anonymous - S01E27
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw tries to go on a diet, and orders food from a man on television. Catfish gets to the box before he does and eats it all. Misterjaw almost eats Catfish because of the diet, and gets fatter because catfish gave him food.

programme.title: Maguiness Book of Records - S01E28
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw tries to break a bunch of Jack Sharky's records in the Maguiness Book of records.

programme.title: Mama - S01E29
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — A large egg being transfered to the Brooklyn Musem is snagged by MisterJaw, and when it hatches, he becomes Mama to the baby Sea Monster.

programme.title: Deep Sea Rodeo - S01E30
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw is introduced to the fastest Seahorse in the west, Seaweed, so he gets a rodeo lesson from Catfish on how to capture him.

programme.title: Cool Shark - S01E31
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — A little purple octopuss keeps playing pranks on MisterJaw and Catfish, so they chase him all the way up to the Northpole, where ice plays havoc with them.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go - S01E32
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw tries to become part of posh Beverly Hills society by passing himself off as an adoptable pet.

programme.title: No Man's Halibut - S01E33
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw fights with an island castaway over who gets to eat Harry Halibut! Harry is not amused.

programme.title: Sweat Hog Shark - S01E34
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — A biker is resting on an island. MisterJaw shocks him into leaving his bike. MisterJaw and Catfish fall into a gang of bikers, and they find riding to be the greatest challenge of all. MisterJaw jumps the Grand Canyon with the bike, and all the bikers praise him. He doesn't understand bikers' lingo, and he takes their praise as insults. This cartoon features lots of humorous motorcycle slang, and even a reference to Evil Knievel and his Grand Canyon jump.

programme.title: Flying Fool - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw is having trouble catching fish for dinner. When he sees a pelican fly over and dive down, scooping up his dinner, he thinks that flying is the way to catch a meal, so he tries taking to the air, too! He decides to build himself a set of wings so that he can do this. He also finds that flying is more difficult than he thought! A clever ending adds the perfect touch.

programme.title: To Catch a Halibut - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — MisterJaw dives on some fish for dinner, but he ends up swallowing a big rock. He tries to catch two pelicans, but they escape. His pal Catfish suggests that he go after a halibut. After all, they are easy targets... but not for MisterJaw, who gets a hankering to eat Harry Halibut. With Catfish's help, MisterJaw comes up with some very imaginative ways to capture his prey!

programme.title: Shopping Spree - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Pally finds a deal in the newspaper where they can get a deal on fish without hunting for their meals. MisterJaw and Catfish raid a nearby fish market and end up on the lam from the law.

programme.title: Showbiz Shark - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — The boys see a sign on shore: talent is needed for an amusement park water show. Misterjaw feels that he has it, and he applies for the job. He plays the piano for the agent. Misterjaw plays jazz, but the agent doesn't like jazz. Another shark plays classical, which the agent likes better. The other shark dives from a 20-foot pole into a barrel of water. Misterjaw dives from 500 feet into a glass of water. The other shark gets the job. No more show biz for Misterjaw.

programme.title: Monster of the Deep - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw finds himself in a haunted sunken ship and being terrorized by its ghostly occupant.

programme.title: Beach Resort - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw and Catfish terrify a local beach, scaring all the tourists off. Now they have everything to themselves and take up tennis. The clerk at the Freebairn Hotel calls Fearless Freddy: Shark Hunter! Freddy is no match for Misterjaw until he blows up a decoy. When the decoy explodes, Misterjaw asks Catfish, "Why didn't you tell me she was that kind of woman?"

programme.title: Aladdin's Lump - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Two fishermen find Aladdin's Lamp. Misterjaw comes along and scares the fishermen away, keeping the lamp. He proceeds to get exactly what he wishes for. He then scares the lamp's genie away.

programme.title: Little Red Riding Halibut - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw tries to get Harry Halibut by pretending to be Granny Halibut. Appearances by the "real" Little Red Riding Hood, and The Wolf, add a whimsical touch.

programme.title: The Codfather - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — MisterJaw and Catfish find a treasure map. The map leads them to a sunken boat full of cans of tuna fish, but a huge fish, the Codfather, is guarding it. The fish claims all the treasures in the area... as long as it's in the Atlantic or Pacific Ocean! MisterJaw and Catfish keep trying to get rid of the Codfather so that they can eat the tuna.

programme.title: The Shape of Things - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw enrolls in a gym to lose some weight. Trouble begins when some neighborhood cats (complete with British accents) set their eyes on having Catfish for lunch!

programme.title: Flying Saucer - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Two goofy aliens land on Earth and bump into Misterjaw and Catfish. The extraterrestrials believe these two nutty sea creatures are earthlings!

programme.title: Davey Jone's Locker - S01E12
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — MisterJaw is after the little yellow fish again, but is captured by a Swordfish poolshark, so they play a game of pool for the little fish.

programme.title: Caught in the Act - S01E13
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw has his eye on a little fish that is to be his supper. The little fellow runs to Madame Neptune, and she lets him stay in her fish bowl. Misterjaw dons a variety of disguises to snatch his halibut prey from Madame Neptune. He pretends to be a phone repairman to sneak the fish out. Granny gives him the broom. Next, a policeman. Again, the broom... A final surprise provides the perfect finish.

programme.title: Merry Sharkman, Merry Sharkman - S01E14
programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — Misterjaw and Catfish have another episode with Fearless Freddy. Freddy tries so many things to catch Misterjaw, but Misterjaw always out-smarts him.

programme.desc: Animation · 1976 — A large egg being transfered to the Brooklyn Musem is snagged by MisterJaw, and when it hatches, he becomes Mama to the baby Sea Monster.

programme.title: She Works Hard for the Money - S01E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia gets a bonus after winning a big case and wants to buy a nice car, but having been raised on the “fifty-cent principal,” Denise wants her to buy two cars in lesser condition so she can have one. Meanwhile, Paul tries to teach Rainbow, Johan and Santamonica about the value of money.

programme.title: Say Hello, Wave Goodbye - S01E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — The Johnsons welcome an African American family that has just moved into their mostly white neighborhood. Santamonica doesn’t get along with the new neighbor’s daughter, until she gives Santamonica attitude. Meanwhile, Rainbow is excited to celebrate her one-month anniversary with Bryce, but he tells her some devastating news.

programme.title: Parents Just Don't Understand - S01E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow clashes with her parents over her love for rap music. Plus, Harrison steps in to take Denise to a charity benefit and helps her realize she deserves better men in her love life.

programme.title: Doctor! Doctor! - S01E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow’s friend Rebecca gets mono (“the kissing disease”), and after helping her out, she becomes interested in the medical field. Alicia fibs to Paul about getting a flu shot, and when Denise gets sick, their distrust of the medical community comes to light. Meanwhile, Johan and Santamonica go to live with Harrison while Denise is sick and start to enjoy his lavish lifestyle.

programme.title: Bad Boys - S01E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia and Paul try to deflect Johan’s interest in going to cop camp and one day becoming a police officer. Meanwhile, Rainbow gets her first role as a school safety patrol and quickly realizes that with great power comes great responsibility.

programme.title: Nothing's Gonna Stop Us Now - S01E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — After learning that scientists predict the ozone layer will be depleted in 20 years, Rainbow panics and tries to implement Earth Day at school to influence some change. To her surprise, she is met with resistance, forcing her to takes matters into her own hands to fight for the cause.

programme.title: Every Little Step - S01E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — The kids meet a homeless man in their neighborhood, and Paul and Alicia try to have an honest conversation with them about the homelessness crisis. Paul and Rainbow try to help by starting a soup kitchen at Rainbow's school. Meanwhile, Denise has a new boyfriend and Alicia doesn't think they're a match.

programme.title: You Got It All - S01E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — In the season finale of “mixed-ish,” Alicia and Paul are both offered jobs to work on Jesse Jackson’s presidential campaign, but Alicia’s law firm makes her an enticing offer to stay. Rainbow struggles to define her racial identity as “mixed” when she’s given a form to answer “black” or “white”.

programme.title: Sweet Child O’ Mine - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — After finding out Johan has been pretending to be a different race, Rainbow gets mad, and Alicia and Paul try to find a way to encourage Johan to be proud of being Black.

programme.title: Brand New Funk - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia and Denise bicker over who is the stronger Black woman, and Paul and Harrison come up with a new way of showing affection. Meanwhile, Rainbow is put in charge of Johan and Santamonica and she struggles to maintain control over them.

programme.title: On My Own - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Paul surprises the family by inviting one of his students to live with them, and Paul and Alicia compete to be his mentor. Meanwhile, Rainbow has a crush on their new house guest.

programme.title: Livin' on a Prayer - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Bow takes an interest in going to church with her friends, much to her parents’ dismay. Meanwhile, Santi and Jonah try to prepare for hell.

programme.title: My Prerogative - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — It’s not all fun and games when Paul wants to crash Denise and Alicia’s neighborhood Spades match, so they teach him about the cultural and racial significance of the game. Meanwhile, Santi, Johan and Bow learn about divorce after watching a movie, so Harrison tries to teach them that divorce can be cool.

programme.title: Just the Two of Us - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia and Denise realize they've been boxed into Black women stereotypes at the law firm, and Harrison's attempts to help ends up causing more harm; Paul worries his new job is taking time away from spending time with the kids.

programme.title: You Give Love a Bad Name - S02E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Paul and Alicia encourage sex-positive conversations with Bow until she invites her crush over to their house and they worry about what’s happening behind closed doors. Meanwhile, Johan and Alvin are looking at advertisements, magazines and even the constellations to see if they can see boobs.

programme.title: She's A Bad Mama Jama - S02E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia’s mom, Grandma Shireen, stays with the Johnson’s after her surgery, but taking care of grandma becomes a full-time job. Meanwhile, Denise tests each of the kids to see who is best fit to take care of her when she gets old one day.

programme.title: Material Girl - S02E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia treats herself to an expensive purse, but Paul finds out and demands that she return it; Bow bribes Alicia to buy her a fancy backpack so she can impress her friends at school.

programme.title: You Dropped a Bomb On Me - S02E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow's best friend, Tamika, asks her to plan her 14th birthday party, so Bow goes out of her way to make sure it's the coolest birthday party ever. Meanwhile, Paul and Alicia battle it out for who is the "coolest," and Harrison takes Santi and Johan on a trip to Mexico for some quality time.

programme.title: Tainted Love - S02E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — After the Johnson family discovers Harrison on a date, Paul decides to give Harrison some dating advice, which turns things upside down. Meanwhile, Alicia feels a little insecure after finding out all of her children go to Aunt Denise for advice instead of coming to her.

programme.title: Walk This Way - S02E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Paul tries to become better friends with Denise so he uses his white privilege to help her out with her errands. Meanwhile, Rainbow, Jonah and Santi are selling chocolate bars for their school fundraiser but they pick up some questionable sales tactics.

programme.title: Forever Young - S02E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — In 2021, Adult Rainbow, Johan and Santamonica recall very different accounts of what happened the summer that they all got their new bicycles. In the ‘80s, an overprotective Alicia's worst fear comes true when one of the kids goes off on their own with their bike and gets lost. Meanwhile, Harrison catches Denise spending extra time in the office to get overtime and puts her to work.

programme.title: Becoming Bow - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow Johnson recounts her experience growing up in a mixed-race family in the ’80s and the constant dilemmas they had to face over whether to assimilate or stay true to themselves. Bow’s parents Paul and Alicia decide to move from a hippie commune to the suburbs to better provide for their family. As her parents struggle with the challenges of their new life, Bow and her siblings navigate a mainstream school in which they’re perceived as neither black nor white. This family’s experiences illuminate the challenges of finding one’s own identity when the rest of the world can’t decide where you belong.

programme.title: The Warrior - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — For Rainbow and Alicia, fitting in at school and standing out at work are hard enough; but with the added pressure from stay-at-home-dad Paul to make the world a little better every day, it might just be impossible.

programme.title: Let Your Hair Down - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — After a teacher tells Rainbow to make sure her hair is "neat" for picture day, she becomes self-conscious and begins a complicated relationship with her hair. Meanwhile, Johan and Santamonica struggle with their own hair identity.

programme.title: Love is a Battlefield - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — When Rainbow is tasked with a school assignment that requires her to trace her roots, she learns that history is more complicated for her mom’s side of the family than it is for her dad’s. Meanwhile, Johan struggles to balance his new love of ice hockey with what his friends think is cool.

programme.title: All She Wants to Do is Dance - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — It’s time for the Johnson kids’ first school dance, but before Bow can dance the night away, she’ll have to consider the social impact of her date choice. Johan finds an outfit for the dance and discovers his love of fashion, while Santamonica spends some time with Harrison.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — The popular girls at school ask Rainbow to join their group Halloween costume as Tootie from “The Facts of Life.” She thinks this is finally her opportunity to fit in, but Denise views the situation differently. Meanwhile, Alicia doesn’t want the kids to go trick-or-treating after Harrison and his colleagues tell her about all the dangerous things that can happen.

programme.title: Puttin' On the Ritz - S01E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — The kids are excited to learn more about their grandad after Harrison invites the crew to family day at his country club. Although Paul thinks it’s a bad idea, he is eventually overruled. Meanwhile, Alicia attempts to fit in at the country club but ends up fighting with Denise about keeping it real.

programme.title: Weird Science - S01E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow’s passion for science deflates when her peers convince her that science isn’t cool. During Career Day, Rainbow code-switches and pursues journalism in order to fit in, only to find that the local news anchor attending the fair has also been hiding a part of herself. Meanwhile, Harrison works to mold a testimony from Denise who struggles to be anyone but herself, and Santamonica tries to steal the spotlight back after Johan suffers an injury.

programme.title: Papa Don't Preach - S01E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Paul struggles when Rainbow and Santamonica want to participate in a beauty pageant. Meanwhile, Johan gets teased for crying after a martial arts tournament, and Alicia and Harrison struggle with the best way for him to fight back.

programme.title: Do They Know It's Christmas - S01E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia and Paul strive to maintain their “Winter Solstice” traditions from the commune, but their parents want to have a more traditional Christmas with the kids. Meanwhile, Alicia’s dad, Lynwood, competes with Harrison to be the kids’ favorite Grandad.

programme.title: When Doves Cry - S01E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — In the wake of the Challenger tragedy, Rainbow and her family handle their grief in different ways. Denise realizes that life is too short, so she vows to right all the wrongs she’s done in her life (and she’s done a lot of bad).

programme.title: It's Tricky - S01E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow wants to battle stereotypes at school after she joins the track team and feels like her friends only see her skin color. Meanwhile, Alicia and Paul battle stereotypes of their own, and Santamonica tries to be cool enough to hang out with Rainbow's friends.

programme.title: Pride (In the Name of Love) - S01E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Paul speaks at the school assembly on Martin Luther King Jr. Day. The kids think Paul is going to embarrass them, so they decide not to attend.

programme.title: True Colors - S01E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Paul is shocked to hear from his estranged mother who wants to visit for Rainbow’s 13th birthday and soon learns more about why she abandoned him. Meanwhile, Rainbow sees turning 13 as a huge turning point in her life and wants a big birthday party, but Alicia wants to celebrate all the things Rainbow missed out on over the years while on the commune.

programme.title: This Charming Man - S01E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow is excited to go on her first real date with Bryce for Valentine’s Day, but when her friends weigh in on the rules and expectations, she becomes very nervous. Alicia is wary to let Rainbow start dating and invites Bryce’s parents over for dinner to cross-examine them; and Paul gets into a fight with Bryce’s dad over politics.

programme.title: She Works Hard for the Money - S01E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Alicia gets a bonus after winning a big case and wants to buy a nice car, but having been raised on the “fifty-cent principal,” Denise wants her to buy two cars in lesser condition so she can have one. Meanwhile, Paul tries to teach Rainbow, Johan and Santamonica about the value of money.

programme.title: Say Hello, Wave Goodbye - S01E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — The Johnsons welcome an African American family that has just moved into their mostly white neighborhood. Santamonica doesn’t get along with the new neighbor’s daughter, until she gives Santamonica attitude. Meanwhile, Rainbow is excited to celebrate her one-month anniversary with Bryce, but he tells her some devastating news.

programme.title: Parents Just Don't Understand - S01E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — Rainbow clashes with her parents over her love for rap music. Plus, Harrison steps in to take Denise to a charity benefit and helps her realize she deserves better men in her love life.

Meanwhile, Johan and Santamonica go to live with Harrison while Denise is sick and start to enjoy his lavish lifestyle.

programme.desc: Comedy · 2019 · TV-PG — The kids meet a homeless man in their neighborhood, and Paul and Alicia try to have an honest conversation with them about the homelessness crisis. programme.title: Moone Dance - S02E02

Meanwhile, Dessie has an important question for Fidelma.

programme.title: Handball Duel - S02E04

programme.title: Stags and Hens - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2012 · TV-14 — Could love be in the air when Martin's new classmate and neighbour Majella catches his eye? Father Linehan plans a memorable stag do for Dessie.

programme.title: The Boyle Wedding - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2012 · TV-14 — Celebration is in the air as St Patrick's Day dawns, but the Moones are having a different kind of party today: Fidelma's wedding.

programme.title: Where the Streets Do Have Names - S03E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2012 · TV-14 — Liam and Debra abandon the kids for a romantic break to celebrate their 20th anniversary - but it all threatens to fall apart after a chance encounter with Liam's old flame. Meanwhile, Martin and Padraic are in Dublin, where they soon discover new talents.

programme.title: The Plunder Years - S03E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2012 · TV-14 — Padraic finds himself caught in the middle of his warring parents and decides to escape his troubles, leading his worried mum and dad to raise the alarm following his disappearance. programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Jeff and Mark look to cash in on one final run of the season. Tickle and Chico's still site is compromised. Mike is desperate to complete his New Orleans order, and turns to Darlene. Josh and Bill might get to sell some of their own liquor after all.

programme.title: Liquid Courage - S03E13
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Jeff and Mark reach a roadblock; Deputy Chuck is in hot pursuit; Mike travels to finish off his biggest sale of the season; Tickle attracts unwanted attention.

programme.title: Shine On - S04E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tim is on the run after his operation was set on fire. Jim Tom prepares for his second coming as a moonshiner. Tickle & Tyler take their partnership to a new level. Josh & Bill sell last year's surplus shine. Jeff & Mark survey an indoor still site.

programme.title: Moonshine Cascade - S04E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tickle and Tyler need to fix a bad feed line and get back to work at the moonshine cave. Jim Tom and Roy build the still that will carry them to greatness. Josh and Bill are sidelined with a crushed still. Sheriff’s Deputy Chuck gains ground on Lance.

programme.title: Bullet Proof - S04E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh & Bill pick up the pieces of their broken still. Lance tries to brew a moonshine game changer as Sheriff's Deputy Chuck closes in. Tickle gets stranded miles from civilization. Tim sets out from Kentucky in search of greener pastures.

programme.title: Risky Whiskey - S04E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh and Bill rebuild bigger and better. Lance takes a risk on a new kind of whiskey, while Jeff and Mark prep their indoor still site. Tickle and crew battle the elements in Kentucky. Tim gives the North Carolina distillery a backwoods makeover.

programme.title: Tennessee Rising - S04E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tim learns a tough lesson; Mark and Jeff have a brush with the law.

programme.title: Moonshine Takedown - S04E06
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tickle nails down a stash spot. Josh and Bill butt heads in the backwoods. Jim Tom and Roy are back in action. Mark and Digger's still goes from old school to state-of-the-art. And Mark and Jeff put the bells and whistles on their new shine spot.

programme.title: White Lightning Wars - S04E07
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Mark and Jeff feel the heat as the law closes in. Tim's plan to give a backwoods makeover to Troy's distillery will cost him big. The law cracks down on Josh and Bill. Tickle flirts with disaster as he tries to sell his Kentucky made white lightning.

programme.title: Liquid Assets - S04E08
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tickle has his hands full keeping track of his liquor and Chico and Tyler are becoming suspicious. Bill and Josh build an underground bunker to hide their shine. Tennessee shiners, Mark and Digger, test an invention that could revolutionize moonshining.

programme.title: Shine Jacked - S04E09
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh and Bill have a close call with authorities; a new lawman visits two shiners in Tennessee; Tickle learns a lesson the hard way.

programme.title: Moonshine River - S04E10
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh and Bill have a triple batch run; Tickle makes a sacrifice to save his partnership; Tim is ready to see if the Asheville distillery can produce his moonshine.

programme.title: Shine Overboard - S04E11
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — The final weeks of shine season are here. Josh & Bill's liquor gets stuck six feet under. Chico & Tyler brew a sweet & sticky moonshine game-changer. Tickle gets trumped by his old buddy. And Mark & Jeff's first sale on the water ends in disaster.

programme.title: Bootleg or Bust - S04E12
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh and Bill secretly sell their shine; Tim returns to Virginia to fill an order; Mark tries to make a delivery by boat; Tickle's deal nearly breaks down.

programme.title: Bros Before Hooch - S04E13
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tickle takes risks to stay true to his old partner; Josh and Bill make a last run in the woods; Mark and Digger's season is in danger when their deal backfires.

programme.title: The Shining - S04E14
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — It’s last call in shine country. Deputy Chuck takes to the water to catch Mark red-handed. Tim & Tickle work together to make a rush delivery of 2,000 cases of liquor in their home state. The cops close in on Josh & Bill with shocking consequences.

programme.title: American Spirits - S05E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — In the Season 5 premiere, moonshine is in demand and the law is on the hunt. Included: Tim faces a dilemma that jeopardizes his legit business; Jeff, Mark and Lance aim to double their profits; and Josh and Bill find themselves on shaky legal ground.

programme.title: Whiskey Burn - S05E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Mark and Digger come up with a revolutionary still design in the first weeks of shine season, during which the outlaws are eager to turn a profit before the cops close in. Josh and Bill's first run leaves a bitter taste. Jeff, Mark and Lance scope out the competition.

programme.title: Gone A-Rye - S05E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Shiners attempt to stay off the grid as the outside world encroaches on the backwoods. Tim breaks the news about the fate of Climax Moonshine. Jeff, Mark and Lance search for a new site before rivals can grab hold of the market.

programme.title: Still Life - S05E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Shine season is in full swing as Josh & Bill find themselves with no still, no home base and no shine. Mark & Digger enlist a whiskey legend to find out why their first run went awry. Mark, Jeff & Lance undertake construction on an ambitious still site.

programme.title: Rain or Shine - S05E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Weeks into moonshine season, Josh & Bill race to finish their still site and make their first run. Intruders interrupt Mark & Digger's rye test. A deadly disaster leaves Tim rattled and rethinking his plans to expand.

programme.title: Scotch on the Rocks - S05E06
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — It's one step forward and two steps back for Josh and Bill as they near the completion of their bunker. Meanwhile, Jeff, Mark and Lance are $6000 in the hole after losing a batch of mash before starting work on their Highland Scotch.

programme.title: Six Feet Undercover - S05E07
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Mark and Digger, with help from Jim Tom, craft 150 gallons of brandy using their revolutionary still pot design. Now, it's just a matter of getting their shine into the hands of their eager customers.

programme.title: Out on a Limb - S05E08
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Patti and David deal with a trespasser that is interfering with their plans. Elsewhere, Chico and Tyler separate over creative differences.

programme.title: Trouble Brewing - S05E09
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tim attempts to sell his moonshine to an international market.

programme.title: Caved In - S05E10
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Patti and David work on a fiery, new brew. Elsewhere, the feud continues between Josh and Bill.

programme.title: Cherry Bounce - S05E11
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tim works to fill a large international order. Elsewhere, Tickle goes to court in Virginia.

programme.title: Shine 'Til You Drop - S05E12
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Mark and Digger set up a new still site. Elsewhere, Patti and David try their jalapeño whiskey in an untested market.

programme.title: Still Regretting - S05E13
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh is missing his help; production is stopped at Snags' distillery; Chico and Sandra go mountain shining; Patti and David hurry their run as the hunting season starts.

programme.title: Virgin Whiskey - S05E14
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh works with Jim Tom to make up a batch from his family's recipe book. Elsewhere, Chico and Sandra make their first run and Tim's tank is not enough for the Poland order.

programme.title: Presidential Shine - S05E15
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — A local fracking operation threatens Patti and David's season; Jeff, Mark and Lance rely on a classic recipe to save their sales; Digger and Mark get visited by law enforcement.

programme.title: End of an Era - S05E16
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Tim is thousands of cases off from delivering his order; Mark and Digger are surprised at a sale; and Josh makes amends.

programme.title: Need for Speed - S05E17
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh gets some help from a pro with his dirt track skills. Elsewhere, Tyler searches for a bootlegging car while Mark and Huck make a delivery over state lines.

programme.title: Whiskey Rebellion - S06E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — It's moonshine season in Appalachia. Josh has hit the ground running but working solo can lead to catastrophic results. And former outlaw Tim Smith is training his son JT to help run his legal outfit.

programme.title: Take Me to the River - S06E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Patti & David scramble to locate a clean water source for their operation. Mark Rogers ventures into unfamiliar territory to secure new buyers. Mark & Digger use an old moonshiner's trick to spook intruders from their still site.

programme.title: Hard Start - S06E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Josh finds himself in desperate need of help following a catastrophe and Chico and Sandra's moonshine partnership puts strain on their relationship. Mark and Digger get innovative with their still, but the operation attracts an unwanted visitor.

programme.title: Luck of the Irish - S06E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — A rookie mistake could ruin Josh and Chuck's operation and Tim travels across the Atlantic to teach an old Irish distillery about making moonshine. Mark and Digger's mash test is interrupted by an unwanted visitor.

programme.title: Reflections and Regrets - S03E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — At Mr. Bickley's 50th birthday party, everyone shares what they regret in their life. Mindy makes excuses to put off her turn, but after everyone leaves, she shares her regret with Mork.

programme.title: Limited Engagement - S04E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — After decorating the apartment with flowers, Mork gets down on his knee and proposes to Mindy. Choosing between logic and her emotions, Mindy tells him that she cannot marry him. Mork asks for 24 hours to get her to change her mind.

programme.title: The Wedding - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Orson forbids Mork to marry Mindy because marriage is outlawed on Ork. Because Mork goes ahead with the wedding anyway, Orson turns him into a dog.

programme.title: The Honeymoon - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mork and Mindy take their honeymoon on Ork, but Mindy becomes a tourist attraction. Things keep going wrong and Mork doesn't understand Earth honeymoon customs. He confesses to Mindy that he's scared of being married.

programme.title: Three the Hard Way - S04E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Exidor determines that Mork is pregnant and eventually gives birth to an egg via his navel. Mindy has trouble accepting that in the egg is their child. The egg hatches a full grown, elderly man as their baby.

programme.title: Mama Mork, Papa Mindy - S04E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mearth learns to walk and talk, but calls Mindy 'shoe'. Mindy starts avoiding Mearth until Mork gives her an opportunity to bond with her son.

programme.title: My Dad Can't Beat Up Anybody - S04E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mork becomes insecure when he thinks he doesn't have Mearth's respect. Mearth finds Mork's spacesuit and Mork wears it as a superhero costume. Mork and Mearth go to a bar, looking for some bad guys and they find more than they bargained for.

programme.title: Long Before We Met... - S04E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mork accompanies Mindy to her high school reunion and gets upset when Mindy associates with an old boyfriend. Mork then attempts to go back in time to the prom and do away with the boyfriend.

programme.title: Rich Mork, Poor Mork - S04E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mork turns to Exidor for money advice, but then invests all the family's money in Exidor's boutique.

programme.title: Alienation - S04E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Mork and Mindy tell Mearth he's an alien, he gets upset, runs away and is captured by a cult of Utopians. Mork and Mindy pretend to be part of the cult to rescue him.

programme.title: P.S. 2001 - S04E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mearth wants to go to school and gets sent to school on Ork, but he comes home crying because the other kids made fun of him and he hates the teacher. Mork and Mindy take Mearth back to class and Mearth uses his parents as a show-and-tell item.

programme.title: Pajama Game II - S04E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mearth is allowed to have some of his Orkan friends over and Zelka ends up spending the night. Mork and Mindy explain the facts of life to Mearth when they assume something happened between him and Zelka.

programme.title: Present Tense - S04E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mearth goes on a trip with Fred so Mork and Mindy have a week to spend alone together. They find that without Mearth at home, they have nothing to talk about. After they have a fight, Mork takes Mindy to the place they first met.

programme.title: Metamorphosis - The TV Show - S04E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — KTNS station manager, Mr. Sternhagen gets fired by his new and very young boss. The boss holds a party to meet all the employees' families, but a short circuit switches Mork's mind with Mearth's.

programme.title: Drive, She Said - S04E14

programme.title: The Inca Maiden - S01E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2015 · TV-Y7 — The Inca Maiden marvels at the stunningly preserved mummy of a 14-year-old girl who died and was buried at the top of the highest active volcano in the world. The extreme environment guaranteed her preservation but did it also kill her? As the secrets of a lost civilization are revealed, shocking clues point us in a more sinister direction, and provide an unprecedented, emotional and intimate look at the tragic life and death of this young girl.

programme.title: The Pharaoh's Secret - S01E05
programme.desc: Documentary · 2015 · TV-Y7 — The Pharaoh’s Secret peels back the wrappings on a mysterious, mutilated pharaoh. Reconstructed in hyper-real CG and using the latest forensic techniques, this programme unearths a violent story of conquest and rebellion that laid the foundations for Ancient Egypt’s golden age.

programme.title: The Hero of Herculaneum - S01E06
programme.desc: Documentary · 2015 · TV-Y7 — The Hero of Herculaneum investigates a forgotten chapter from the volcanic destruction of Pompeii and Herculaneum: 300 mummified skeletons found buried in ash, including the body of a man armed to the teeth and carrying a huge cache of gold and silver. Who was he? What was his role in the disaster? And how did he die? For the very first time his story is told…

programme.title: The Gunslinger Mummy - S01E01
programme.desc: Documentary · 2015 · TV-Y7 — The Gunslinger Mummy delves into the myth and legend of the American West through an investigation into a mysterious mummy named Sylvester - now on display at a Seattle curiosity shop. The world of cowboys and carnival sideshows comes to life in stunning CG animation as we discover whether the truth really is stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Buried in a Bog - S01E02
programme.desc: Documentary · 2015 · TV-Y7 — Buried in a Bog unravels the riddle of two Iron Age Bog Bodies unearthed from the peat fields of Ireland. Through CG Animation these mysterious mummies, murdered over two millennia ago are brought back to life in a shocking ancient detective story that discovers the truth and glory behind their deaths.

programme.title: Otzi The Iceman - S01E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 2015 · TV-Y7 — Ötzi the Iceman re-opens one of the oldest cold cases in human history by examining a Neolithic murder victim buried under ice for over five thousand years. Chilling events are reconstructed in hyper-real cg and the latest forensic and scientific techniques employed to expose Europe’s ancient, violent past.
