programme.title: House Rules - S12E10
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS team consults with three cyber-terrorists they imprisoned after a city-wide Internet shutdown the week before Christmas. Also, McGee reflects on the case and Gibbs' infamous rules as he pens a heartfelt letter to his father.

programme.title: Check - S12E11
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS team must investigate a series of crime scenes that appear to be copy-cats of previous cases. Also, two of Gibbs' ex-wives, one of which the team has yet to meet, show up at a crime scene to discuss something important with him. Jeri Ryan guest stars.

programme.title: The Enemy Within - S12E12
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS team searches for a home-grown terrorist after a rescue mission in Syria reveals an American was involved in the capture of a social worker. Meanwhile, McGee and Bishop question DiNozzo's unusual behavior. Joe Spano and Marisol Nichols guest star.

programme.title: We Build, We Fight - S12E13
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Gibbs and the team investigate when a Navy lieutenant who is set to be the first openly gay servicemember to receive the Medal of Honor is murdered. Also, as his wife's due date approaches, Palmer prepares for fatherhood with an NCIS baby shower. Rocky Carroll makes his directorial debut.

programme.title: Cadence - S12E14
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — DiNozzo returns to the military academy he attended as a teenager after a murdered Marine and alumni of the school is found clutching the photo of a current student. Also, Bishop and her husband invite Gibbs and the team out for a special dinner.

programme.title: Cabin Fever - S12E15
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS team suspects Gibbs' arch-nemesis is behind an explosion at a global terrorism summit. Gibbs elects to sit out the investigation in order to help a grief-stricken Fornell, whose life is on the verge of imploding following his wife’s murder.

programme.title: Blast From the Past - S12E16
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — A covert identity created for one of Gibbs’ undercover cases 20 years ago resurfaces after a murder victim is found living under the alias.

programme.title: The Artful Dodger - S12E17
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Evidence in an NCIS murder case reveals a rare painting on loan had been swapped for a fake, prompting DiNozzo, Sr. to share his knowledge and contacts of the black market art world with the team.

programme.title: Status Update - S12E18
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — After the body of a thief is found in a Marine’s house, NCIS discovers the calling card of a terror group Delilah and the Department of Defense have been tracking.

programme.title: Patience - S12E19
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The murder of a petty officer sparks a lead in a 40 year old airport bombing cold case that Gibbs and DiNozzo have been assigned to for the past two years. Also, McGee is jealous that he was not previously briefed on the cold case.

programme.title: No Good Deed - S12E20
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — DiNozzo is partnered with his girlfriend ATF Special Agent Zoé Keates after evidence reveals that the murder weapon in an NCIS case was originally purchased for the controversial ATF sting operation “Operation Fast and Furious.” Also, Anthony DiNozzo Sr. returns to town for a special dinner to meet his son’s girlfriend.

programme.title: Lost in Translation - S12E21
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Gibbs and Bishop travel to Afghanistan after the murder of a Marine in D.C. is linked to a terror group holding another Marine hostage overseas. Also, DiNozzo is upset that McGee was chosen to be the new face of NCIS for all recruitment brochures,

programme.title: Troll - S12E22
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Special Agent Ned Dorneget from NCIS cyber operations assists the team when a Navy ensign who worked in the Office of Naval Intelligence is murdered. Also, the team discovers that Jake and Gibbs have become good friends.

programme.title: The Lost Boys - S12E23
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS cyber case turns into a united global effort after evidence confirms “The Calling,” an international terrorist group that recruits children through the internet, has been purchasing S-bombs off the black market.

programme.title: Neverland - S12E24
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — NCIS feverishly investigates a global terrorist group that is recruiting teens via the Internet, following a deadly bombing overseas that results in an emotional and surprising loss for the team.

programme.title: Stop the Bleeding - S13E01
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — After being shot, Gibbs fights for his life aboard a Navy hospital ship, while DiNozzo and Joanna travel to Shanghai to try and take down the Calling.

programme.title: Personal Day - S13E02
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Gibbs calls on the team to assist DEA Agent Luis Mitchell with a case that keeps going cold, but DiNozzo discovers there is more to Gibbs’ personal connection to the agent and his desire to help him succeed. Also, the team gossips about Gibbs’ new look after he replaces his standard military haircut and polo shirt for a modern cut and tailored dress shirt.

programme.title: Incognito - S13E03
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — After a Marine is found murdered in Quantico hours after calling Gibbs to discuss a possible case, Bishop and McGee go undercover as a married couple to run surveillance on a Marine Lieutenant and his wife.

programme.title: Double Trouble - S13E04
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Vance partners with Gibbs and returns to field duty when a murder case is connected to a former NCIS agent he locked up for stealing evidence.

programme.title: Lockdown - S13E05
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — While visiting a pharmaceutical lab on a murder case, Abby is trapped with no communication to the outside world after armed men take over the building and hold everyone hostage.

programme.title: Viral - S13E06
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — When a petty officer’s murder matches the M.O. of a local serial killer, the NCIS team must determine if this is the killer’s latest victim or the work of a copycat. Also, McGee and Delilah must learn to compromise before moving in together.

programme.title: 16 Years - S13E07
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS murder case of a retired Navy Lieutenant Commander forces Ducky to reveal his participation in a secret society that solves cold cases.

programme.title: Saviors - S13E08
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — DiNozzo is reunited with his ex-girlfriend, Jeanne Benoit, when insurgents in Sudan attack a group of volunteer doctors, including her husband. DiNozzo and McGee travel to the crime scene for the joint murder and kidnapping case and join the search for the missing doctors.

programme.title: Day in Court - S13E09
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — In order to clear his name, a petty officer volunteers to be court martialed if NCIS agrees to conduct its own investigation after his murder case is dismissed due to a mishandled warrant. Also, Bishop and Jake discuss their marital problems.

programme.title: Blood Brothers - S13E10
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The Secretary of Defense calls on NCIS to help a sailor who is battling leukemia to locate a donor for a bone marrow transplant, after two of his siblings are killed in the line of duty. Meanwhile, Bishop returns home to Oklahoma for Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Spinning Wheel - S13E11
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — After Ducky is attacked by a man claiming to have information about his half-brother who died decades ago, the NCIS team searches for the perpetrator, as Ducky recalls the final emotional days he had with his sibling. Also, with the holidays approaching, Bishop and Jake discuss the future of their relationship.

programme.title: Sister City (1) - S13E12
programme.desc:
Action · 2003 · TV-14 — After the passengers and crew of a private plane traveling from New Orleans to Washington D.C. are lethally poisoned, all evidence points to the missing chef, Abby’s brother, Luca. Gibbs and the D.C. team work in conjunction with Pride and the New Orleans team to locate Luca and determine why a private tech company was targeted.
(Sister City (2) aired on NCIS: New Orleans, season 2, episode 12.)

programme.title: Déjà Vu - S13E13
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — While investigating the murder of a seaman who was set to testify before a grand jury, the NCIS team uncovers the resurgence of an international human-trafficking ring. Also, McGee hopes to spend the night at a colleague’s home after a storm causes massive power outages in the city.

programme.title: Decompressed - S13E14
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Four deep sea divers stay inside a diving chamber with a deceased body in order to decompress. The dead body belongs to a retired petty officer who died in mysterious circumstances. The NCIS team will try to crack the case from land while the divers spend four days with the body.

programme.title: React - S13E15
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — When Secretary of the Navy Sarah Porter learns her daughter has been kidnapped, the NCIS team partners with the FBI to track the case, determine a motive and bring her home. Also, McGee’s childhood friend, NCIS Special Agent Valerie Page is in town to assist the team with advance tactics training

programme.title: Loose Cannons - S13E16
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Doctor Cyril Taft experiences the rush of an NCIS case after he is assigned surgical duty to Gibb’s suspect and finds key evidence. Also, Dinozzo pays Jeanne Benoit a visit as he chases a lead involving doctors in Sudan.

programme.title: After Hours - S13E17
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS agents’ personal plans are interrupted when each of them catches errors in a seemingly cut-and-dried closed case. Also, McGee and Delilah argue over the importance of not discussing work during dinner, while DiNozzo bores his date with shop talk.

programme.title: Scope - S13E18
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS team re-examines an ambush on a group of Special Ops snipers in Iraq after an American couple is attacked in the same area six months later. When Gibbs discovers he needs the account of the lone survivor, Marine Gunnery Sergeant Aaron Davis, he tries to connect with the wounded warrior who is being treated for PTSD at Walter Reed Medical Center.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubts - S13E19
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — The NCIS team must ascertain who is lying, the wife or the mistress, after the women accuse each other of murdering a Navy Public Affairs officer. Also, Anthony DiNozzo, Sr. helps a homeless woman who believes he is her father.

programme.title: Charade - S13E20
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — After Tony’s identity is stolen by multiple perpetrators, the fake Special Agent DiNozzos begin blackmailing Senators.

programme.title: Return to Sender - S13E21
programme.desc: Action · 2003 · TV-14 — Gibbs and Senior FBI Agent T.C. Fornell unite after two British prisoners, including a former spy, escape and arrive stateside via a shipping container. Also, McGee is busy apartment hunting and determined to find out how DiNozzo purchased his lavish place.

programme.title: Chinatown - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The death of a lieutenant commander appears to be suicide but the NCIS team uncovers evidence corresponding to murder. Also, Operational Psychologist Nate Getz joins Special Agent Kensi Blye in the field.

programme.title: Full Throttle - S01E17
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After a sailor is killed during an underground street race, the NCIS team determines that his car had been sabotaged and contained confidential Navy equipment. Meanwhile, Callen is forced to take traffic school.

programme.title: Blood Brothers - S01E18
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The investigation of a drive-by shooting has the NCIS team searching Los Angeles for the dead marine's younger brother who may be the next target and the one with the answers.

programme.title: Hand-to-Hand - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — When an undercover operation has the NCIS team investigating a MMA gym and its fighters, Sam Hanna is tasked with donning gloves and entering the cage for a one-on-one fight.

programme.title: Fame - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer entangled in the world of Hollywood glitz and glamour as the team is joined at Hetty's request by LAPD liaison Marty Deeks.

programme.title: Found - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team races to save one of their own when they receive video evidence of Special Agent Dominic Vail being held hostage months after he was kidnapped.

programme.title: Hunted - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team is on the hunt for a terrorist who escaped Army custody during a secretive transfer in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Burned - S01E23
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After Callen's cover is blown and compromises the unit, the NCIS team races to find out who is behind the security breach.

programme.title: Callen, G - S01E24
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Callen races against a ruthless adversary to locate a woman who knows the whereabouts of a forgotten fortune earmarked to fund a new war in the Middle East - and also holds the tantalizing key to his unknown past.

programme.title: Human Traffic - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — When one of their own disappears while undercover, the team must work alongside LAPD on a case involving human-trafficking, money laundering and drugs.

programme.title: Black Widow - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After a mysterious hit squad takes out a Special Agent on assignment, the NCIS team jumps into action before the next target is set.

programme.title: Borderline - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team jumps into action when video surveillance footage shows an ambush on a humvee transporting Marines in the desert. Meanwhile, Nate returns from his mystery assignment.

programme.title: Special Delivery - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team investigates the murder of a Marine with top-level security clearance after he is found dead and missing a hand in a Beverly Hills parking lot off Rodeo Drive.

programme.title: Little Angels - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Videotape revealing a Naval Commander's daughter being buried alive strikes a nerve with Special Agent Sam Hanna and thrusts the NCIS team in a race against the clock to save the girl before time runs out.

programme.title: Standoff - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After a downtown Navy Recruitment Center is held hostage, Callen mediates with his ex-partner, Tracy Keller, to uncover information about a hijacked shipment of Spike missiles.

programme.title: Anonymous - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After a state department employee and a plastic surgeon are murdered by a group of terrorists, the NCIS team must frantically search for the only witness who can identify the killers' surgically altered faces.

programme.title: Bounty - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — When a former Army Sergeant responsible for hunting down high-value targets is found dead, the NCIS team searches for terrorist leaders suspected of his murder. Meanwhile, Deeks bonds with a person of interest in the case, making him more determined than ever to track down the killers.

programme.title: Absolution (1) - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — When a murdered antiques dealer's book of top-secret information goes missing, Hetty sends the NCIS team on a mission to find it.

programme.title: Deliverance (2) - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Hetty and the NCIS team continue to search for an elusive book that has the attention of several foreign security agencies.

programme.title: Disorder - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Kensi connects personally with a discharged Navy Intelligence officer suffering from post traumatic stress disorder who is the sole survivor of a deadly dispute being investigated by the NCIS team.

programme.title: Overwatch - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team uncovers an experimental Navy tracking system when a body containing a top-secret residue is stolen from an autopsy room. Meanwhile, Callen challenges Hetty on the rock wall.

programme.title: Archangel - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team sets out to find the individual responsible for stealing a classified Pentagon document before the file's decryption code is cracked by the wrong party.

programme.title: Lockup - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Sam goes undercover as a prisoner to track down a terrorist group responsible for several bombings around the world.

programme.title: Tin Soldiers - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After Callen catches a man breaking into his house, a former KGB operative leads the NCIS team to a shipment of counterfeit computer chips entering the United States.

programme.title: Empty Quiver - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Suspicious of an undercover venture involving a deal between corrupt cops and military personnel, Callen and Sam try to expose the illegal operation by posing as California highway patrol officers.

programme.title: Personal - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Deeks' morning routine is disrupted when he is shot during a convenience store robbery, leaving the NCIS team to investigate whether he was the assailants' intended target.

programme.title: Harm's Way - S02E18
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Sam resumes a former alias and boards a one-way flight to Yemen in hopes of tracking down a terrorist group's leader and rescuing the hostage son of a Saudi Prince.

programme.title: Enemy Within - S02E19
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — NCIS investigates whether the life of a Venezuelan politician is in danger after a Navy Intelligence Commander who is responsible for tracking his moves suddenly disappears.

programme.title: The Job - S02E20
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Kensi goes undercover as a thief in the hopes of uncovering the object that a world-class thief intended to steal.

programme.title: Rocket Man - S02E21
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After a rocket engine expert is killed, NCIS tech operator Eric Beale goes undercover for the first time to ensure that the classified technology used to build satellites is safe.

programme.title: Plan B - S02E22
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Deeks resumes an old alias he is not fond of in order to protect his best friend and chief informant from a criminal group that wants him dead.

programme.title: Imposters - S02E23
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — After a Navy SEAL imposter is set ablaze, NCIS obtains new information regarding the whereabouts of the stolen Brachytherapy canister that could be used to make a deadly bomb.

programme.title: Familia - S02E24
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Hetty's sudden resignation prompts Callen and the NCIS team to investigate the reason why she would disappear in the hopes of tracking her down.

programme.title: Lange, H. - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The Special Projects team travels to Romania to search for Hetty, while delving into the history of the Comescu crime family, and their connection to Callen. Meanwhile, Eric and Nell discover that Lauren Hunter, the Office of Special Projects' Operations Manager, is a member of the Comescus.

programme.title: Cyber Threat - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — The NCIS team joins forces with the NSA to find the creator and controller of a software program linked to a cyber attack against the Department of Defense. Meanwhile, Callen continues searching for more information about his past.

programme.title: Backstopped - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-14 — Special Agent Sam Hanna is sent undercover as a bomb specialist as the team races to locate stolen explosives somewhere in the city. Meanwhile, to much protest, Hunter changes the dynamics of the team and has Callen partnered with Kensi and Sam with Deeks.

programme.title: Checkmate (1) - S04E23
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride assembles an off-the-books team with hacker Elvis Bertrand, retired Green Beret Sydney Halliday journalist Oliver Crane and attorney Elliott Newman, to search for a loophole when he faces a grand jury indictment for abuse of power.

programme.title: Checkmate (2) - S04E24
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride’s newly formed off-the-books team and NCIS team uncover a sinister plot during the New Orleans Tricentennial Fleet Week celebration.

programme.title: See You Soon - S05E01
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — While Pride fights for his life in the ICU, the team scours the city for the hit woman who attempted to assassinate him.

programme.title: Inside Out - S05E02
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — As the team searches for a former IRA bomb-maker who was smuggled into the city, they are joined by Special Agent Hannah Khoury, Pride’s replacement during his medical leave. Also, Pride considers a new position with the agency.

programme.title: Diplomatic Immunity - S05E03
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — While NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy intelligence officer killed during a conference for foreign diplomats, the key witness cozies up to Sebastian. Also, Pride has some trouble adjusting to his new position at the agency.

programme.title: Legacy - S05E04
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After a petty officer is found murdered under a shrimping boat, the NCIS investigation uncovers a conspiracy in the tight-knit local fishing community. Also, Lasalle awaits the final results of the tax fraud investigation into his family’s company.

programme.title: In the Blood - S05E05
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride’s father, Cassius Pride, is wrapped up in an NCIS case involving a notorious unsolved casino heist from several years ago. Also, Pride meets a family member he never knew existed.

programme.title: Pound of Flesh - S05E06
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After Pride’s assistant, Ginny Young, escapes from a kidnapper, the NCIS team uncovers evidence of a suspect who is harvesting organs from multiple victims. Also, Pride turns to his friend, Commander Calvin Atkins, M.D., for medical and spiritual guidance as he struggles with the ramifications of his recent brush with death.

programme.title: Sheepdogs - S05E07
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Following a deadly car explosion in the French Quarter, the NCIS team interrogates a professor and former member of a student protest organization. Also, Tammy discovers a secret about Hannah’s personal life.

programme.title: Close to Home - S05E08
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The NCIS team places Mateo Diaz, a high school gang member turned informant, in protective custody while they investigate the murder of his junior reserve officers’ training corps instructor. Also, Pride needs his brother Jimmy Boyd’s help to gain Mateo’s trust.

programme.title: Risk Assessment - S05E09
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The NCIS team investigates the murder of a Navy contractor who, unbeknownst to anyone, lived two lives for decades, with two wives, families and careers.

programme.title: Tick Tock - S05E10
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — While on a sunrise jog, Pride is grabbed by two masked men who order him to complete a series of tasks in order to save Wade and his father, Cassius Pride, who are being held captive.

programme.title: Vindicta - S05E11
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride and the NCIS team hope to take down a secret and lethal group of former intelligence agents and avenge the death of someone close to them.

programme.title: Desperate Navy Wives - S05E12
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — While undercover, Gregorio joins a social club for military wives after one of the members is contacted by an ex-boyfriend on the FBI Most Wanted List.

programme.title: X - S05E13
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — NCIS investigates the disappearance of a Navy entomologist after a deadly shooting at a research lab. Nero, with Naval Intelligence, joins the investigation when the team discovers a rare and deadly virus was also stolen.

programme.title: Conspiracy Theories - S05E14
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride and the team reunite with conspiracy journalist Oliver Crane after the source for his latest vigilante story is murdered. Also, Hannah’s former partner, Liam Somers, surprises her in New Orleans and shares a shocking revelation about an old case.

programme.title: Crab Mentality - S05E15
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The team investigates multiple murders tied to a construction company creating an experimental chemical that strengthens sea walls. Also, evidence from Hannah’s previous mission in Oman is used against her as blackmail.

programme.title: Survivor - S05E16
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After an elusive terrorist with a personal vendetta against Hannah resurfaces, she is placed in protective custody with her family while the NCIS team searches for the suspect’s whereabouts.

programme.title: Reckoning - S05E17
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After a reshuffling of assignments, Pride is no longer Special Agent in Charge of the Southeast and returns to the New Orleans NCIS office during the investigation of a missing petty officer.

programme.title: In Plain Sight - S05E18
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The NCIS team investigates the murder of Patton’s friend, a former Navy Seal gunned down in a drive-by shooting while Patton helplessly watched.

programme.title: A House Divided - S05E19
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After a Navy Lieutenant from a well-connected and affluent New Orleans family has a fatal fall down a flight of stairs at a charity gala, the NCIS team investigates whether his death was an accident or foul play.

programme.title: Jackpot - S05E20
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — When Elvis Bertrand’s “daughter” is linked to an NCIS murder case, he asks Pride to prove her innocence.

programme.title: Trust Me - S05E21
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Tammy is convinced that a con man committed the hit-and-run murder of a Navy doctor, even though the evidence shows otherwise. Also, unbeknownst to Hannah, her husband, Ryan Porter, approaches Pride with new intel on Apollyon, the underground spy network responsible for murdering his father.

programme.title: Chaos Theory - S05E22
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The NCIS team investigates a deadly bombing at a military museum event with over 1,000 people in attendance.

programme.title: The River Styx (1) - S05E23
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride and Lasalle travel to war-torn South Ossetia in Russia to locate FBI Special Agent Raymond Isler, who was kidnapped during a failed mission to apprehend the leader of Apollyon, the underground spy network responsible for murdering Pride’s father.

programme.title: The River Styx (2) - S05E24
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After tracking Apollyon, a deadly underground spy network, to war-torn South Ossetia, Pride is separated from the team and faces grave danger. Also, in order to save Pride, the NCIS team must locate a mole who continues to feed information to Apollyon.

programme.title: Judgement Call - S06E01
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride must cut his vacation short when Hannah is suspended for breaking protocol during a joint investigation with the FBI.

programme.title: The Terminator Conundrum - S06E02
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — NCIS investigates a private plane crash after a Navy pilot says she saw an unidentified object prior to the crash. Pride suffers from insomnia and nightmares as a result of being kidnapped and drugged last year.

programme.title: Bad Apple - S06E03
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride travels to New York after new evidence links to a 20-year-old cold case from his time at Jefferson Parish Sheriff’s office.

programme.title: Overlooked - S06E04
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The NCIS team uncovers a sinister plot by a private detention center contracted by the government to house undocumented immigrants. Lasalle and Sebastian travel to Alabama to search for Lasalle’s missing brother.

programme.title: Spies & Lies - S06E05
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Navy Lieutenant Max Landry asks the New Orleans field office for help when he suspects his girlfriend is a spy. Also, Lasalle faces another devastating dead end as he searches for his brother’s last known whereabouts.

programme.title: Matthew 5:9 - S06E06
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Lasalle hopes to avenge his brother’s murder by tracking a drug ring in Alabama he believes is responsible. When Pride assists with the case, he crosses paths with Eddie Barrett, an elusive individual who knows more than he is sharing.

programme.title: Boom-Boom-Boom-Boom - S06E07
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Following a natural gas explosion at a movie theater, the NCIS team discovers the gas company has been hacked and more explosions could be triggered.

programme.title: The Order of the Mongoose - S06E08
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sebastian calls the NCIS team to assist with a possible kidnapping case when a dignitary’s son he was assigned to protect disappears from a local concert venue.

programme.title: Convicted - S06E09
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After Eddie Barrett provides an alibi witness, Pride and the team are more determined than ever to find a break in the case and avenge Lasalle’s murder.

programme.title: Requital - S06E10
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Pride is cut off from the team and backed into a corner after the investigation into Eddie Barrett uncovers a malicious plot.

programme.title: Asuka Strikes! - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Shinji and his friends accompany Misato to meet Eva Unit 02 and its pilot Asuka at sea. Misato's old friend Ryoji Kaji is aboard with his own agenda.

programme.title: Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win! - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Asuka and Shinji face another Angel but it gets the upper hand. They now have six days to learn synchronized moves to destroy it completely.

programme.title: Magmadiver - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — NERV learns of an Angel in dormant embryonic form inside a volcano. Using equipment designed for magma, Asuka is sent to retrieve it with Unit 02.

programme.title: The Day Tokyo-3 Stood Still - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Tokyo-3 loses power just as another Angel is detected. The Eva pilots must enter the base from the surface while NERV preps the Units manually.

programme.title: She said, "Don't make others suffer for your personal hatred." - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — With Gendo and Fuyutsuki in Antarctica, a newly promoted Misato is in charge when a new Angel appears above the Earth, aiming to bomb Tokyo-3.

programme.title: Lilliputian Hitcher - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — An Angel infiltrates NERV, quickly taking over the MAGI supercomputer, Ritsuko proposes writing a program to forcibly evolve Ireul to its extinction.

programme.title: Weaving a Story - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — As Seele reviews NERV and Gendo's actions with the Third through Eleventh Angels, Ritsuko conducts a test in which the Eva pilots switch Units.

programme.title: Those women longed for the touch of others' lips, and thus invited their kisses. - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — For the first time in years, Shinji meets his father at his mother's grave. Ritsuko, Misato and Ryoji attend a wedding and Asuka goes on a date.

programme.title: Splitting of the Breast - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — While in battle, Shinji and Unit 01 are engulfed in the spreading shadow of an Angel. As NERV fears them both lost, Shinji has a strange experience.

programme.title: Fourth Child - S01E17
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — NERV-02 in Nevada vanishes, along with the Eva Unit 04. With Unit 03 on the way, Gendo orders Ritsuko to assign a pilot to it.

programme.title: Ambivalence - S01E18
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Unit 03 arrives from the United States, but Shinji still doesn't know who its pilot is. During testing, NERV learns Unit 03 is possessed by an Angel.

programme.title: Introjection - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Distraught after the battle, Shinji vows to never pilot an Eva again and quits NERV once more. Just as he's about to leave, another Angel attacks.

programme.title: Weaving a Story 2: oral stage - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — After achieving an unheard of synchronization rate, Shinji merges with Unit 01. While he has an out of body experience, NERV works to salvage him.

programme.title: He was aware that he was still a child. - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Seele kidnaps Fuyutsuki and interrogates him about NERV and Gendo's true intentions, revealing events from the past. Ryoji goes missing.

programme.title: Don't Be. - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Asuka's synchronization ratio continues to drop, undermining her self-confidence. Determined to show her worth, she ignores orders during battle.

programme.title: Rei III - S01E23
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Despite her struggles, Asuka is ordered to assist Rei in battle against Armisael. When she fails, Rei makes a desperate move in order to save Shinji.

programme.title: The Beginning and the End, or "Knockin' on Heaven's Door" - S01E24
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Kaworu Nagisa, the Fifth Child, comes to NERV to pilot Unit 02 in Asuka's place. He's friendly to Shinji, but he's shrouded in mystery.

programme.title: Do you love me? - S01E25
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — The Human Instrumentality Project begins, and the souls of humanity merge. The Eva pilots confront the nature of their existence as reality dissolves.

programme.title: Take care of yourself - S01E26
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — The Human Instrumentality Project continues. Shinji must decide whether to accept a world alone, or embrace connections with others.

programme.title: Angel Attack - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — In the year 2015, an Angel returns to attack Tokyo-3. Misato Katsuragi transports Shinji to the NERV base overseen by his estranged father, Gendo.

programme.title: The Beast - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — After piloting the Eva Unit 01, Shinji wakes up in the hospital with no memory of the battle. Feeling sorry for him, Misato lets him move in with her.

programme.title: A Transfer - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Word gets around school that Shinji is the Eva pilot; his classmate Toji resents him for it. An Angel appears and Shinji must pilot in combat again.

programme.title: Hedgehog's Dilemma - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Stressed out following his last battle, Shinji runs away from home and meets Kensuke. After NERV brings him back in, Misato offers him a choice.

programme.title: Rei I - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Unit 00's pilot Rei Ayanami appears to have recovered, but she has no friends, no records of her past, and no interest in getting to know Shinji.

programme.title: Rei II - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — As the Fifth Angel drills toward NERV, Misato leads Operation Vashima: All of Japan's power will be diverted to take out Ramiel with a positron rifle.

programme.title: A Human Work - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-MA — Ritsuko tells Shinji about the classified true cause of the Second Imapct. Then she and Misato attend the field test for an Eva competitor mecha.

programme.title: Best of Friends - S03E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan has a real problem when his high school buddy comes to visit as a decidedly changed man.

programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan's life becomes a living hell as he tries to butter his new boss; a little person with a very nasty personality.

programme.title: Up on the Roof - S03E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry tries to free a rock star literally imprisoned by his overly solicitous entourage.

programme.title: The Night Off - S03E13

programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry throws a surprise birthday for Dan whose date is extremely anxious to be home by midnight.

programme.title: The Mugger - S03E17

programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry decides to help his idol, a down-and-out magician, who goes on to help himself to Harry's possessions.

programme.title: Monkey Business - S03E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Bull tries to save a baby orangutan from animal-research experiments.

programme.title: Flo's Retirement - S03E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — The staff tries everything they can think of to postpone Flo's mandatory retirement.

programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — The courtroom becomes a delivery room when Hurricane Mel traps four pregnant women.

programme.title: The Next Voice You Hear... - S04E01

programme.title: Giving Thanks - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan demands that Christine sleep with him after he saves her life with the Heimlich maneuver.

programme.title: Author, Author - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Bull tries his hand at writing a children's story; however, the results are a trifle strong for the editors he submits it to.

programme.title: Halloween II: The Return of Leon - S04E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry looks forward to seeing Leon again while Dan crawls for an invitation to his boss' Halloween party.

programme.title: Dan's Operation (1) - S04E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan refuses to admit his surgery has weakened him and he overexerts himself into a coma.

programme.title: Dan's Operation (2) - S04E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — After Dan falls into a coma, his friends maintain a bedside vigil and reminisce about the good times they've had.

programme.title: The New Judge - S04E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan makes a friend out of the judge substituting until he realizes the man is trying to bribe him, and his friends talk him into wearing a wire to entrap the man.

programme.title: Contempt of Courting - S04E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry returns and finds a lovely woman substituting on the bench for him, who likes him a lot and jails Christine for mouthing off about perceived mistreatment of a client.

programme.title: Earthquake - S04E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan and Roz are trapped in an elevator with two hungry sumo wrestlers just convicted in Harry's court.

programme.title: Prince of a Guy - S04E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry tries to prevent the forced marriage of a Polynesian princess while her brother auctions off Christine.

programme.title: New Year's Leave - S04E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry deals sympathetically with an escaped felon whose only wish is to spend New Year's Eve in Times Square to celebrate his 42nd wedding anniversary.

programme.title: Murder - S04E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry has to deal with a woman who confesses to him that she killed her husband that morning, a detective who can't get used to working without his partner and a morose Dan who was rejected as a sperm bank donor.

programme.title: Baby Talk - S04E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Mac goes on a drunken spree in a cowboy bar after Quon Le spends them into bankruptcy and then announces her pregnancy.

programme.title: The Modest Proposal - S04E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry is depressed and unhappy when Christine announces that she plans to marry a nice, dull guy.

programme.title: A Day in the Life - S04E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — NBC programming chief Brandon Tartikoff posts bail for a Neilsen family as the gang rushes to adjudicate 200 cases in one session.

programme.title: Rabid - S04E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry asks Dan to care for his new dog, who saved his life from a fire, but the mutt bites Dan and raises a rabies scare that could cost him his life.

programme.title: Christine's Friend - S04E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry's really depressed when Christine's old friend seems to prefer Dan as does his idol, Mel Torme.

programme.title: Caught Red Handed - S04E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry helps Christine fight sexual harassment from her boss and Dan comes on to a woman who has taken a vow of celibacy.

programme.title: Paternity - S04E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan is served with a paternity suit and Bull runs for union rep against a very tough lady.

programme.title: Here's to You, Mrs. Robinson - S04E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Quon Le plans to become a US citizen before her baby is born, but she and Mac are both rushed to the hospital with pains just as Harry begins the swearing-in ceremony.

programme.title: Her Honor (1) - S04E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan thinks he will become a new judge, but Christine is awarded the position. However, Harry discovers that his name is not on the judge reappointment list. Meanwhile the Wheelers, the hick couple from West Virginia, become the proprietors of the concession stand.

programme.title: Her Honor (2) - S04E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Upon learning that he will not be reappointed as a judge, Harry disappears to perform an outrageous stunt. But he doesn't realize that Christine, who has taken over the night court, has gotten his job back.

programme.title: Her Honor (3) - S05E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Christine nervously takes the bench as Dan and Mac try to cover for the newly reinstated Harry, who's planning the greatest gag of all time.

programme.title: Her Honor (4) - S05E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — While preparing to attempt his outrageous stunt, Harry talks to and saves the life of a suicidal man.

programme.title: Death of a Bailiff - S05E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Bull decides to give away all his worldly goods after hearing God's voice when he's struck by lightning on the roof of the courthouse.

programme.title: Ladies Night - S05E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Christine and Roz visit a male strip joint to do some female bonding, but Harry and the guys show up just as the show gets going.

programme.title: Safe - S05E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry traps himself inside a safe while practicing a magic trick and Dan is pursued by a little devil who seems to know all about him.

programme.title: Mac's Dilemma - S05E06

programme.title: Who Was That Mashed Man? - S05E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan's sadistic boss asks him to look out for his very attractive niece while Harry tries to prevent a TV hero of yesteryear from killing himself.

programme.title: No Hard Feelings - S05E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry hires a blind assistant whose abrasive sense of humor put everyone on edge and Dan struggles with impotence when her meets a seductive prospective employer.

programme.title: Constitution (1) - S05E09

programme.title: Constitution (2) - S05E10

programme.title: Let It Snow - S05E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — A blizzard traps everyone inside the courthouse and cancels holiday plans, including a visit from Bull's mother, the skipper of a garbage scow.

programme.title: I'm OK, You're Catatonic/Schizophrenic - S05E14

programme.title: Chrizzi's Honor - S05E15

programme.title: Another Day in the Life - S05E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Panic grips the courtroom as the gang races to clear 207 cases in one session so a millionaire will donate money to save an orphanage and so Dan can win an office pool for the most convictions.

programme.title: Heart of Stone - S05E17

programme.title: Russkie Business - S05E18

programme.title: Jung and the Restless - S05E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — The gang joins Roz in an encounter group she's required to attend to temper her hostile attitude at work, and they see a new side to their co-worker.

programme.title: Top Judge - S05E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Harry becomes uncharacteristically glum and morose after an elderly judge dies after one of Harry's pranks, so his friends urge him to respond when a new judge lays claim to Harry's crown as the "King of the Courtroom Cutups."

programme.title: Mac's Millions - S05E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Mac quits after inheriting $2 million from his grandfather, leaving his friends at the mercy of the most incompetent court clerk in New York.

programme.title: Danny Got His Gun (1) - S05E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Dan flip-flops on his active duty for the Army Reserve until he learns it will be in a tropical paradise with a beautiful lady officer.

programme.title: Danny Got His Gun (2) - S06E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1984 · TV-PG — Meanwhile, in the arctic rescue scenario, Dan accidentally fires a flare-gun at a small plane signalling to him; the pilot in the plane is injured (both hands broken) and thus cannot perform a critical operation. Because of that, Dan becomes the only person available who can operate on a young Eskimo woman suffering from appendicitis.

programme.title: Episode One - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Meet Jill (""mid 20's, widow, with a lust for life and a flexible spine""), a suburban hairdresser who sets her sights on a new life following her husband is diagnosed with cancer. Jill convinces everyone her husband Terry is dead, however he's alive and well in the hospital. But Jill doesn't care about that, she's got better things to do like joining the ""Lasso the Moon"" Matchmaking Agency where she's set-up on a rather peculiar blind-date with Glen who describes his personality as ""Scottish"". Next on the agenda is the â€˜Fun and Fellowship' group at the local village hall where she meets her new neighbour and the man of her dreams - Dr. Don Cole. Jill firmly sets her sights on the dishy GP, but there's just a slight problem - he's married to wheelchair-bound Cath. Undeterred by this small obstacle, Jill infiltrates their livesâ€¦and refuses leave.

programme.title: Episode Two - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill descends further into Cath and Don's lives by inviting Don around for a dinner of smashed prawns in a milky basket. However her plans are thwarted when Cath turns up for dinner too. Meanwhile, husband Terry continues his attempts to get in touch, but Jill still refuses to speak to him.

programme.title: Episode Three - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill convinces Cath to try to heal her marriage with the Caro Bibbens Celebrating Celibacy programme. Don becomes increasingly frustrated and is eventually thrown out of the house by Cath after she finds a pair of lacy split pants in his pocket.

programme.title: Episode Four - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Don attempts a reconciliation with Cath but Jill is now firmly established in their home and has no intention of allowing the two to make up. Meanwhile, Terry is released from the hospital and Jill puts him straight into a hospice where he assumes he'll spend the last days of his life.

programme.title: Episode Five - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Cath finally stands up to Jill and throws her out of the house and reveals some interesting news to Jill. Jill goes ahead with Terry's funeral, inviting Cath & Don, however there is one guest Jill did not expect.

programme.title: Episode Six - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Don and Cathy split up. Jill kills Terry, then forces Glenn to kill Gordon the vicar with a poisoned sundae and makes him confess to the police. Then she tells them him they can start a new life- well death together. He eats one of the other poisoned desserts, then gives it to her, saying it's her turn. She tells him she's not really hungry and watches him die. Terry turns out to be alive after all.

programme.title: Episode One - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill is picking up the pieces of her life after the murders at the end of the last series. She has managed to frame ex-boyfriend Glen for them.

programme.title: Episode Two - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill and Linda drive down to Cornwall as Jill goes in search of Cath and Don. On the way, Jill runs over a black woman and discovers that she was going to a job interview at The Trees, the therapy centre where Cath and Don are. Jill decides to take her place at the interview, despite the obvious difference in appearance.

programme.title: Episode Three - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill arranges an encounter with Don's girlfriend in an attempt to discourage her, while Cath pursues a relationship with her therapist.

programme.title: Episode Four - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill is still pursuing Don, even after finding out that Cathy is pregnant with Don's child, but her attempt to seduce Don is unsuccessful, so she seduces his 12-year-old son instead.

programme.title: Episode Five - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill decides that the only way left to infiltrate herself into the Cole household is to emulate Cath's pregnancy, and announces that 12-year-old Bruce is the father. Don responds by going into a persistent state of drunkenness.

programme.title: Episode Six - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill's lies are finally catching up with her. The man she framed for her husband's murder, Glen Bulb, escapes from the mental hospital. And Cath is becoming suspicious of Jill's "pregnancy", which is now entering its 11th month.

programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill convinces Cath to try to heal her marriage with the Caro Bibbens Celebrating Celibacy programme. Don becomes increasingly frustrated and is eventually thrown out of the house by Cath after she finds a pair of lacy split pants in his pocket.

programme.title: Episode Four - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Don attempts a reconciliation with Cath but Jill is now firmly established in their home and has no intention of allowing the two to make up. programme.title: Episode Five - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Cath finally stands up to Jill and throws her out of the house and reveals some interesting news to Jill. Jill goes ahead with Terry's funeral, inviting Cath & Don, however there is one guest Jill did not expect.

programme.title: Episode Six - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Don and Cathy split up. Jill kills Terry, then forces Glenn to kill Gordon the vicar with a poisoned sundae and makes him confess to the police. programme.title: Episode One - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill is picking up the pieces of her life after the murders at the end of the last series. She has managed to frame ex-boyfriend Glen for them.

programme.title: Episode Two - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill and Linda drive down to Cornwall as Jill goes in search of Cath and Don. Jill decides to take her place at the interview, despite the obvious difference in appearance.

programme.title: Episode Three - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill arranges an encounter with Don's girlfriend in an attempt to discourage her, while Cath pursues a relationship with her therapist.

programme.title: Episode Four - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill is still pursuing Don, even after finding out that Cathy is pregnant with Don's child, but her attempt to seduce Don is unsuccessful, so she seduces his 12-year-old son instead.

programme.title: Episode Five - S02E05

programme.title: Episode Six - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Jill's lies are finally catching up with her. The man she framed for her husband's murder, Glen Bulb, escapes from the mental hospital. And Cath is becoming suspicious of Jill's "pregnancy", which is now entering its 11th month.

programme.title: Episode One - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-MA — Meet Jill (""mid 20's, widow, with a lust for life and a flexible spine""), a suburban hairdresser who sets her sights on a new life following her husband is diagnosed with cancer. programme.title: Grandmaster - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The game Clamy challenged them to wasn't normal chess. Shiro is a chess master, but even she is helpless against Clami's assault. But when Shiro understands the real rules of the game, things begind to turn around. The battle to determine the king of Elukia, and all of humanity, finally reaches its end.

programme.title: Weak Square - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sora and Shiro leave the running of the country to Steph and spend every day playing video games. Steph's hope that they would become not only the saviors of Elukia, but all of humanity, crumbles away.

programme.title: Interesting - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The siblings confront Jibril, a member of the Flügel race to reclaim the royal library in a game of Shiritori.

programme.title: Sacrifice - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Intending to challenge the Werebeasts, the siblings discover that it's hard to come with a strategy to defeat the latter, as all memories regarding the games are erased from their challengers, until Stephanie entrusts Sora a key left by the former king, leading to his secret research on how to outwit them.

programme.title: Fake End - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The siblings pay a visit to the Werebeasts' embassy in Elkia, and expose the tricks that they use to outwit their opponents. Sora bets all of Imanity's remaining territory, along with the lives of all its citizens in an all-or-nothing game against the Werebeasts. However, while awaiting an answer from them, Sora mysteriously disappears without a trace, and Shiro realizes that she is the only one who remembers him.

programme.title: Sky Walk - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — While figuring out the truth about her brother's disappearance, Shiro remembers that Sora is having a high-stakes game of Othello with Clammy in which they are betting their own existence and memories. With Sora in a dire position and unable to continue the game, Shiro assumes his place according to the game's rules and wins. With this, the siblings not only earn Clammy's allegiance and the support of her Elf partner, Feel Nilvalen, but by sharing his memories with her, Sora finally wins her trust.

programme.title: Blue Rose - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After finishing their preparations, the time has come for Sora and Shiro to challenge the Werebeasts with the destiny of all Imanity at stake, accompained by Jibril and Steph. But just when the game begins, the siblings fall into despair when they see themselves in a city that resembles their own homeland and the traumas of their past come to surface.

programme.title: Killing Giant - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Having regained their composure, Sora and Shiro confront Izuna with Jibril's help but soon realize that the game is rigged to the point that winning is almost impossible. All hope seems lost when Shiro is apparently put on enemy control, until Izuna realizes that she is actually falling on a trap by the siblings, and enjoying the game for the first time in her life, she finally decides to go all out against them.

programme.title: Rule Number 10 - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sora and Shiro are driven into a corner by Izuna's activated Blood Destruction, but just when Izuna thinks she's won the game, she falls into yet another of their traps and is defeated. Some time later, the siblings are summoned by the leader of the Werebeasts, the Shrine Priestess, who wants a rematch against them for the sake of her people, but the challenge "unexpectedly" ends in a draw. She is convinced into joining forces and establishing the Elkia Federation by merging the Imanity and Werebeast territories into a single nation. While making preparations for their next battles, Sora and Shiro renew their conviction to unite all the races of Disboard under their rule, and one day challenge Tet for his title of "One True God".

programme.title: Beginner - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sora and Shiro are unemployed and never leave their house, but on the net, they're known as "Blank", an invincible team of gamers. One day, these siblings are visited by a boy named Tet, who calls himself god. Tet summons them to a world where all war is banned, and everything is decided by games.

programme.title: Challenger - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sora and Shiro have been abandoned in another world by Tet. In this world all war is forbidden, and everything is determined by games whose rules are determined by the "Ten Pledges" that Tet established. They find themselves in the country of humanity, the weakest of the 16 races in this new world.

programme.title: Expert - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — A girl named Clamy has won the right to be the next king of Elukia by her overwhelming good luck. Steph lost to her and loses the chance to become the next ruler. Just as she defeats the last challenger, however, Sora and Shiro interrupt her.

programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Having regained their composure, Sora and Shiro confront Izuna with Jibril's help but soon realize that the game is rigged to the point that winning is almost impossible. All hope seems lost when Shiro is apparently put on enemy control, until Izuna realizes that she is actually falling on a trap by the siblings, and enjoying the game for the first time in her life, she finally decides to go all out against them.

programme.title: Rule Number 10 - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sora and Shiro are driven into a corner by Izuna's activated Blood Destruction, but just when Izuna thinks she's won the game, she falls into yet another of their traps and is defeated. Some time later, the siblings are summoned by the leader of the Werebeasts, the Shrine Priestess, who wants a rematch against them for the sake of her people, but the challenge "unexpectedly" ends in a draw. She is convinced into joining forces and establishing the Elkia Federation by merging the Imanity and Werebeast territories into a single nation. While making preparations for their next battles, Sora and Shiro renew their conviction to unite all the races of Disboard under their rule, and one day challenge Tet for his title of "One True God".

programme.title: Grandmaster - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The game Clamy challenged them to wasn't normal chess. Shiro is a chess master, but even she is helpless against Clami's assault. But when Shiro understands the real rules of the game, things begind to turn around. The battle to determine the king of Elukia, and all of humanity, finally reaches its end.

programme.title: Weak Square - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Sora and Shiro leave the running of the country to Steph and spend every day playing video games. Steph's hope that they would become not only the saviors of Elukia, but all of humanity, crumbles away.

programme.title: Interesting - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The siblings confront Jibril, a member of the Flügel race to reclaim the royal library in a game of Shiritori.

programme.title: Sacrifice - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Intending to challenge the Werebeasts, the siblings discover that it's hard to come with a strategy to defeat the latter, as all memories regarding the games are erased from their challengers, until Stephanie entrusts Sora a key left by the former king, leading to his secret research on how to outwit them.

programme.title: Fake End - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The siblings pay a visit to the Werebeasts' embassy in Elkia, and expose the tricks that they use to outwit their opponents. Sora bets all of Imanity's remaining territory, along with the lives of all its citizens in an all-or-nothing game against the Werebeasts. However, while awaiting an answer from them, Sora mysteriously disappears without a trace, and Shiro realizes that she is the only one who remembers him.

programme.title: Sky Walk - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — While figuring out the truth about her brother's disappearance, Shiro remembers that Sora is having a high-stakes game of Othello with Clammy in which they are betting their own existence and memories. With Sora in a dire position and unable to continue the game, Shiro assumes his place according to the game's rules and wins. With this, the siblings not only earn Clammy's allegiance and the support of her Elf partner, Feel Nilvalen, but by sharing his memories with her, Sora finally wins her trust.

programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The siblings confront Jibril, a member of the Flügel race to reclaim the royal library in a game of Shiritori.

programme.title: A Housecat, a Stray God, and a Tail - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — A god named Yato answers a five-yen prayer to defeat a phantom that has appeared above a school using his Regalia, Tomone. Shortly after the battle, however, Tomone decides she is fed up with Yato and requests to have his contract with him terminated. Now without a Regalia, Yato takes up a new request to find a missing cat named Milord. Whilst he is doing that, a girl named Hiyori Iki spots him walking into the path of an oncoming bus and dives into to save him. She pushes him out of the road but is hit by the bus herself, and afterwards finds her spirit separated from her body, although she is able to return to it safely. Whilst recovering in hospital, Hiyori hears strange voices before having another encounter with Yato, who formerly introduces himself as a god. Some time later, Yato finds Milord but is attacked by the phantom. After Hiyori helps Yato escape, she learns that the incident from before has resulted in her becoming a half-phantom lying between the worlds of the living and the dead, causing her spirit, which has a cat's tail, to sometimes leave her body. After learning of the situation, Hiyori gives Yato five yen as a fee in order to help her get back to normal.

programme.title: Snow-like - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — As Hiyori ends up drifting out of her body more often than not, she takes advantage of her new agile form. Despite being reminded by Hiyori about the job she paid him for, Yato insists that he can't do anything until he gets a new Regalia. Assuming a Regalia could be made from any phantom, Hiyori goes in search of one, only for it to turn out to be a really hostile one. Hiyori attempts to fight the phantom herself but is stopped by Yato, who is injured in the process. After retreating to treat his 'blight' wound, which can spread if left untreated, Yato explains that Hiyori's tail is what connects her to her physical form, and if it is cut, she will die. The phantom returns, and Yato spots an uncorrupted spirit and claims it as his new Regalia, which takes the form of a white katana, allowing Yato to defeat the phantom. Yato afterwards decides to name his Regalia Yukine, which transforms into the form a teenage human boy.

programme.title: Bidden Calamity - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — As Yukine tries to adjust to his role as Yato's Regalia, he is scolded by Yato over allegedly having dirty thoughts about Hiyori, explaining that they share the same mind and body. Later, the three are summoned by the God of Learning, Lord Tenjin, who has taken on Tomone, now named Mayu, as one of his new Regalia. Tenjin commissions Yato to take care of some phantoms that have appeared near a railway track. Whilst fighting the phantoms, the three encounter a 'storm', which Yato and Yukine manage to destroy before it compels a schoolboy to walk into the path of a train.

programme.title: Where Happiness Lies - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yato takes Hiyori and Yukine to meet a fellow god named Kofuku, and her Regalia, Daikoku. In the middle of their talk, Yato is summoned by a suicidal office worker named Usuke Urasawa, whom he accidentally knocks off the top of a building in the process. On the way down, Usuke explains how his luck and fortune went downhill in pursuit of love for a girl, who turns out to be Kofuku, revealed to be a Binbougami (God of Poverty) who causes bad luck and misfortune to those around her. Yato manages to use Yukine to sever Usuke's ties and memories to Kofuku, before ensuring he lands safely. After Yato collects his payment, Kofuku tells Hiyori that Yato had once killed before. Later, as Yato tells Hiyori to go to Kofuku and Daikoku should anything happen to him, Yukine encounters a strange woman, who is revealed to be Nora--Yato's former Regalia.

programme.title: Borderline - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After Yato teaches Yukine how to make a borderline, which regalia can use against phantoms, Hiyori decides to have Yukine live in her house, feeling Yato can't look after him properly. After some reluctance, Yato agrees to let Yukine stay with her. Yato ends up sneaking himself too, keeping Yukine in check before he gets any ideas about Hiyori. The next day, Yukine runs away after Hiyori stops him from stealing a skateboard, with Yato later explaining to her that any impure thoughts Yukine has results in pain for himself. Whilst running away, Yukine encounters a little girl, which he later learns to be the spirit of a girl who died in a traffic accident. However, the girl ends up getting possessed by a phantom and becomes consumed by it, forcing Yato to use Yukine to defeat her against his will .

programme.title: Scary Person - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yukine, depressed about being used by Yato to kill the girl spirit instead of saving her, steals the skateboard he had his eye on before. When Yato stops him, Hiyori appears, deciding to cover for Yukine by claiming she bought it for him. Just then, a god named Bishamon, holding a personal grudge against him, appears and attacks Yato. Hiyori calls Kofuku and Daikoku to help, tracking Yato's location using her sense of smell. However, Kofuku's attempt to stop the battle ends up making things worse by causing a huge hole with raging storms appear. Bishamon tries to take advantage of the situation, dealing some damage to Yato, but is urged by one of her regalia, Kazuma, to retreat to protect her other regalia.

programme.title: Uncertainty & Destiny - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Hiyori's presence as a spirit is discovered by Kazuma, who chooses to keep this a secret from Bishamon, before telling Hiyori that if nothing is done about Yukine, Yato will die. Later that night, as Yato is helping out at a convenience store, Yukine, who has been feeling that Yato would choose Nora over him, is caught trying to steal some charity money. Just then, another phantom appears, and despite Nora's presence causing Yukine unease, Yato assures him that he is his regalia and manages to defeat the phantom with him.

programme.title: Over the Line - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yato and Yukine are called to Hiyori's school at the request of a bullied student, with Yato giving him a certain something to use. Whilst at the school, Yukine laments that he never had the chance to go to high school himself and make friends with others. The student is driven by a phantom to confront the bully using a knife Yato had given him, but he manages to hold himself back and disperse the phantom with his own will. Yukine, however, gives into his frustration and starts breaking the school's windows, causing Yato's blight to spread further. As Hiyori discovers this, she risks herself to try and bring him to Kofuku and Daikoku, getting blighted herself in the process. Kofuku and Daikoku shut them out with a borderline.

programme.title: Name - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Daikoku and Kofuku only allow Hiyori to come through the borderline so she can cleanse her blight, stating that Yato will die unless Yukine receives punishment by ablution. Although Daikoku manages to enlist the help of Mayu, he struggles to find a third Regalia to help perform the ablution. Rejecting the thought of calling on Nora, as she might kill Yukine, Hiyori goes to Bishamon's shrine to request Kazuma's help. As the three Regalias get together, they discover Yukine's back is covered with phantoms and begin their ablution, in which Yukine must endure pain until he confesses to his sins, or otherwise transform into a phantom himself. Yukine admits his crimes and expresses his jealousy of the living and his envy of what they have. As Yukine's condition worsens, Hiyori and Yato calls out to him, reminding him that they are his friends, and the name Yato gave him is that of a person's. Hearing this, Yukine apologises for all the bad things he had done, allowing the ablution to be successfully carried out. With both Yato and Yukine back to normal, they both feel thankful towards Hiyori for saving their lives. Meanwhile, Nora has awakened a spirit named Rabo, who has a grudge against Yato.

programme.title: Regarded with Hate - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — As Yukine takes up a part time job at Daikoku's food stand to help repay what he stole, he and Hiyori hear from Miyu about how Tenjin banished one of his regalias for stinging him with blight. Meanwhile, Tenjin informs Yato, who finally contemplates fulfilling Hiyori's request, that he may be able to fix her problem if he cuts his ties with her. On New Year's Day, as Yato and Yukine fight a group of phantoms, Hiyori, who was on a shrine visit with her friends, is lured out by Nora, who sends her own phantoms to chase after her. As Hiyori is saved as the phantoms are dissolved by dawn's sunlight, Nora informs her about Rabo and his desire to kill Yato, telling her to stop existing. After Yato and Yukine manage to defeat all the phantoms, they catch up to Hiyori, only to find she has no memory of who Yato is.

programme.title: Abandoned God - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — As Yato and Yukine try to figure out how to restore Hiyori's memories, they are confronted by Nora, who reveals she had stolen Hiyori's memory of Yato and has become Furuhime, regalia of Rabo, who attacks Yato in an attempt to awaken some repressed memories. As Yato finds himself unable to beat Rabo and Furuhime, the two take their leave, with Furuhime stating she will return Hiyori's memory if Yato can defeat Rabo. It is revealed that Rabo is a calamity god, a god who answers malicious wishes to kill people, phantoms, and gods, who once worked alongside Yato, who was also a calamity god himself. As Yato becomes conflicted over whether restoring Hiyori's memory is the right thing to do, Yukine shows Hiyori a picture book detailing the times they have spent together. Meanwhile, Furuhime reveals that Hiyori's memory is further waning, shown when she loses her memory of Yukine, and will leave her as an empty vessel if nothing is done. Despite knowing the risks involved, Yato and Yukine resolve to restore Hiyori's memory.

programme.title: A Scrap of a Memory - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yato and Yukine warp over to Rabo's shrine, mistakenly dragging Hiyori along with them. Yato immediately engages Rabo and Furuhime, only to be easily fended off and taken prisoner by a spell of Rabo's which enshrouds the victim in a sphere of water. Hiyori manages to pull Yato out, allowing the fight to resume. Unsatisfied with Yato's performance, Rabo decides to destroy the jewel-like sphere containing Hiyori's stolen memories, causing her to fall unconscious. Angered by this, Yato appears to awaken to his former self as a god of calamity, and easily kicks Rabo into the stone cliff surrounding the site. Having seen that Yato had returned to his old self, Rabo absorbs the storm which had been raging from above, thus merging with its phantoms. An exchange between the two causes boulders to loosen, one of which heads directly for Hiyori. Yato saves her just in time, and holds her tightly to his body in a protective gesture. Hiyori's memories are awakened by his scent, and she returns to consciousness. Realizing he has to get rid of Hiyori, Rabo takes hold of her, but is finished off by Yato and Yukine with a move used for cleansing phantoms. As the three make their way back home, Hiyori tells Yato and Yukine that she never wants to sever her ties with them.

programme.title: Bearing a Posthumous Name - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yato continues his daily routine as a delivery god who also slays Phantoms when the need arises. Elsewhere, Bishamon is plagued by nightmares from times long past…

programme.title: One of Her Memories - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yukine makes a new friend, but soon learns what it means to be a Regalia. Kazuma remains confused by Bishamon's declining health… until he makes a shocking discovery!

programme.title: False Bond - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Kugaha finally sets his plot into motion and has Kazuma banished. The ensuing chaos causes more pain for Bishamon… and pulls Yukine and Yato into the turmoil too!

programme.title: Wish - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Kazuma and Hiyori find themselves captured. They watch helplessly as Kugaha tricks Yato and Bishamon into battling each other to the death!

programme.title: Divine Acclamation, Imprecation - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yukine shatters in half while Yato and Bishamon battle each other! Elsewhere, Kugaha enacts the second part of his plan by slaughtering Bishamon's Regalias!

programme.title: What Must Be Done - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Bishamon and Yato learn of Kugaha's betrayal, but most of the damage has already been done. Meanwhile, the giant, masked Phantom continues to hunt down the last remaining Regalias…

programme.title: How to Worship a God - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Bishamon is forced to confer with the other gods about her recent failings. Elsewhere, Ebisu offers to buy Yukine from Yato for a large sum of money - enough for Yato to build his own shrine.

programme.title: God of Calamity - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — After Kugaha's defeat, Ebisu decides to conduct certain, secret tests. Meanwhile, Yato reaches new highs and new lows after Hiyori gives him his own shrine…

programme.title: The Sound of a Thread Snapping - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Yato and Nora head into the underworld to complete one last job together: find and rescue a certain conjurer. But with each passing moment, Hiyori begins to forget Yato…

programme.title: A Certain Desire - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The heavens are thrown into chaos when the gods learn that Ebisu has been experimenting with Phantoms. Meanwhile, Yato and Ebisu struggle to escape Izanami and leave the underworld behind.

programme.title: Revival - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Bishamon and Hiyori manage to track down Yato, but they have no way of getting into the underworld. Meanwhile, Izanami continues to pursue Yato… And if he gets caught, he'll be stuck in the underworld forever!

programme.title: Your Voice Calls Out - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — Bishamon faces Izanami in battle in order to save Yato. Yato's only hope for escape lies in his true name, but he's never revealed it to anyone. Meanwhile, the heavenly executioners have caught up with Ebisu and are prepared to kill him!

programme.title: The God of Fortune's Message - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2014 · TV-14 — The heavens deliver their divine punishment, and Ebisu is forced to start anew. Despite this, Yato is filled with a new sense of purpose and upholds his promise to Ebisu.
