programme.title: The Break Up - S08E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn, Gus and Juliet handle one last case in the series finale.

programme.title: Pilot - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — When Shawn Spencer is arrested for calling in an accurate tip to the police because only the perpetrator would know the details, his only way out is pretending to be a psychic. It turns out Santa Barbara PD isn't done with him. They ask him to consult on a kidnapping case, and a business is born.

programme.title: The Spellingg Bee - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — When what begins as a little competitive sabotage in a regional spelling bee quickly escalates to murder. Shawn and Gus must investigate the mysterious death of the "Spellmaster" at the regional Spelling Bee.

programme.title: Speak Now or Forever Hold Your Piece - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus become wedding crashers at a posh ceremony in order to retrieve a stolen antique engagement ring inexplicably taken from an inpenetrable vault under surveillance. And theft turns to murder when things start to come unraveled.

programme.title: Woman Seeking Dead Husband - Smokers Okay, No Pets - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus land their first non-SBPD case when a widow hires them to find some cash that her husband stole from a bank. Shawn is asked to talk to a spirit and help the widow of the thief.

programme.title: 9 Lives - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn claims a psychic connection with a cat so he can continue his investigation into a what he believes is a murder, but that the police have labeled a suicide, and the link he finds to a hotline may involve one of SBPD's own officers.

programme.title: Weekend Warriors - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus attend a Civil War reenactment rehearsal for the sheer pleasure of watching Lassiter have a nervous breakdown as he runs it, but when a scripted death turns real they end up donning uniforms themselves in order to find the murderer and perhaps prevent another.

programme.title: Who Ya Gonna Call? - S01E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn reluctantly settles for a private client who claims a ghost has it in for him after Lassiter kicks Gus and him off the much more interesting case of a murdered psychologist, but the two investigations seem to be running parallel and Shawn may still end up solving the police's case.

programme.title: Shawn vs. The Red Phantom - S01E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Gus is ecstatic when it turns out the only real clue in his and Shawn's missing-person case is TriCon, the comic book and science fiction convention currently running in Santa Barbara. As bodies start turning up, they must balance their newly-scammed and increasingly onerous duties as George Takei's assistants with finding the killer and saving the teenager.

programme.title: Forget Me Not - S01E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Henry's old captain believes he's solved a murder, but his Alzheimer's has caused him to forget the most important details: the crime, and who committed it. Henry calls in Shawn and Gus who find themselves investigating a murder that happened decades ago and only the faulty memory of the retired officer gives them any hope of closing the case.

programme.title: From the Earth to Starbucks - S01E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — When Lassiter doubts his own crime-solving ability, Shawn tries to boost his confidence by helping him solve an astronomer's mysterious death.

programme.title: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not, He Loves Me, Oops He's Dead - S01E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — The duo's latest case, a gag from Lassiter, turns from an alien abduction investigation to a murder case with the discovery of naked body. Between tanning salons, speed dating and Henry disagreeing with their prime suspects, it's possible Lassiter will solve the case before Shawn and Gus can.

programme.title: Cloudy...With A Chance Of Murder - S01E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — A local weatherman is found dead the morning after a tryst and his lover is charged with his murder despite her claims of innocence. Shawn is intrigued and becomes a defense consultant in order to gain access to the case.

programme.title: Game Set... Muuurder? - S01E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Lonely and bored, Shawn convinces Juliet to give him a shot with a case involving a missing tennis star, but first he has to spring an unwilling Gus from a corporate retreat.

programme.title: Poker? I Barely Know Her - S01E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Henry's friend refuses to report his son, Brandon, missing after the son steals 30,000 dollars. Shawn agrees to help locate the son, and finds out that Brandon has been involved in some underground poker. Meanwhile, O'hara tries to surprise Lassiter on his birthday.

programme.title: Scary Sherry: Bianca's Toast - S01E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Juliet asks Shawn and Gus for assistance on her undercover assignment. They're only too glad to help, since it involves sorority sisters. Unfortunately, what's supposed to be an easy case turns out to have ties to their past and may endanger Juliet. Meanwhile, Lassiter locks horns with the oldest rookie the departments has ever trained.

programme.title: American Duos - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus go undercover as talent show contestants to investigate a number of failed attempts to kill one of the judges.

programme.title: 65 Million Years Off - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — The discovery of a washed-up body sparks a debate between Shawn and the police, who both disagree as to how the man died. While Shawn believes that the man was killed by a Tyrannosaurus Rex, the police believe the killer is a little less... extinct.

programme.title: Psy vs. Psy - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — The FBI employs their own psychic in a search for a counterfeiter, causing the department to work together in an effort to prove that Shawn is the better psychic.

programme.title: Zero to Murder in Sixty Seconds - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn tracks down Lassiter's car with little difficulty after it's stolen. However, Shawn discovers that there's more to the situation than meets the eye and calls Gus back from vacation to help with the investigation.

programme.title: And Down the Stretch Comes Murder - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Gus and Shawn's childhood nemesis, now a horse jockey, asks the duo for help in discovering why his horses never win. But the investigation develops into a murder case after a jockey dies while racing.

programme.title: Meat Is Murder, But Murder Is Also Murder - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus are put on the case when a food critic is murdered. However, Gus' Uncle Burton is in town, and due to a misunderstanding, Gus must pretend to be the psychic detective to avoid disappointing his family.

programme.title: If You're So Smart, Then Why Are You Dead? - S02E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus take on academia as lecturers at a school for the gifted where two students suspect a teacher of murder, they just don't know who's been murdered or the murderer's identity. At the precinct, Juliet lobbies hard for lead position on the next case, and Lassiter hands her a "gimme". The same case Gus and Shawn are working.

programme.title: Rob-a-Bye Baby - S02E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus want to be put on Lassiter's burglary case, but a sleep-deprived Chief Vick orders them to find her a nanny instead. Unfortunately, at least from Lassiter's view, the two teams keep crossing paths, and Shawn sees an opportunity to horn in on the more interesting case.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters! - S02E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn and Gus find themselves trying to outwit a bounty hunter when Juliet asks them to find a suspect who escaped from her custody. The problem is, once they find him, Shawn believes his claims of innocence, meaning they not only have to capture him, but prove he's been set up.

programme.title: Gus' Dad May Have Killed An Old Guy! - S02E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Christmas with the Gusters is ruined when Gus' parents' neighbor is killed, a clue leads Lassiter to look at Mr. Guster more closely. Evidence leads the police into arresting Gus' mother too, and Shawn and Gus vow to get them out of jail.

programme.title: There's Something About Mira - S02E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — Shawn is shocked when he learns that Gus is married after Gus' wife unexpectedly shows up. She asks the men to take on a missing-persons case.

programme.title: The Old and the Restless - S02E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — A missing persons case from a posh retirement community turns into a family affair when Shawn and Gus must team up with Henry to solve the case.

programme.title: Lights, Camera... Homicidio - S02E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2006 · TV-PG — The star of a Spanish telenovela has been murdered by another actor on the show. The murderer insists that it was an accident and claims that the prop knife was switched with a real knife without his knowledge. Shawn and Gus believe that he was framed and investigate the crime. Finally they catch up with the car in a parking lot, where Ashton is there to let her know that she's just been Punk'd.

So, these kids (led by Field Agent Rob Pinkston) ask Zach and Donald for some beer at the store. When they blow the kids off, the kids spray paint Zach's car all up and down with graffiti. Zach comes back and catches the kids red-handed. A big argument ensues and Zach is ready to press charges or kill the kid, whichever happens first. Finally Ashton arrives to pull the plug on the situation.

He eventually abandons the car and hops in a taxi, driven by Field Agent Chris. When he goes the wrong way, Jadakiss hops out and starts heading down the street on foot. Chris follows him to tell him that he's just been Punk'd.
Segment 2: Rachel Bilson's dog is being blamed for the tipping of a mail delivery truck and the breaking of a water main. The police officer lets her know that she's going to be in a lot of trouble because of what her dog did. The water company and everybody on the scene are giving poor Rachel a hard time about all the damage. Finally Ashton arrives on the scene to let Rachel off the hook.
Segment 3: Rob Pinkston playing a fan comes up to Dirk asking him to sign a shirt, which he gladly does. But the kid comes back with a jersey, a pennant, a poster, some hats, a ball, a weight training belt and all kinds of stuff, which still he does. The items keep coming, and Dirk's patience is being pushed now. His friends that he's eating with are trying to encourage him to step up and say no. When the kid comes back with a second bag FULL of stuff, he says no, and the Maitre D comes by to tell them that they're not to visit the restaurant again. Finally, the kid comes back with one final item, a menu that reads, "Hey Dirk, you've been PUNK'D."

After some dialogue between A.J., the manager and Jamie-Lynn, they leave the restaurant, when the bomb was dropped that it was all a sham.
Segment #2: Andy Roddick has to get to The Tonight Show and the driver, Chris, decides to take a shortcut. They hit a roadblock that is set up because of the problem of mudslides (which has actually been a real problem due to the serious weather conditions this winter). They get into a real problem when they cannot go further but they cannot go back. The driver gets "smart" and tries to drive through anyway. The car is sprayed with water coming from no-one-knows-where, and the mud just makes the road impassable and the car is stuck. When the police arrive, an argument breaks out and suddenly Andy is blamed for the whole thing. The police make him sit there in this no-pass zone, intending to keep him there until 4pm. Finally the Punk'd camera crew arrive to let him off the hook.

Omarion insists that there's no baby and she's making it up. After a while, her ex-boyfriend shows up and he looks angry. He wants to know whose baby it is. He insists that heads are gonna roll, but Marques keeps it pretty cool. Finally the Punk'd crew shows up to slow the roll.

programme.title: Smell of Success - S01E07

programme.title: Corpsicle - S01E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-PG — Chuck learns the most shocking secret of her life and refuses to forgive Ned. programme.title: Circus Circus - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-PG — Georgeann Heaps hires Emerson to find her missing daughter, and the trail leads to a circus. Meanwhile Ned and Chuck try to deal with the change in their relationship, and Olive considers staying longer at the nunnery.

programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — It didn’t matter if Timmy (Thomas Robinson) was naughty or nice. This year, he gets one Christmas present that turns out to be a dangerous gremlin-like monster.

programme.title: The Dead Body - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A friendship made between a bullied boy and a mysterious new kid at school leads to school pranks that threaten to get out of hand.

programme.title: Nightmare Inn - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When a young girl loses her father, she is forced to face her fears and move to a terrifying hotel where the staff have mysterious secrets.

programme.title: The Red Dress - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When a teenage girl is faced with a moral dilemma she learns that everything that can be had has a price.

programme.title: Ghostly Stare - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Lauren (Emma Grabinsky) and Mark (Jason Spevack) learn that when cemeteries are disturbed, not everything stays buried.

programme.title: Walls - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A family moves into a new home, but the son soon discovers there is something wrong within the walls.

programme.title: Game Over - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Kelly "Kell-razer" (Calum Worthy) and his friend Gooch (AJ Lutsky) receive a mysteriously new game called "Zee Town" that they got from a stranger, named the Game Master (voiced by David Sobolov). However, it turns out this game is actually real.

programme.title: Alien Candy - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A sixth grader who believes in extraterrestrials is approached by two eighth graders who invite him to join a special club.

programme.title: Fear Never Knocks - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Siblings sneak into Grandpa's office to play with a mysterious old recorder. They record their worst fears and play them back. They will soon regret this decision.

programme.title: Best Friend Forever - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — 12 year old Jack Pierce performs an experiment at home, and finds himself saddled with a new best friend: Cheeky the Zombie.

programme.title: Black Mask - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Three friends find a mysterious mask that allows a glimpse into another time where they see a horrible accident they desperately try to prevent.

programme.title: Afraid Of Clowns - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Christopher is deathly afraid of clowns... are they really trying to get him or will he finally outgrow this childhood horror?

programme.title: My Sister the Witch - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Alice comes home from boarding school acting strange. Pete, her brother, suspects that she is a witch. He does everything he can to thwart her attempts to practice her craft.

programme.title: Wrong Number - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — The two meanest girls at school prank call someone who turns out to be even meaner than they are.

programme.title: Catching Cold - S01E17
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A boy becomes obsessed with catching a mysterious ice cream truck that seems to haunt his neighborhood.

programme.title: Pool Shark - S01E18
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Can a handsome boy overcome his fear of the water and convince people there is a shark in the pool?

programme.title: Lights Out - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Three kids decide the ghost hunter show they watch is lame. Filming inside the local mental hospital that closed 60 years ago should provide them with some interesting footage... but will it ever be seen?

programme.title: The Perfect Brother - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Matt's brother Josh is perfect, maybe just a little too perfect.

programme.title: Scary Mary (Part 1) - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Three friends dare to find out if the myth of a dead girl who can reach through the mirror to "take your face" is really true.

programme.title: Scary Mary (Part 2) - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — While in Scary Mary's world, Hanna refuses to be like everyone else, who have given their faces to Mary.

programme.title: Creature Feature (Part 1) - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A classic film lover named John (Joel Courtney) gets sucked into a 1950s B-movie called I Was A Teenage Tick Monster playing at a haunted drive-in.

programme.title: Creature Feature (Part 2) - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Nathan and Lisa get sucked inside the B-movie to rescue John and stop the evil Dr. Mangle from releasing his creation on the world.

programme.title: Swarmin' Norman - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A bullied boy named Norman discovers that he has god-like power over insects and uses them to get revenge on his tormentors – only to discover (the hard way) that absolute power corrupts absolutely.

programme.title: Flight - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A boy named Josh on his first flight learns that the Grim Reaper (posing as an old woman) is a fellow passenger and an undead man only the boy can see is trying to escape her.

programme.title: Pumpkinhead - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A girl and her brothers investigate a pumpkin patch said to be tended to by a murderous farmer who kidnaps children and switches their heads with the pumpkins in his gardens.

programme.title: Brush with Madness - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When comic book geek Corey gets yelled at by his favorite artist Allan Miller (Mackenzie Gray) during a comic book convention, Corey steals Allan's brushes and comes up with his own creation – only to learn that Allan's brushes have the power to turn fantasy into reality.

programme.title: Sick - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Alex has to stay home from school, thanks to a bad cold – and soon finds that he's not alone in the house. To make matters worse, two morning news show anchors begin talking to him from the television, warning him that his mom and the government are out to kill him for being ill (along with the monster in the house that may have sickened the boy to start with). Is Alex really in danger or is this all a fever dream?

programme.title: Mascot - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Willie and his friend Drake hate their school mascot Big Yellow and decide to have it replaced with a wolf....which doesn't sit well with Big Yellow himself.

programme.title: Bad Feng Shui - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A Chinese girl named Jessica hates how strict her mother is right down to rearranging her room. When Jessica decides to arrange the room the way she wants it, dark forces begin haunting her house and she turns to Mr. Ming on how to set things right.

programme.title: The Hole - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Rob and Carrie's family move to a new house which they find by the help of a video is haunted by a father who went insane during a barbecue and killed his family in a car wreck.

programme.title: Scarecrow - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A farmer named Jenny has trouble ridding her crops of an infestation of crows, so she buys a scarecrow from a mysterious salesman -- and soon discovers that the scarecrow has the power to scare more than crows.

programme.title: Dreamcatcher - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — The camp legend of a mysterious creature who feeds on nightmares appears to be true after a cabin full of girls have a recurring nightmare that terrorizes them so badly, it leaves them unable to sleep.

programme.title: The Most Evil Sorcerer (Part 1) - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — In a medieval English town ruled under a corrupt sorcerer, two teens, Ned and Sara, set out to dethrone the sorcerer and rid him of his magic.

programme.title: The Most Evil Sorcerer (Part 2) - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When Ned and Sara discover that the sorceress who helped them dethrone the evil sorcerer was the one who taught him black magic, Ned takes revenge against the sorceress, and Sara worries that Ned's obsession to learn magic may drive them apart.

programme.title: Stage Fright - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A high school drama club is doing a play based on the story of Hansel and Gretel, but the cast suspects their drama teacher of being a witch after several misfortunes befall the cast and one of the props is revealed to be a real working oven.

programme.title: Night of the Mummy - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When a rare Egyptian exhibit comes to town, Seth discovers a horrible secret that connects him with the mummy of The Boy Pharaoh.

programme.title: Headshot - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — An ice cream shop girl named Gracie Wilde dreams of being the prettiest face in the world -- a wish that a ruthless teen magazine photographer named Cassandra is more than willing to grant Gracie. As Gracie gets more famous, her character begins to change.

programme.title: The Return of Lilly D - S02E18
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — The evil doll Lilly D. (from the series premiere "Really You") is being beaten up by boys when a young girl named Natalie takes her home to her grandfather.

programme.title: Grampires (Part 1) - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When Mike (Mitchell Kummen) and Cristen (Chanelle Peloso) visit their grandpa (Christopher Lloyd) at his retirement community, they soon discover why its residents only come out at night as the grandpa and it's inhabitants are actually vampires.

programme.title: Grampires (Part 2) - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — The grandpa must protect and save his grandchildren from the bloodthirsty residents of his retirement community.

programme.title: The Cast - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When Lex rats out his friends for egging the house of a mysterious cat lady, her cats begin to follow him and take interest in his increasingly itchy arm cast.

programme.title: The Weeping Woman - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Chi (Rico Rodriguez) learns the scary folk tale of the child-stealing river witch called "La Llorona." He soon comes face to face with the terrifying creature and must defeat her to save his friends.

programme.title: Intruders - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A young girl, who's been unhappy ever since the birth of her baby brother, makes a deal with a seemingly harmless forest creature who promises to give the girl a better life with a new family in exchange for her baby brother.

programme.title: Spaceman - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Aaron (Will Shadley) is a lonely boy who is given a toy space helmet by a neighborhood woman. The helmet begins receiving calls, however there are no batteries in it.

programme.title: Red Eye - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — It's always a good day for Georgia (Mackenzie Foy) when she gets a postcard from her traveling father away in another country, but soon she has reason to believe that he is being followed by someone and decides to figure out what's going on before it's too late.

programme.title: My Imaginary Friend - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Shawn (Ryan Lee) is happy to make friends with a mysterious being named Travis, but soon the two are faced with a dilemma when Shawn's brother begins to butt heads with Travis, who just so happens to be an imaginary being, and perhaps even a ghost.

programme.title: Poof de Fromage - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Bobby (Quinn Lord) and his family are housing a French exchange student, Jean-Louis (Vincent Martella) for a year, but a chain of strange happenings make Bobby suspect that his French exchange student may be an alien.

programme.title: The Golem (Part 1) - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Jeremy and Bonnie are saddened to learn of the passing of their grandmother and travel to her homeland of Russia to spread her ashes. But soon after they arrive, a bewildering secret is uncovered from their grandmother's past.

programme.title: The Golem (Part 2) - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — After arriving to his late grandmother's homeland of Russia to spread her ashes, Jeremy must use what he knows about a certain secret from her past to save the village and his sister from a malevolent threatening being.

programme.title: The Girl in the Painting - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — When a girl in a painting captures the attention of Becky (Bailee Madison), she becomes enthralled with the image and does everything she can to mirror the life and surroundings of the painted figure, but she soon realizes that things aren't as they seem.

programme.title: Checking Out - S03E13
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Jeremy (Matthew Knight) & Chelsea get out of a family vacation with mom & dad. When the family stumbles upon a creepy hotel where parents mysteriously forget that they have kids, Jeremy & Chelsea have to fight to keep their family together.

programme.title: Terrible Love - S03E14
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Hopelessly infatuated with a boy who seems to have more important things to do than pay any attention to her, a girl commissions Cupid to cast his spell on him but with two times the normal strength, inevitably leading to a terrifying obsession.

programme.title: Séance - S03E15
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — As part of a joke, Naomi (Julia Sarah Stone) and Tracey (Laine MacNeil) try to scare Naomi's sister Carla (Joey King) by summoning the spirit of an evil man named Cyrus Clayton (Ian Gregson), a sawmill worker who was fired for drinking on the job and killed his boss before he lost his leg. But the joke's on them when Carla goes missing and the spirit is let loose in the house.

programme.title: Detention - S03E16
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A snooty homecoming queen named Kate (Madison Desjarlias), a jock named Halftime (Casey Dubois), and a Goth girl named Audrey (Madeline Carroll) are stuck in detention for unknown reasons. But when Kate goes missing and strange noises begin haunting them, Audrey and Halftime soon realize that their after-school punishment is from a higher power who wants them to atone for a homecoming court scandal.

programme.title: The Funhouse - S03E17
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — Two kids make a pact to stick together, but problems arise when one of them goes into a fun house and his dark thoughts begin to overpower him.

programme.title: Worry Dolls - S03E18
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — A girl receives worry dolls from her busy parents, and soon whatever she frets about becomes real.

programme.title: Lovecraft's Woods - S03E19
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-PG — On their way to a party, three teenagers (a gamer named Nicholas, a goth named Erica, and a brainy girl named Margaret) find themselves in an unfamiliar part of the forest known as Lovecraft's Woods, said to trap its victims into an endless time loop and be haunted by a ghoul who infects anyone it scratches.

programme.title: Ragnarok - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Despite Edda's embrace of a new dawn, the young God of Thunder cannot evade the predestined future that awaits.

programme.title: New Boy - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Returning to his family’s hometown, awkward teenager Magne discovers his strange new powers. Still, the hamlet's natural beauty cloaks dark secrets.

programme.title: 541 Meters - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Magne and his classmates try to regroup after a tragic loss, while the police seem uninterested in getting to the truth. Gry stumbles on Vidar unmasked.

programme.title: Jutulheim - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — The break-in confirms what Magne suspects: He must take matters into his own hands. After tying up loose ends, the Jutuls put the teen to the test.

programme.title: Ginnungagap - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — A search for answers brings Magne back to a mysterious woman — and a meaningful mountain. Turid confronts Ran, and former BFFs Gry and Saxa get heated.

programme.title: Atomic Number 48 - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — As Fjor holds Vidar back, Magne takes the blame, then tries a new tack. Threats abound, and the greatest is the explosive find that Isolde left behind.

programme.title: Yes, We Love This Country - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — While attempting to expose the truth, Magne gets another shock. Hope seems lost, but have the Jutuls underestimated their foe — and the power of good?

programme.title: Brothers in Arms - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — A battle ends with a bang — and an ominous promise of violence. After visiting another realm, Magne hunts for allies while Vidar marshals his forces.

programme.title: What Happened to the Nice, Old Lady? - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — The truth hurts, and a fight for hearts and minds kicks off. Vidar gets under Magne's skin, Iman feels her power, and Laurits discovers his dark side.

programme.title: Power to the People - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Edda rises: Magne confronts Ran, and Laurits proves a point. As protests gather momentum, a king walks again, and a master manipulator gets played.

programme.title: God Is God, Though All Men Death Had Tasted - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — A patriarch passes — and a strange new creature is born. Magne tries to change, Laurits lashes out and Fjor charts a new path. Saxa and Iman step up.

programme.title: Know Yourself - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — In a seismic shift, Magne rejects strength, Fjor makes a power grab and a circle closes ranks. Laurits learns the truth, and Iman reaches out to Ran.

programme.title: All You Need Is Love - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Desperate times fire up Magne and his crew as they go on a risky mission. The Jutuls face an unforeseen enemy while a formidable ancient force awakens.

programme.title: War Is Over - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Bereft of his hammer, Magne continues to battle the Giants while complying with modern rules. But when he breaks a pact, the truce crumbles.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — The Jutuls decide to play along with Magne's antics to make him more open to Saxa's plan. Feeling rejected by everyone, Laurits finds support in Jens.

programme.title: Losing My Religion - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Under Saxa's spell, Magne continues to fall further from himself — a perfect distraction for Fjor to enact his vicious plan and set a dangerous trap.

programme.title: My Precious - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — More vulnerable than ever, Magne requires backup to face his relentless foes. An impossible ultimatum threatens Laurits' loved ones.

programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — As Magne's arrogance sows discord among his allies, the gods stand at a crossroads between forging lasting peace or fighting the impending battle.

programme.title: The Pursuit - S08E09
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Jed is being pursued by Marshall Hanson Dickson, a well known lawman. Dickson claims Jed Is James Carothers wanted dead of alive for murder in Missouri. Jed says he was cleared of the charge.

programme.title: Duel at Daybreak - S08E10
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — The new drover, a young southern gentleman, Roman Bedford, has incurred the wrath of the ranch foreman they're picking up cattle from. Roman has paid attention to the ranch owner's daughter, with whom the foreman has intentions. The ranch owner has keep hidden his past from his daughter.

programme.title: Brush War at Buford - S08E11
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Major Buford who fought for the south ties his herd in with Rowdy's. He does this so he can cross Duke Aberdeen's land. Duke was a POW in a Confederate prison, and won't let Buford cattle cross his land. The major's son Court hates anything Yankee. Union forces burned the Buford mansion in Virginia, and soon after Mrs. Buford died. Duke sends out phoney stock inspectors that claim many of the cattle are someone else's.

programme.title: The Testing Post - S08E12
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — An army lieutenant requisitions 100 prime steers and only offers a piece of paper in return. He pulls a gun and Rowdy wings him. Reinforcements come demanding the 100 head. Rowdy goes forty miles to the fort and the major says he can't pay him.

programme.title: Crossing at White Feather - S08E13
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Rowdy hires Jonas Bolt to guide the herd to and across the river. Rowdy finds Jonas drunk and fires him. The saloon owner tries to trick Rowdy out of a 1000 head using Jonas.

programme.title: Incident of the Tumbleweed - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Two outlaws kill their lawman escort in Favor's camp, saddling the trail boss with the responsibility of bringing them in for trial.

programme.title: Incident at Alabaster Plain - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Rowdy's wartime friend, they spent time in a POW camp, is getting married. The bride's stepbrother, a murderer sixteen times over, has returned to claim his share of the family fortune.

programme.title: Incident with an Executioner - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — A stage load of passengers being chased by the man with the black satchel wrecks. Favor takes them to his camp. The man is a hired executioner after someone from the stage or the herd.

programme.title: Incident of the Widowed Dove - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Rowdy tries to help Clovis leave her sheriff husband.

programme.title: Incident on the Edge of Madness - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — The drive trapped by high water is approached by a Colonel and lady looking for men to join his Confederacy of Panama. Fearing his men will leave, Favor tries to cross, losing a man. The men leave not realizing what the Colonel's plans are.

programme.title: Incident of the Power and the Plow - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Gil Favor gets permission from rancher Jed Reston to drive his herd over Reston's land. He discovers, however, that Reston has a bigoted attitude toward Indians, particularly a local Comanche named Taslatch who wants to be a farmer and who's paid for a mail-order plow. (Reston's recently had his son, Matt, give Taslatch 15 lashes on a trumped-up rustling charge.) Favor earns Reston's enmity by siding with Taslatch. Tensions soon escalate until violence is set to erupt between the Comanches and local townspeople and Favor must take decisive steps to intervene.

programme.title: Incident at Barker Springs - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Brazo, a retired gunfighter, attempts to keep his kid brother from taking up the family business.

programme.title: Incident West of Lano - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Four stranded women provide a love interest and a complication for Favor. A freight hauler with a gunfighter says he's using the only river crossing first.

programme.title: Incident of the Town in Terror - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — When Rowdy and two steers are thought to have anthrax, The only medical help is a young lady with two years of nursing school. Her town doesn't want anything to do with the drovers or the herd.

programme.title: Incident of the Golden Calf - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Brother Bent the newest drover sparks gold fever, when he flashes a huge nuggett.

programme.title: Incident of the Coyote Weed - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Banditos inside and outside threaten the herd and the drovers.

programme.title: Incident of the Chubasco - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — The drive faces a formidable tasks climbing to a plateau known for it's high winds and dust storms. Favor hires Tom Bryan more for his wagon than the man. Tom sneaks a woman dressed in a bridal gown into the wagon. Jefferson Devereaux, a wealthy land owner, comes looking for a man and a woman, his wife, Jenny. Rowdy was a POW with Tom. He says Tom sold out. Jeff and forty men will be back in the morning for Tom and Jenny.

programme.title: Incident of the Curious Street - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Favor and Rowdy are looking for strays. They enter a deserted mining town. Matt Lucas is the caretaker. He says he's the only one there. Leaving they hear an organ. Mrs. Miller and her daughter, Angie, say Lucas and his son, Waldo, gunned down the stage coach driver, and is holding them hostage.

programme.title: Incident of the Dog Days - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Favor stops Talby from shooting Johnny Camber, who he says is Billy Carter, who killed his daughter. Clark accuses Carl Myers of being a trail camp thief and a card cheat. Favor decides to take the herd across the dry plain at the worst time of the year. The men begin to question Favor's judgment. Eventually all but six of his men quit.

programme.title: Incident of the Calico Gun - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Favor and Pete find Jenny Watson outside a burned cabin. Her parents who died of a sickness were burned with the cabin. Favor invites Jenny to ride along to Silver Junction. Jenny is in cahoots with three brothers to rob Favor of the drive's payroll.

programme.title: Incident of the Misplaced Indians - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Rowdy finds two indians dead outside a house. Amelia Spaulding is inside singing and making candy.

programme.title: Incident of Fear in the Streets - S01E17

programme.title: Incident Below the Brazos - S01E18

programme.title: Incident of the Dry Drive - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Jess Hode, a bitter ex-trailboss who the owners thought was too old, demands half of Favor's herd for the only water around. Jess' son stands by him but soon comes to see through his old man. Favor tries a couple other water holes but they are dry.

programme.title: Incident of the Judas Trap - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — With wolves threatening the herd, Pete is sent to town to get a wolver and traps. None are available, but he meets his old flame, Nora Sage. She is later found strangled in her room. Brad Morgan, Medrina Wilcox's foreman also came to see her. Medrina has a herd but only one man. They pool herds. Brad was a wolver, and directs Favor's men in placing the traps. Brad toys with the affections of Nora, Medrina and her sister Paula. Favor lets the sheriff take Pete, but says he needs Morgan.

programme.title: Incident in No Man's Land - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Favor and Rowdy ride into a settlement of women to find out the source of explosions threatening to stampede the herd. They're told to go to the camp. It uses contract prison labor. The women are the wives and girlfriends of the convicts. Todd McCauley has one month to go, but Clement won't release him saying he knows where the money he stole is. Todd arranges a breakout. The convicts need horses and head for the drive.

programme.title: Incident of a Burst of Evil - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — A badly beaten wild man, Bing, says that Comancheros are planning to take the herd. Rowdy befriends a woman, once a countess, now being held by the Comancheros. She offers a mirror for the kindness Rowdy has shown. Rowdy says he couldn't accept it. She sneaks it into his saddlebag. At a trading post the mirror is identified as one taken in a Comanche raid. Rowdy is thought to be a Comanchero and has to fight his way out. Rowdy goes to the Comanchero camp to get Louisa to back up his story and is caught. Loouisa tells Rowdy of the Comancheros plans. Bing was sent by the Comancheros to lead the drive to them.

programme.title: Incident of the Day of the Dead - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Rowdy goes to town to pick up the mail for the men and stops a runaway horse. Luisa, a rancher, sees it and tries to get Rowdy to come and work for her.

programme.title: Incident of the Roman Candles - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 1959 · TV-PG — Pete and Quince find young Davey Colby who says Indians killed his father and grandfather and carried off his mother. He is trying to reach his uncle in Eberle. Favor doubts his story. He hasn't heard of any Indians in the neighborhood. The Kimble County Sheriff tells Favor, there are no Colbys in Eberle and no Indians within 100 miles. Favor tells Pete some kids just find it easier to lie. Davey says he ran away from home to find his father, a bounty hunter. Favor tells Pete to take him home to his mother. After a couple of unsuccessful escape attempts, they ride up to Davey's home. The door is locked. Davey knocks. A woman answers and says she's never seen Davey before in her life. Pete says he understands and turns to leave. He gets a rifle leveled at him. Inside is Bodie whose knee was shot by Davey's father Sam. Bodie, Mooney and Harv are lying in wait for Sam to return home.

programme.title: Incident at Dangerfield Dip - S02E03

programme.title: Incident of the Shambling Man - S02E04
