programme.title: Anawanna Incorporated - S02E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — The campers start a birdhouse company for career day. Dina is appointed leader and Donkeylips is put in charge of production. After seeing how the others are being lazy, Donkeylips and his workers go on strike. Meanwhile, Ug and Sponge search for items to put in the Camp Anawanna time capsule.

programme.title: Zeke The Plumber - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — (AKA "The Ghost Story") Budnick tells the gang a ghost story about the camp's old custodian, Zeke. It is said that Zeke, who had lost his nose in an accident, was unable to smell a gas leak, which killed him. Budnick tells the group that whoever touches Zeke's plunger, will have horrible nightmares haunted by Zeke. Of course, everyone had bad nightmares that night. And so the entire group, with help from Ug, set up an elaborate plan to get revenge on Budnick.

programme.title: The First Day - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — (AKA "Michael Comes to Camp") Michael arrives at Camp Anawanna and becomes very popular with some of the other campers. Budnick then forces Michael and Sponge to join a ""secret club"" along with him and Donkeylips. As part of the club initiation, Sponge and Michael go to steal something from the girls' cabin. In a rush to avoid getting caught, Michael takes and accidentally breaks Telly's glasses.

programme.title: The Treasure of Sara Madre - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — Budnick finds a treasure map that supposedly leads to the buried cash of the camp's late dance instructor Sara Madre. He sells two copies of the map: one to Michael and Sponge, and another to Z.Z., Dina, and Telly. In order to find the treasure, the groups must go across the camp doing odd dance steps. As the groups try to be the first to the treasure, Donkeylips and Budnick find that watching the hunt is hillarious.

programme.title: Brownies For Thud Mackie - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — (AKA "I Hate Camp") After Michael accidentally ruins some brownies that belonged to the camp's meanest kid, Thud Mackie, he needs to do something or face a beating. After all of his attempts to smuggle brownies into camp are foiled by Ug, he decides the best thing to do is leave camp. With everyone's help, he creates a video that exaggerates the horrors of camp to send to his grandparents. The video plan works, but Michael doesn't really want to leave, leaving him with a choise: stay with his friends at camp and be pounded by Thud, or leave.

programme.title: Bunk Chief Elections - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — (AKA "Telly and Dina") At the girls' bunk Telly and Dina each try to bribe Z.Z. to vote one of them as Bunk Chief. At the guys' bunk, as punishment for putting a goat into Ug's cabin, all the boys must do the prep work for the Indian Counsel Dinner. They decide to get back at Ug by doing something that he would never expect: behaving.

programme.title: Toilet Seat Basketball - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1991 · TV-G — (AKA "Telly & The Basketball Team") The gang forms a basketball team that must play in a small camp tournament to earn the privilege of representing Camp Anawanna in a big basketball tournament. If they lose, their pictures are taped to the bottom of a toilet seat in the main lodge. Telly is the team's coach, but no matter how hard she pushes them, they keep losing. Once Budnick takes over as coach, though, everything starts to turn around and they start to do well.

programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Fuu is a young waitress in search of a Samurai who smells of sunflowers, but she has some unexpected company with her. Mugen and Jin are two samurai who want to kill each other and are always getting arrested. Can these three learn to work with each other?

programme.title: Redeye Reprisal - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugen's armless rival retuns with some new hired help: Oniwakamaru.

programme.title: Hellhounds for Hire (Part 1) - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugen and Jin decide to ditch Fuu, but they end up joining opposite sides in a basica gang warfare with Fuu in the middle reminding them of their promise.

programme.title: Hellhounds for Hire (Part 2) - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — A dice rolling contest will decide the fate of the gang warfare. Who will end up dying as a result?

programme.title: Artistic Anarchy - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Fuu is targeted as a kidnapper groups next victum. Will the others be able to save her in time?

programme.title: Stranger Searching - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — The gang enters into an eating competition with Mugen and Jin's swords on the line. After a mysterious man wins the eating competition, they must find a way to get their swords back and save the mysterious man. Will they succeed?

programme.title: A Risky Racket - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — A thief was running around town, while Fuu, Jin, and Mugen were going to get some soup. Fuu was daydreaming and the thief ""accidently"" bumped into Fuu. When Fuu was paying for the soup, she noticed that her purse was gone and said that the man she bumped into took the money. Will Fuu ever get her money back?

programme.title: The Art of Altercation - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — A man hunting for Jin has been challenging any samurai wearing glasses he can find, accompanied by a beat-boxing duo of underlings. The question arises as to whether or not he will recognize Jin when he becomes infatuated with Fuu, for Jin has had to pawn his glasses.

programme.title: Beatbox Bandits - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugen, Jin, and Fuu need to cross a border so they purchase Travel Passes since they dont have any.The Travel Passes turn out to be fake. Mugen, Jin, and Fuu are sentenced to death. The guards were going to have them killed until they found out about a errand they needed to run. So they send Mugen to run the errand for them. He must travel past a forest full of bandits and trouble to deliver an object. If Mugen does not make the delivery and come back in time, Jin and Fuu will die!

programme.title: Lethal Lunacy - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugen faces the lethal challenge of a Shaolin-trained swordsman and proves equal to the test, while Jin gets stuck doing all the housework. Can Mugen defeat this trained swordsman or will he suffer from his mistakes?

programme.title: Gamblers and Gallantry - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Jin comes to the rescue of a lady in distress. He falls in love and tries to rescue his women from the hard life she has come to face. Will he save her and himself?

programme.title: The Disorder Diaries - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Jin and Mugen read through Fuu's diary and find out that she hasn't been telling them what they need to know.

programme.title: Misguided Miscreants, Part 1 - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugens past memories lure himback into his violent past; A pirate makes secret plans. And the lust for gold brings betrayal.

programme.title: Misguided Miscreants, Part 2 - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — When Mugen finds out what the pirate was planning to do, he gets his revenge.

programme.title: Bogus Booty - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — The shogun's prettiest ninja ends up giving Mugen and Jin an evening that they will never forget. Meanwhile, Fuu gets large.

programme.title: Lullabies of the Lost, Verse 1 - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugen, Jin and Fuu get into a quarrel and separate, and have unexpected encounters; new opponents appear, old grievances return, and Mugen and Fuu meet a mysterious archer.

programme.title: Lullabies of the Lost, Verse 2 - S01E17
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Jin ends a life he hoped to spare. Continuation of the last episode.

programme.title: War of the Words - S01E18
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Fuu gets a facelift when kids trade in the sword for the graffiti brush; Jin keeps a promise to a long-lost friend and confronts the shock of the new, while Mugen learns to read and conquers a castle.

programme.title: Unholy Union - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — A cynical charlatan fleeces the Hidden Christian flock, Fuu gets closer to the Sunflower Samurai, and a truth is finally revealed.

programme.title: Elegy of Entrapment, Verse 1 - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Fuu, Mugen and Jin meet up with a blind girl who is a traveling musician. Because of her blindness, she is able to sense the emotions of the group. Is this girl more than just a musician?

programme.title: Elegy of Entrapment, Verse 2 - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Jin learns the Way of Water, a woman's sorrow comes to an end, and Mugen both gives and receives an assassin's last gift.

programme.title: Cosmic Collisions - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — On the way to Nagasaki the trio falls in a hole and ends up in a mine. The trio ends up working for the owner of the mine for a share of the treasure. As the days drag on Fuu discovers that they are becoming more and more like the seemingly-alive workers.

programme.title: Baseball Blues - S01E23
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — An anachronistic batch of American belligerents sail into town and a canny ninja-turned-team manager enlists our heroes to do battle with them on the field of honor...which in this case is a baseball diamond. Behold Mugen's pitching skills and tremble!

programme.title: Evanescent Encounter (Part 1) - S01E24
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Fuu, Mugen and Jin have finally arrived in Nagasaki to find Ikitsuki island in search of the Sunflower Samurai. There seems to be one small problem that might keep them from getting there though. A group of assassins are following closely behind.

programme.title: Evanescent Encounter (Part 2) - S01E25
programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — As Jin duels Kagetoki Kariya, the most powerful man in the shogunate, Mugen has to contend with three brothers who want his head. Will they survive?

programme.desc: Action · 2004 · TV-MA — Mugen's armless rival retuns with some new hired help: Oniwakamaru.

programme.title: XXXI: Jack in Egypt - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — As Jack travels towards Egypt, Aku unearths three ancient Minions and tasks them to kill Jack in return for freeing them.

programme.title: XXXII: Jack and the Travelling Creatures - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — To get to a time passage, Jack must pass a lake which sucks down any who try to cross it without touching its bottom.

programme.title: XXXIII: Jack and the Creature - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Whilst crossing a desert to seek the Crystal of Cagliostoro, Jack comes across a oasis. He unwittingly disturbs an overly friendly creature, who begins following Jack, messing up Jack's every move along his quest.

programme.title: XXXIV: Jack and the Swamp Monster - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack finds a swamp where a foul-tempered hermit answers his call. The wizard tells Jack of the titan Chronos and his powers over space and time, now locked within three pieces of armor set with gems.

programme.title: XXXV: Jack and the Haunted House - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack travels through a swampland, when he comes across a small shadow crying in the distance. After approaching the being, it drops a small toy doll and Jack follows it back to a small house in hopes of giving the item back to the creature.

programme.title: XXXVI: Jack, the Monks, and the Ancient Master's Son - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack meets two Shaolin monks and after a brief fight he convinces them of his credentials and they take him to see their Grand Master at their hidden temple.

programme.title: XXXIX: Jack and the Labyrinth - S03E13
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack is directed to a deathtrap-filled labyrinth which holds a diamond that can restore him to his time. Unfortunately a master thief also enters the labyrinth going for the item.

programme.title: XL: Samurai vs. Ninja - S04E01
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Aku sends forth the robotic ninja Shinobi, Warrior of the Dark, to kill the Samurai. Jack responds to the cries of a young boy from a village beset by robot lobsters. Jack defeats them all while Shinobi watches - then the ninja takes the boy to a nearby ruined tower where he strikes from the darkness at Jack as he follows. Jack knows of the ninja's technique and reveals that he is trained to blend with the light just as Shinobi can blend with the dark. The warriors of light and dark fight from shadow to light and back again - with the sun going down, Jack quickly runs out of concealment and in a last desperate measure reflects the waning light onto Shinobi and destroys him with a well-tossed sword.

programme.title: XLI: Robo-Samurai vs. Mondo Bot - S04E02
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack enters the abandoned city of Andromeda and finds himself under attack by a monstrous giant robot, the Mondo-Bot. Jack is initially defeated and rescued by local robots who believe he is the Chosen One. The city is built on a magical city of giants and Jack goes underwater to seek them out and finds a giant samurai robot which pulls Jack into it. Jack's bot is resistant to everything the Mondo-Bot shoots at it so the two engage in an enormous close combat battle and Jack proves triumphant.

programme.title: XLII: Samurai vs. Samurai - S04E03
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — While traveling through the rain, Jack takes refuge in an inn and meets Da Samurai, a hip-hop singer/fighter. His performance is interrupted by a new version of Aku's bounty hunters. Jack defeats them handily, much to Da Samurai's amazement. Da Samurai challenges him to battle and Jack eventually agrees. Jack requires him to first fight with sticks and Jack is clearly the superior warrior. Their fight is interrupted by the arrival of many more of Aku's hunters. Da Samurai is captured and Jack defeats the 100+ robots...but they assemble into one gigantic multi-headed robot. Da Samurai saves Jack by taking an energy blast, giving Jack time to defeat the robot and acknowledge Da Samurai has taken the first step on the path of a true warrior.

programme.title: XXXVII: The Birth of Evil (1) - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — The gods Odin, Ra, and Rama battle a great dark evil. One shard escapes and falls to primitive Earth, creating a vast black forest. Down through the millennia it spreads and kills until the period of feudal Japan.

programme.title: XXXVIII: The Birth of Evil (2) - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — The gods send the Emperor a mystical horse to free him and deliver him to a castle in the sky. The three gods give him powers and forge a mystic sword for him to wield before sending him forth to fight Aku.

programme.title: XLV: The Scotsman Saves Jack (1) - S04E06
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — While traveling the Scotsman finds Samurai Jack working as a waiter named Brent Worthington. The Scotsman rescues the amnesiac Jack from bounty hunters and realizes that Jack was injured by the tango beast. He follows the trail from the tango beast to a bar of bounty hunters to a sea captain to a chart that directs them to The Great Unknown. The Scotsman hires a ship to take them there.

programme.title: XLVI: The Scotsman Saves Jack (2) - S04E07
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — The ship sails into the Great Unknown and encounters sirens who hypnotize everyone except the Scotsman who is conveniently immune thanks to his musical taste for Scottish music and his wife's singing. The entranced crew bring the ship to ground and give the sirens all their treasure as the Scotsman confronts the Sirens. They send the crew against him but he uses his bagpipes to snap them out of it. While the Sirens attack the defenseless Scotsman, Jack grabs his sword and kills the beasts. When the other ships leave without them and they have to have a series of contests to determine who will row the boat. Jack wins them all, including an epic thumb-wrestling battle.

programme.title: XLIII: The Aku Infection - S04E04
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack is infected with a bit of Aku and the piece infects him with Aku, trying to take him over and drive him to evil.

programme.title: XLIV: The Princess and the Bounty Hunters - S04E05
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Bounty hunters come together and vie among themselves to determine who will go first. Each hunter outlines his plan while another, armored hunter points out the flaws in each plan. The armored hunter is a woman, Princess Mira and she proposes they fight together, but she claim the bounty so that Aku will free her people.. The bounty hunters prepare their trap, digging pits to ambush Jack. But Jack defeats them all in the span of a second and even the princess yields before his superior ability.

programme.title: XLVII: Jack and the Flying Prince and Princess - S04E08
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — A prince and princess flee invaders of their planet and go for help, but ended up stranded on Earth and captured by Aku's forces - only Jack can rescue them.

programme.title: XLVIII: Jack vs. Aku - S04E09
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Tiring of the failure of his minions, Aku decides to engage Jack in one-on-one combat to settle matters between them once and for all.

programme.title: XLIX: The 4 Seasons of Death - S04E10
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Four separate stories following Jack through the four seasons: Summer, Fall, Winter and Spring. In Summer, Jack is traveling through the desert and is set upon by strange creatures formed of sandstorms. In Fall, a creepy little scientist attempts to make a poison to kill Jack. In Winter, a warrior race forge a mighty sword with which to slay Jack. In Spring, Jack finds rest in a mysterious garden paradise.

programme.title: L: Tale of X9 - S04E11
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — The first three-fourths of the story is a monologue: a Terminator-like killer robot with human emotions tells us the story of his life. He formerly worked for Aku, but stopped because of his emotions and because he felt in love with a little dog. But Aku kidnapped his dog and forces him to fight against Jack if he wants to see it again. He is tracking Jack and he is finally destroyed by the samurai His last words are for his puppy and Jack looks sadly at him. Then there is a close-up of his car and the last image of the episode is a photo of the dog.

programme.title: LI: Young Jack in Africa - S04E12
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — This episode takes place during Jack's childhood. After Aku's first attack, Jack is brought to a tribe in Africa where he is admitted into the adult community after a small ritual and the chief of the village teaches him the art of fighting with a stick. But an enemy tribe attacks the village in order to get a reward promised by Aku for Jack's capture and everyone is captured except for Jack. So he follows them, mastering the captors' weapon, using qualities of the animals he has observed to do so. After a difficult series of fights, Jack releases all the prisoners and with their help, the enemy tribe is defeated. At the end, Jack leaves the tribe because he is now considered to have learned all he can from them.

programme.title: LII: Jack and the Baby - S04E13
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — While peacefully enjoying a snack of peaches, Jack hears a baby cry and races to find out what's the matter. He rescues Baby from a crew of hungry (baby-eating) monsters. The two then set off to find the baby's mother. Jack makes a great temporary parent, finding food, shelter, dealing with diapers. He tells Baby a bedtime story of Momotaro (Peach-boy, an archetypal Japanese folk-tale). When sick, Baby wants peaches; when they return to the peach orchard, the monsters find them again. After the final defeat of the monsters, Baby's mother is found. When she notices a surprising change in her child, Jack explains the baby has achieved sakai, the spirit of the samurai.

programme.title: XCII - S05E01
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — It's been 50 years since we last saw Samurai Jack, and time has not been kind to him. Aku has destroyed every time portal, and Jack has stopped aging, a side effect of time travel. It seems he is cursed to roam the land for all eternity. His past haunts him as does a cult of assassins dedicated to killing him for Aku's glory.

programme.title: XCIII - S05E02
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack's will to survive is pushed to its absolute limits after a deadly, unseen foe launches a relentless surprise attack.

programme.title: XCIV - S05E03
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Samurai Jack is gravely injured but still decides to face one of the deadliest foes he's ever encountered: Assassins from the Cult of Aku.

programme.title: XCV - S05E04
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack partners with a deadly assassin in order to escape a gargantuan creature that has swallowed them whole.

programme.title: XCVI - S05E05
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Samurai Jack fights to save a group of enslaved people from being harvested as the power source for a monstrous Mega-Robot.

programme.title: XCVII - S05E06
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Ashi's search for Samurai Jack helps her to see his effect on the world after encountering numerous people and places where he has changed things for the better.

programme.title: XCVIII - S05E07
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack and Ashi overcome a series of dangerous physical and spiritual tests in order to recover Jack's sword.

programme.title: XCIX - S05E08
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — The burgeoning relationship between Jack and Ashi takes a turn after they are hunted by one of the galaxy's deadliest creatures.

programme.title: C - S05E09
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Samurai Jack's worst fear is realized when he faces off against Aku; the demon makes a shocking discovery about Ashi that puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: CI - S05E10
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — The fate of the entire universe hangs in the balance as Samurai Jack finally faces Aku.

programme.title: I: The Beginning - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Aku, the shape-shifting master of evil, devastates a young boy's land, forcing him to travel around the world to train as a samurai. When Samurai Jack returns to free his people, he is instead flung into the far future, where he must quest to undo the future that is Aku.

programme.title: II: The Samurai Called Jack - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack befriends some talking archeologist dogs and learns of his location: In the future shaped by years of Aku's evil reign. He vows to help the dogs gain their freedom from a life of enslaved jewel mining.

programme.title: III: The First Fight - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Aku learns of Jack's arrival in the future, and of the help he is giving the dogs. He sends a huge army of insect drones to destroy Jack and the dogs alike. Jack has been busy preparing many traps for them however, and when they arrive the battle begins in earnest.

programme.title: IV: Jack, the Woolies, and the Chritchellites - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack comes into contact with a tribe of creatures who utilize their technology to subdue a group of supposedly savage beasts called "Woolies." Little does Jack know, there is more to the situation than meets the eye.

programme.title: VII: Jack and the Three Blind Archers - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Samurai Jack hears of a mysterious island which possesses a well that can grant any wish. He arrives at the island and discovers the well is not alone.

programme.title: V: Jack in Space - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Samurai Jack befriends a future community building a spaceship to escape Aku's tyrannic rule. Jack agrees to assist in their escape by fighting off the blockade orbiting the planet in return for a trip through time back home.

programme.title: IX: Jack Under the Sea - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Jack hears tales about a race of amphibians living in an underwater city who have a time machine. He searches them out, and they agree to let him use the machine, but the creatures have not been entirely truthful.

programme.title: VIII: Jack vs. Mad Jack - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2001 · TV-14 — Aku places a bounty on Jack's head, but is disappointed by the failure of some inept hunters, so he creates an evil spirit-clone version of Jack to finish our hero off for good.

programme.title: XI: Jack and the Scotsman - S01E11

programme.title: Marrakech - S01E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman enters into the labyrinthine city of Marrakech, where nothing is what it seems. He navigates through the Jamaa El Fna, the largest square of Africa, dodging Gnawa dancers and snake charmers who take your money before you know what’s happening. He is led by false guides to fake rugs sold by ruthless bazaar owners. It’s a maze-like world where you’re lost without a guide, but there’s no way to be sure whose side the guide is on. Is Conor up to the challenge?

programme.title: New Orleans - S02E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — In New Orleans Conor becomes victim to culturally bespoke scams unique to this city. He starts by experiencing street level scammers …the small fry that feed off the Mardi Gras Street Carnival.

programme.title: Mexico City - S02E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman discovers the paradox that is Mexico City. From the moment he takes a taxi from the airport he is on a mission to find out about the kidnapping scam of the city’s taxis.

programme.title: New York - S02E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman immerses himself in the Big Apple and find outs that Zero Tolerance hasn’t swept tourist scams from the streets. He’s taken for a ride by unlicensed pedi-cab touts in Central Park, discovers where pickpockets ply their trade now they’ve been shifted from Time Square, and falls into a huge and dangerous counterfeit perfume scam.

programme.title: Jerusalem - S02E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman discovers the holy city of Jerusalem, where scam artists have been perfecting their craft for thousands of years. From fake holy men at the Western Wall, to pickpockets on the Mount of Olives, Conor uncovers the dark truth about the sacred sites of the holy city. In the city’s souvenir markets and upscale antiquities shops, artifacts from Jesus’ time are being sold to tourists eager to bring home a piece of the holy land. Fakes abound, and unscrupulous shop owners will say anything to make a sale. It’s ‘buyer beware’ in the holy city - where being a believer can be a pricey affair.

programme.title: Mumbai - S02E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — In Mumbai Conor Woodman experiences the mother of all taxi scams minutes after his arrival from the airport. After a gruelling experience at the hands of a relentless scamster claiming to be a travel agent, Conor is then approached by a woman who says she can make him a Bollywood star.

programme.title: Amsterdam - S02E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — As daylight fades, the scammers emerge from the shadows readying themselves for a nights work in one of Europe's most popular tourist destinations, Amsterdam. Conor meets the city's hustlers, pickpockets, fake police and ATM skimming gangs.

programme.title: London - S02E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman goes undercover in his home town of London to discover a whole new side to the city. After getting his phone snatched, using tracking software Conor goes in pursuit of the culprits to retrieve his property.

programme.title: Hong Kong - S02E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Hong Kong, a place where nothing is what it seems and Conor’s journey takes him from the heart of Hong Kong island to the border with Mainland China. Conor goes shopping for antiques and is sold an expensive jug from the Ming dynasty, only to find out that it wasn’t exactly what he thought it was.

programme.title: Bogota - S02E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman searches for a deadly zombie drug that renders its victims helpless as he explores the underside of Colombia's largest city.

programme.title: Paris - S02E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Paris will never seem the same after Conor Woodman takes you into the world of pick-up artists, French paintings (by the Chinese), pick-pockets and slight-of-hand scams

programme.title: Buenos Aires - S01E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Buenos Aires is a fast moving city bringing in around 10 million tourists annually. But like the Tango with its themes of deception and trickery of love, Conor Woodman discovers that many visitors leave Buenos Aires with broken hearts, after being scammed by pickpockets, con-artists, and grafters. Conor sets out to discover that the most common scams involving tourists are pick pocketing, clip joints, vice girls, taxi scams and hotel scams. But prevalent throughout the whole of the city and running out of control is Buenos Aries’ problem with counterfeit money…

programme.title: Prague - S01E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — As day turns to night, Prague’s scammers emerge readying themselves for the scores of tourists enjoying the cities nightlife and who are completely unaware they’ve been marked by those who disguise themselves as beautiful girls, harmless hawkers and friendly taxi drivers.

programme.title: Rio De Janeiro - S01E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman is in Rio, one of the sexiest cities in the world and never more so than at Carnival time. Millions of tourists descend on the city for the biggest party on the planet. And with so many tourists out reveling on the streets it’s party time for Rio’s scammers too.

programme.title: Barcelona - S01E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman visits the pick-pocket capital Barcelona, one of the most popular tourist destinations in the world. Whether it’s a day at the beach or an evening at the football or just a walk down the Ramblas enjoying the night life, this city has so much to offer. But look out this town has a darker secret, it’s home to one of the most skilled set and creative con men and thieves in the world; they’ll take your money off you day or night. Conor sets out to see exactly who these people are, how they operate and who knows he may even become part of the gang.

programme.title: Rome - S01E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Conor Woodman is in Rome, on a mission to uncover the gritty underworld that crawls under the thriving tourist scene of the Eternal City. At the Coliseum, he finds rogue Centurions who threaten tourists and unsheathe their swords to fight over territory. Right under the dome of St Peter’s, he discovers tourist agencies that employ muscle to scare competitors off their streets and conquer contested corners. There is a turf war underway in Rome, in which tourists have become the spectators and the prize.

programme.title: Delhi - S01E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Nobody can call themselves a true world traveller until they’ve survived Delhi. For backpackers going to Delhi is like a rite of passage. But ask anyone and they’ll tell you, before you can find yourself, first you have to lose yourself... just be sure to watch out for all those quack doctors who will prescribe you anything and everything in order to line their pockets with your cash. With the help of secret cameras the crew follow Conor’s every move while he and George the fixer try to unearth some of the deadly scams that Delhi has to offer.

programme.title: Istanbul - S01E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Istanbul is a city that offers a different face depending upon the areas you visit, and whether you do it during the day or at night. This exotic blend can be both fascinating and disorienting - a perfect environment for the skillful scammer to target vulnerable tourists. But in a clever feat of his own, Conor Woodman turns the tables on a scammer, and convinces him to become an operative for the film. In rare and revealing scenes, we experience first-hand the clever techniques that this con man uses to fleece his tourist victims. It turns out to be a punishing workout for Conor, but the reward is worth the effort in the end.

programme.title: Las Vegas - S01E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — In Vegas, host Conor Woodman ventures into the shadows to discover there’s a lot more to the tourist industry than meets the eye. In fact it’s a multi-layered hustle that takes Conor on a journey from the swankiest casinos and glamorous nightclubs to beneath the Strip itself, where tunnel dwellers live in the storm drains of Las Vegas, facing constant danger from rising waters. From them, Conor discovers the realities of life in “Sin City”, away from the glittering façade.

programme.title: Bangkok - S01E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — Host Conor Woodman returns to Thailand’s capital city of Bangkok, the one of the hottest cities on earth; and land of the three-wheeled auto rickshaws also know as Tuk-tuks. It has been 15 years since his last visit, this time to see if the gem scam he first encountered there is still being run – and to discover another one.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2012 · TV-14 — In New Orleans Conor becomes victim to culturally bespoke scams unique to this city. He starts by experiencing street level scammers …the small fry that feed off the Mardi Gras Street Carnival.
