Galeo tells another story, about how he wanted to be like Strangesnork for a science fair. Galeo invents glue and his brother scoffs at him, But not the science teacher. Galeo's glue is a hit and Strangesnork's invention is a miss. In the present, Galeo uses his time machine to show what really happened. It seems that Galeo was right all along, but Strangesnork tries to change the outcome in his favor. Galeo talks to his younger counterpart about his invention. Dr. Strangesnork talks to his younger counterpart about the fair. At the science fair, Strangesnork sabotages others' projects and accidentally makes Galeo's life even better.

programme.title: The Story Circle - S04E30
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks are playing video games at Grandpa Wetworth's house when the power goes out. Grandpa suggests a game of Story Circle, where the players make up their own outcomes of a story.

programme.title: I'll Be Senior - S04E31
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bigweed and Little Seaweed are at it again. This time, they are after a white kelp in a shark country for a potion to take over Snorkland. They steal the kelp and put a phony one in its place. Meanwhile, Junior finds an ad to make big money and Grandpa Wetworth finds an ad as well. Junior and Grandpa have a race, Junior wins and brags about his youth. Grandpa thinks that he is too old to live and is very insecure about himself. Casey tells him that he needs to have some fun in his life, so she and All-Star take him to a snorkboard park. That falls through, and Grandpa threatens to go to an old snorks' home. Granpa meets an old snork named Rose. Meanwhile, the bombs that Bigweed made turns everyone into babies! Meanwhile, Junior visits Grandpa and Rosie and they go into town where they notice the baby mayhem. They notice that Bigweed has taken over and Grandpa tries to get the seniors together to stop him. He gives the old people spirit and the verve that they need to come up with a big

programme.title: The Day They Fixed Junior Wetworth - S04E32
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — It's Casey's birthday and evryone has brought a present, except Junior who wants to sell his toys. Casey's mad because of how Junior acts all the time. All-Star tells how Junior used to be mice and respectful. All-Star tells everyone how Junior used to be so shy that he would run away or get laughed at. Junior used to be picked on by a big bully named Moose and All-Star feels sorry for him and comes to his defense.

programme.title: The First Snork in Space - S04E33
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Casey gets out her telescope for a famous starfish, and notices a flash in the sky. She investigates and finds a flying saucer. An alien named Molly from Seaturn is looking for a root that happens to be in Snorkeater-land. On the word ""reward"", Smallweed pops up again and goes into the ship to find treasure. Casey and Molly get the root and the Snorkeaters come after them. Molly helps her out and they go back to the spaceship. They find Smallweed and they accidentally get launched in space! On the way to Molly's planet, a bunch of sea pirates try to zap them out of the air. They get caught in a meteor shower and take a smooth fall. Luckily, they land in front of a gas station and a dance hall. They find a fabled bird fish and Molly needs a bird feather for her potion. They pull off when the crowd gets ruly and Molly tells them that they need some sort of formula for the potion. She visits a hermit for help, and finds out that he needs something sweet to eat from a cavern of nectar. Whe

programme.title: Wish or Wish Out - S04E34
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A sneaky Snail comes to town to sell his ware. Junior's brother, Willie, is discouraged because he is too little to go on the rides and stuff. Casey is discouraged as well because she seems to have a boring life. All-Star wishes he had a life like Occy. On cue, the Snailsman comes up and tries to sell stuff. He brings out a wishing pearl, a trinket that can only grant one wish. All of the get their wishes, and one by one they start to feel very successful. Then Willie starts to feel too big to do anything, Casey starts to feel the pressures of being a superhero, and All-Star gets in trouble with a dog fish catcher. All-Star then finds out that being a dog isn't all that it is cracked up to be. The Snailsman then gives them one pearl, and Casey and Willie starts fighting over it. All-Star then makes a wish for all of them back to normal.

programme.title: All That Glitters is Not Goldfish - S04E35
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Casey and Jo-Jo plan to surprise Corky with a vacation and Corky thinks the worst. Casey and Jo-Jo explain the concept of time-off to Corky so that he acn have some fun in his life. Casey gets on Corky for being too cautious and uptight. They decide on a picnic in the tycoons. While on their picnic, a tattered Egyptian snork needs help. Prince Eli, the tattered Snork, had a powerful empire until his evil sister Alexandra stole his scepter and took over Seagypt. Corky, Jo-Jo and Casey enlist to help him get his kingdom back. Eli and the Snorks get through some serious booby traps to get through the pyramid and get his scepter back. They go to confront Eli's sister and Eli and Alexandra get into a magical fight. When they get into the dungeon, Eli turns evil. Alexandra tells the truth about Eli, and it turns out that he was the mean seed after all. Corky comes in and they get together to pull off a plan to get Eli's power away from him so that justice can be served.

programme.title: My Dinner with Allstar - S04E36
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star finds a golden lamp, and Bigweed swipes it from him. A giant genie pops out and sucks them in a vortex. They enter a Wonderland where they hear cheerful music from a tuner fish. Then, a smidgen with a GIANT appetite follows them and they get sucked in a slow motion tide. When they get out, they meet the Genie and they run into a cave with the Tunerfish. Bigweed rests in a whale's mouth and they run when they realize that and falls into another vortex. They land in a place of mirrors where Bigweed steals All-Star's lamp. They break out, only to see that the tunerfish has brought them seahorses. All-Star and Bigweed come to a kelpburger stand. They meet a weird maitre 'd who gets them free food, but he's out of everything. When they eat, they put the lamp togteher, but a crab takes it apart. Bigweed grabs the piece out of the crab's claws. They find out that some of these creatures have been chasing them because of the lamp. They dress up as harem girls to see what is up. The ma

programme.title: Journey to the Source - S01E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Snorkland gets ready for a big Steam Festival, which is voluntarily called off due to a steam shortage. There is a reward for 5000 pearls for anyone who can go to the Source and try to restore the town's steam. The Snorks, along with Junior, travel to the Source where they find out that a space rocket particle had fallen on the steam source when a rocket blasted off into space a little while earlier.

programme.title: Vandal Scandal - S01E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Governor unveils a new painting of himself in the town square, which is ruined by the mark of a red crayon. Interestingly enough, Casey was missing a red crayon from her set. Junior and his family blame All-Star and his friends for ruining the painting. Tooter later finds the red crayon and starts scribbling with it. Unfortunately, Junior catches Tooter with the evidence. Tooter is charged with defacing property, but when the trial begins, Tooter is nowhere to be found. The Snorks find Tooter by using Professor Galleo's secret weapon, the Silver Fish. While the Snorks find Tooter, someone else is scribbling red mustaches on the Governor's painting. The Snorks find Tooter being chased by a giant crab and almost gets caught in a bad sea current. Casey finds her red crayon when Baby Smallstar is found scribbling red mustaches on the painting! The charges against Tooter are dropped.

programme.title: Hooked on a Feeling - S01E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Everyone is having a good time at a carnival, everyone except Occy who is excluded from everything. He finds a love interest in a fishing lure in the guise of a girl octopus. This relationship takes a dangerous turn when a swordfish follows it along with Occy all over Snorkland. The Governor blames Occy for causing this whole mess and banishes him to the Great Beyond. The Snorks then help Occy out when the Swordfish chases him again. They find out that the cause of the whole trouble was the girl octopus lure and Occy has to give her up for the good of the town.

programme.title: The New Neighbors - S01E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — While on a field trip at the kelp factory, Tooter meets a hummerfish who follows him home. When the Snorks find out that the Hummerfish is to be killed, Tooter tries his best to protect him from Junior's dad. Tooter lets it go, but there is a whole lot of hummers in town and they are in a mad feeding frenzy.

programme.title: Das Boot - S01E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — In the middle of a seahorse polo game, a giant boot crashes down on the field. Everyone thinks that it is an alien from beyond the limits. Galeo tries to communicate with it while the governor thinks that the boot will attack Snorkland. Tooter finds out the truth about the so-called invader and examines it. While examining it, Junior comes up and Tooter plays a trick on him, making him think that the aliens are attacking. Junior starts a story that gets out of hand. Tooter tells All-Star that there are no aliens at all. Galeo uses his machine to contact, but it calls a giant crab toward the boot.

programme.title: Which Snork Snitched? - S01E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star and Junior compete against each other in a gymnastics event and Junior cheats. All-Star finds out and gets Junior in trouble. To get back at All-Star, Junior buys a myna bird to spy on all of the Snorks' plans.

programme.title: Allstar's Allstar Band - S01E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — To make some money for All-Star's uncle Galleo, All-Star and his friends put together a band. The singing might be a little bit bad, but Occy fooling around as a keyboardist proves to be a great success. Soon, Occy is a huge star of Snorkland. Junior, however, wants to ruin Occy's success in any way he can. He even goes to his Dad, the Governor, who wants the band to stop playing so that he can promote his bad playing band. With Occy's help, that band starts playing perfectly. Both the Governor and Junior's plans backfire on them when the steam power controlling the instruments goes out of control and hits the Elder's house!

programme.title: Snorkymania - S01E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A barrel from the world above falls into the ocean, letting out a reddish fluid that makes people frightningly zany. Meanwhile, the Snorks are performing in a talent show and Dimmy really sets a bomb with his jokes. Then the red stuff seeps in and makes everyone laugh. Of course, it gets out of hand when the entire town starts laughing crazily. The Snorks go out in the Silverfish to find the the problem at the Great Reef. The barrel is about to fall in the reef, but the Snorks get it out in time. But Junior and Occy, under the spell of the red stuff, take over the Silverfish! Eventually, Occy gets back to normal and so does Junior.

programme.title: A Snorking We Will Go - S01E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks go on a snorking trip. Everyone is having the time of their lives, except Junior. Junior is all shook up after a story about a sea creature. While on a nature hike, they get lost thanks to Junior's ""sophisticated"" compass. While finding the way back, they come across an old sunken ship. As they explore the ship, they almost get caught by a strange giant form reaching into the ship. All-Star gets them all out safely, and he is commended for his efforts. The strange form just happened to be a diver just exploring under the sea.

programme.title: Now You Seahorse, Now You Don't - S01E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks enter a seahorse race. Junior, with the help of little Willie, cheats in the race. All-Star and Junior have to compete in a Snorkel chase. Junior thinks that All-Star's seahorse is all washed up because his horse ""won"". All-Star tries to prove him wrong by training his horse Sea Biscuit. Galeo creates a machine for the Silverfish with a magnetic compass. All-Star takes it by mistake and finds out that Junior and his horse cheated. All-Star and the Snorks cook up a plan to get back at Junior.

programme.title: Snorkdance - S01E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — It's the last day of school and everyone is looking forward to the Snork Prom. All-Star gets cheated by Junior during a football game, but the Snorks see through his trick and win the game. All-Star makes the winning shot, but breaks his foot. All-Star gets Tooter to go out with Casey, but Junior tries to ruin the date by making himself like Tooter, right down to the green makeup. Occy knows the difference, but no one listens. Galeo makes up a new dance without knowing it and All-Star goes to the prom with his new dance. Junior gets uncovered and has to dance with an overexcited Snork girl who has been chasing him throughout the episode.

programme.title: Snork Marks the Spot - S01E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks check out a construction site where Junior builds his empire. Occy digs up an old treasure map. Galleo tells the Snorks that the map was left by ancient Snorks. Junior steals the map and gives the Snorks a fake map to follow. They encounter a whole lot of dangers along the way while Junior thinks that the treasure is buried right in his own front yard. Galeo finds out that the treasure map is actually a warning about molten lava, an unfortunate proposition for Junior and his family.

programme.title: Junior's Secret - S01E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior talks about All-Star and his toy drive buit he forgets to mention that he sleeps with a toy turtle. Willie accidentally gives away Junior's turtle and Junior secretly pines for it. Junior then breaks into the school to get the toy turtle back, and gets caught by a guard. The Governor bails him out and he makes up a story about donating toys. At the toy drive, Junior tries to take his turtle back, but Baby Smallstar claims it as her own. Knowing that all is lost, Junior goes out and buys a stuffed seahorse.

programme.title: The Big Scoop - S01E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior makes up a story about a big wolf-fish for the newspaper, so he employs Willie to make his story come true. A sea current comes along and blows Willie away and Junior gets it all on film. All-Star notices that the fish was fake, and Junior vows to get a picture of a real wolf-fish. The Governor is worried about Junior (and Willie who followed him) and All-Star and the Snorks try to find him. Junior finds a real wolf-fish, and it chases him. All-Star and the rest of the gang get him in no time. The story is in the newspaper and Junior is mad again.

programme.title: The Blue Coral Necklace - S01E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Daffney gets a new blue coral necklace and Casey wants one as well. All-Star gets a hold of his mother's necklace and gives it to Casey, but then Occy gets it crushed under a steam roller. All-Star tries to tell his mom about the necklace when she mentions that she will wear it at a picnic! All-Star then scrambles to find a rare coral necklace. he finds it in a cave and as Tooter and Occy find blue coral, Tooter gets caught in a cave-in. All-Star uses the Grappler, a new invention, to get Tooter out and to mine some blue coral. New necklaces are made for all the gang and All-Star tells his mother what happened. His mother then tells him that the coral necklace that was destroyed was costume jewelry! It seems that All-Star and the gang went through all that trouble for nothing.

programme.title: Up, Up & Awave - S01E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Two oceanographers are exploring communication skills of porpoises and pick up the Snorks. The Snorks are having a balloon contest. Something goes wrong with Junior's balloon and anchors All-Star's balloon to a rock. All-Star fixes it and is in the race again. In order to finish, the teams all face the wrath of Junior's cheating and a big sea current. Now, after saving Junior, they get lost and Tooter, Dimmy, and Daffney's balloon gets carried away by the porpoises. The baloons are caught by the oceanographer's net and are saved by the porpoises. Then, they are caught by a giant funnel, and the town loses hope. The porpoises save all of the balloons in time.

programme.title: Snorkin' Surf Party - S01E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — It is a very HOT day in Snorkland. The Snorks venture to the beach. Junior introduces two surfer girls whom he brags to about beating All-Star. All-Star goes to the cove and is a great surfer, but Junior tries to prove him wrong. He challenges him to a Snorkboard race at the Big Reef. All-Star says it's dangerous and Junior calls him a ""Yellow snorkfish"". All-Star then builds a sand castle and Junior shows off by building an even bigger castle. Junior overhears All-Star talking about Galeo's motor for his invention and Junior steals the motor, unbeknownst to him that the machine is out of whack! Junior accidentally makes it work when trying to cheat, and Junior ends up with a cold. The two girls choose Galeo over Junior because of his invention.

programme.title: The Snorkness Monster - S01E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks take a field trip to the Snork Ness. They can go anywhere except any of the caves because of the Snorkness monster. An old man tells them that the Monster likes kids- for mysterious reasons. Casey encounters the monster while picking weeds and Occy goes into the cave. The Snorks check it out and find a big pearl. It turns out that the pearl is an egg laid by the Monster. The Snorks take the Silverfish with a communicator that lets them talk to the monster. Casey tames the monster and the monster tells them that her egg is gone and she wants it back. All-Star goes to Junior's house and try to get the Egg back, but the Wetworths catch them. The egg hatches and out pops a baby Snorkness monster!

programme.title: A Snork on the Wild Side - S01E19
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A wild creature with two snorks named Jo-Jo meets the Snorks. The Snorks try to get him and his pet Fenji to see that Snorkland is a good place to live. They show him how to have fun and to be like all of the Snorks. Junior tries his best to catch Fenji and take him to the zoo. Jo-Jo and the Snorks then go to the zoo to get back Fenji. Jo Jo doesn't understand why all the fish are in cages and lets them go. The Governor catches Jo Jo and locks him up. All-Star and Casey try to get him out so he can free Fenji. Of course, the famed Wolf-fish chases Junior and Jo Jo saves him by scaring away the Wolf fish. The Governor then frees all of the fish for Jo Jo.

programme.title: Allstar's Double Trouble - S01E20
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star has a date with Casey, but his mother wants him to take Samantha, a friend of the family, out to show her around Snorkland. All-Stra cannot be in two places at the same time, and he doesn't want Casey to know about his visiting friend. At the movies, Samantha tells All-Star about a boyfriend that she has back home, and he's a big one at that. All-Star then tries to be at both the movies and the prom with the help of Dimmy and Tooter. Just then, Bubba, Samantha's boyfriend, comes to visit and goes after All-Star. As All-Star goes to be with Casey, Junior joins Samantha! Bubba gets on Junior!

programme.title: Fine Fettered Friends - S01E21
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — At school, Galeo shows the Snorks some great archaeological finds. One of the interesting items is ancient handcuffs. Galeo fastens the cuffs on Junior's and All Star's arms and they spend the whole day handcuffed together. Galeo suggests that they climb the mountain where Galeo found the handcuffs and they have to work together to find the key.

programme.title: Time Out for Sissies - S01E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — To work on his football skills, Dimmy takes ballet lessons. He is ridiculed by a buch of bullies who instantly dub Dimmy a sissy. But Dimmy proves them wrong by using a few moves on the team. Dimmy then gets the whole team to take ballet lessons. The bullies then take over the dance school where the football team really gets at them.

programme.title: Me Jo-Jo, You Daffney - S01E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Daffney wants Dimmy to appreciate her, but when he doesn't oblige, an accident brings her and Jo Jo together. Jo Jo tries his best to woo Daffney. Dimmy is jealous when Jo Jo goes with Daffney to the Debutante Ball. Jo Jo learns to be civilized and a refined gentleman. Dimmy tries to prove that he can be as brave as Jo Jo, too. He tries to tame a wild fish and totally crashes the party. Jo Jo saves the day by luring the fish away.

programme.title: The Old Shell Game - S01E24
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Mrs. Butfish asks All-Star and Dimmy to housesit for her and she wants them to watch her seashell collection. Junior then finds out about the job and he tries to ruin it for them. Then Junior gets Occy to chase Polly, his myna bird, and they accidentally change the address number on the houses. The house next door is going to be demolished the next day and the changed addresses make the workers think that the Butfish house is the one that they are to tear down. While all this is happening, Junior steals the seashells and then tells her that All-Star and Dimmy stole the shells. Luckily, Occy had the foresight to hide the shells.

programme.title: The King of Kelp - S01E25
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Snorkland is getting ready for the Kelp Festival. All-Star and Junior vie in the kelp harvest competition. It seems like Junior's machine is better than All-Star's, put picks up a lot faster. Junior then picks a girl octopus to keep Occy busy while he sabotages All-Star's machine. All-Star's machine starts to go out of control and crashes. Occy then enters the race and tries all his might to pick the most kelp to help All-Star win the contest.

programme.title: Whales Tales - S01E26
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A baby whale gets separated from its mother when another whale chases them. Casey gives Daffney a driving lesson and they come across the whale in the net. They try to help the whale find its mother, but they try to hide it from anyone, especially Junior. Junior comes across the whale when he tries to snitch on All-Star, Casey and Daffney. The killer whale gives chase again and eats the Silverfish. The baby whale bumps into the whale and gets knocked out. The mother whale finds her baby when it comes to.

programme.title: Snorkitis is Nothing to Sneeze At - S02E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Dimmy is very sick from Snorkitis. Galeo diagnoses it and as Tooter describes, Dimmy, Tooter catches it. Then everyone in Snorkland gets sick. Galeo wants All-Star to finish what he started a while back. He gets help from Casey and they try to get Galeo to read the notes for them. Galeo then finds the cure in snork bubbles. The Governor then recognizes Galeo as a hero.

programme.title: The Whole Toot and Nothing But... - S02E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior writes a speech for class and gets a C in it for using a lot of words and saying nothing. Tooter gets an F in speech and his parents decide to get him professional help. It is then discovered that Tooter picked up his toot from a day at work with his dad. Tooter then joins a band and gets very famous until Junior spoils it by ridiculing his speech impediment. Of course, Tooter ends up saving Junior from a Snorkeater by imitating a Snorkeater-eater. All-Star then tells Tooter's parents that everyone likes Tooter just for who he is.

programme.title: Chickens of the Sea - S02E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star's dad is making stew and needs some salt. All-Star goes to the market where it is crowded with people wanting to get salt. All-Star goes to Galeo to see what is going on and Junior follows him. Galeo then tells him about ancient Snorks and their sea salt adventures until he falls out from dehydration. All-Star and Junior go off to find the legendary saltfish. Junior then finds some salt and takes it all for himself. He gets out but he doesn't get very far when two green guards catch him. The leader, Slugworth, gets them to start working in the salt mines. Junior gets in good with the leader, who wants more Snorks for the salt mines. Meanwhile, All-Star gets the workers to stand up to the leader. All the workers start a revolution against Slugworth. Junior then gets a well-earned lesson when the Neandersnorks want him to work.

programme.title: Never Cry Wolf-Fish - S02E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks go to see the flying fish and Dimmy's dad lets him use his new snorkoculars. Dimmy sees a wolf fish but no one believes him. All-Star and Casey gets on Dimmy for crying wolf, menaing that he shouldn't exaggerate. Then, a hawk fish takes him to its nest and keeps him there. All-Star and Casey never even knew what happened to him. In the nest, Dimmy sees a real wolf fish and protects the baby hawk fish. All-Star and Casey look for Dimmy and the wolf fish gets at them. Dimmy then gets rid of the wolf fish again. Then he tells them about the hawk fish episode and they don't believ him until the family flies by and waves to him.

programme.title: Learn to Love Your Snork - S02E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Daffney is unsecure about her looks when someone says that she has a big snork. Daffney's fears are confirmed when someone does a wicked stature of her. Casey then sees an ad on TV on how to shrink her snork. They get the product, but something goes wrong and Daffney's snork sticks straight up! She wears a big hat when she goes on a date with All-Star. She gets ridiculed by Junior in the movies and runs out. Then Casey looks like a sitting duck fish and everyone laughs at her. She runs away and is chased by a giant green fish. After All-Star saves herm, he tells her that she looks great the way she is.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Snork - S02E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Tooter has a record to play and it is a very big hit on a dance show. Tooter then becomes very popular that he even has his own concert. All of a sudden, a strange melody fills the air, but it's not Tooter but an organ playing monster. All of the Snorks fall into the trance of the monster. Tooter and Daffney go off to search for the Snorks. Inside the monster, they all meet Galeo's old friend who was trapped in for 20 years. He had a plan of counteracting the sound of the Piperfish, but he now has a chance to put his plan in action with the help of the Snorks. Tooter finds out about the monster and plays his music to free the Snorks. It's an all-out musical war, but Tooter wins.

programme.title: Allstar's Freshwater Adventure - S02E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — While having lunch, a storm blows a creature named Lucky into Snorkland. All-Star shows him around and he loses his breath. Galeo finds out that Lucky comes from a fresh water land and has to get back immediately. Lucky and All-Star go back to the current and Lucky goes back, but All-Star gets sucked in with him. All-Star meets Riverland and Lucky's parents. All-Star finds out that he cannot stand fresh water. All-Star decides to help them with their problem for things falling from above. All-Star has to go back because of the frshwater environment and he goes through the current. Back home, All-Star makes it back for Casey's aunt's show and Casey doesn't believe a word of his adventure.

programme.title: Dr. Strangesnork - S02E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Galeo displays his new invention called the Minaturizer, which shrinks things. All-Star watchs the invention, but Dr. Strangesnork steals it without All-Star looking. Occy then follows him and his cat to his laboratory. They are caught by the scientist, which turns out to be Galeo's brother. He uses the minaturizer to shrink his mind swapper to take over Snorkland, but he uses it to swap Occy's and All-Star's minds. All-Star (as Occy) tries to warn governor Wetworth about Dr. Strangesnork's plan, but he dismisses him. Occy (as All-Star) then guides Casey to Strangesnork's lab. Meanwhile, the Snorks find out that All-Star is really Occy. Dr. Strangesnork then goes to the auditorium where the Governor is giving his speech. The Snorks catch up to him, but he gets away. But not before Galeo swaps All-Stra and Occy back to their original selves.

programme.title: It's Just a Matter of Slime - S02E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star meets a kelp helper who is facing a lot of trouble because of what he is. All-Star then makes friends with the kelp helper, but the grandfather is uncertain about all this. This friendship is ruined when Junior insults them. The Kelp helpers all pack up and leave. Because of all the kelp helpers leaving, Snorkland is all full of algae. Everyone has to clean up and it's all the Governor's fault. All-Star goes to the kelp helpers and apologizes to them, but they expect an apology from the governor himself. It takes a giant snorkeater terrorizing Snorkland to set the governor straight. The Kelp helpers really did make a great contribution to Snorkland after all.

programme.title: Water Friends For? - S02E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Daffney gets tickets to the rodeo, but Casey gets tickets to the hockey game. They get into an argument over events. Daffney goes to the rodeo and the rodeo owners get Daffney into riding one of the horses in the rodeo. Daffney really does well, due to the fact that she only rode the seahorse go round. At the hockey game, Casey is lonesome for Daffney. In the rodeo, it takes a cactus to really get Daffney's horse going! At the game, a special announcement states that Daffney is out of control with her horse. The Snorks then try to find Daffney. Daffney almost gets sucked into a whirlpool, but Casey saves her.

programme.title: The Shape of Snorks to Come - S02E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior is thinking about running for Governor one day and goes campaigning. While chasing down local votes, he falls into a hole cause by a sea quake. The hole Junior falls down in sends him flying into the future where there the ruling is very strict. Because he says All-Star, he gets taken to court, The judge gives him 10 years in jail. While in jail, he meets old Casey. Casey tells him that All-Star was the governor's worst enemy and everything about him is illegal. Junior says Wetworth and is let out of jail. Junior gets the shock of his life when the Governor turns out to be HIM! Then the whole town escapes from jail and tehy all chase him. Junior then realizes that he has been campaigning in a bad way and plans to change his ways so it will not end up being like what he had just seen.

programme.title: Junior's Octopuppy - S02E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star, Daffney and Galeo enjoy a nice lunch when Junior comes yelling about a watch he has lost. Occy chases Junior off. Then All-Star tells Galeo that Occy used to be Junior's dog. Three years ago, Junior got Occy to protect him from people whom he accuses as thieves. All-Star helps him out by putting Junior's stuff back. On a field trip, Junior is training Occy, who gets stuck. All-Star and Casey help Occy out and Occy takes a liking to him. Then Junior tries to get Occy to track down and catch a butterfly shrimp. Occy leads him to a cave with a giant snorkeater. Occy leaves Junior and goes to All-Star's rescue when he is chased by the Snork eater. From that point on, Occy became All-Star's pet.

programme.title: Casey and the Doubleheader - S02E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Casye and Dimmy meet a Doubleheader named Red and Ed. They introduce them to All-Star and Tooter. They might by two, but they are so different in every way. Red is an avid eater and ends up eating everything in sight, even Casey's mother's flowers. Then Red makes trouble while no one is looking. In the morning, Red goes around acting like an innocent bystander. Then Galeo finds out that Red and Ed caused all the trouble. Actually, Red caused all the touble, but he sees the error of his ways when they save Casey from a waterfall.

programme.title: The Ugly Yuckfish - S02E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks visit the Undersea Fish Exhibits and are looking for the legendary Rainbowfish. Daffney doesn't want anything to do with it because it might mess up her chances for a beauty contest. Daffeny is soon pursued by a Yuckfish. Junior scares it away by taking pictures but the Yuckfish follows them as they leave. Daffney loses her purse and the Yuckfish finds it for her. The Yuckfish really likes her, but Daffney doesn't give him the time of day. She finds him a good home with a Snork rancher, who disgracefully turns the Yuckfish into a sideshow act. The Snorks break him out by pretending to be a circus trainer with a giant fish (Daffney, Casey, and Tooter). The Snorks then take Daffney to the beauty contest where she wins. The Yuckfish joins her on stage and Junior starts laughing and making fun of it. Daffney defends it by saying that it is beautiful and to everyone's surprise, the Yuckfish turns into a beautiful Rainbow Swan fish!

programme.title: Gills Just Want to Have Fun - S02E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Dr. Strangesnork tries to take over Snorkland again. This time, he creates a giant wave. He creates a big current that blows the Snorks while they are spring cleaning. Daffney then finds a red object and wears it around. Unbeknownst to her, that is a power pearl that the evil doctor uses to control his wave machine. Dr. Strangesnork follows Daffney around to get the pearl back, even if he has to dress up as a girl to get it. He tries some clever disguises to follow his evil plan. Dr. Strangesnork even dresses up as exercise guru, Jane Flounder. Daffney throws away the pearl, and the doctor gets it back.

programme.title: Guess What's Coming to Dinner! - S02E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A young Snorkeater doesn't like to eat Snorks. His pleas fall on deaf ears because his father bans him from the house if he doesn't eat a Snork. Meanwhile, Daffney is teaching Jo-Jo how to talk properly. The Snorkeater catches Jo-Jo, even though he doesn't like to do it. The Snorkeater tell his sad story to Jo-Jo and the gang, and they try to help him out. Unfortunately, Junior sees this plan and assumes that Jo-Jo is helping to Snorkeaters eat Snorks. Junior spreads this rumor around and the Snork guards are sent to stop the evil Snorkeater. In reality, the Snorks are making it look like the Snorkeater is eating Snorks to gain his family's respect. They succeed and no one gets hurt or eaten. Junior learns a lesson about jumping to conclusions.

programme.title: A Sign of the Tides - S02E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — King Neptune's horn to turn the tides over is lost when his dolphin hits it out of his temple. Suddenly, everything starts rising to the top of the ocean.The Snorks try to find out what is happening. They find out about King Neptune's horn and they try to find it. Willie finds the horn and turns it into a clubhouse that he wants them all to see.

programme.title: The Littlest Mermaid - S02E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Dimmy meets a little mermaid and falls in love when he saves it. Another Snork falls in love with it too: Dr. Strangesnork. He wants her for her scales for an invention he is working on to take over Snorkland.

programme.title: I Squid You Not - S02E19
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star has invented a bubble gun to show Galeo, but Occy breaks it by mistake and All-Star gets on him. Occy thinks that All-Star doesn't love him anymore, and he runs away. On the run, Occy meets a squid whose family doesn't want anything to do with him. The smaller squid makes friends with Occy. Later on, the squid gets caught by a claim jumper, who in turn in captured by Slugworth, the salt master. The little squid escapes and goes to find All-Star to help them out. Occy uses All-Star's bubble gun to capture Slugworth and his guards. The claim jumper adopts the gun and the squid as a pet.

programme.title: The Backwards Snork - S02E20
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star and the gang meet a supposedly faceless snork who is just lonely and needs companionship. He is a backwards snork who was exiled for being different. They try to help him save his home from being town down by Governor Wetworth.

programme.title: All's Whale That Ends Whale - S03E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — On a field trip, the Snorks get swallowed by a whale. As they split up to find some means of escape, Junior finds a lot of treasure. All-Star tries to teach them all how to work together.

programme.title: Allstar's Last Hour - S03E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All-Star is sick. Galeo cannot find out what's wrong with him. They have to go visit King Claw, a very reclusive crab. King Claw finds out that All Star has pneumonia and needs a hair for a get well potion from the seal Sea Urchins. The potion works and All-Star is better.

programme.title: A Willie Scary Shalloween - S03E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Willie runs away to the Lost Valley on Halloween where he meets a lonely Kimodo dragon.

programme.title: Sea Shore Sideshow - S03E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — All Star, Casey and Tooter are fishnapped in a boot by an evil sideshow man. He makes them do tricks against their very will. Casey and Tooter like the idea of being stars, but All Star wants to get back to the ocean. He sends a message to Corky, leader of the Snork Patrol. Corky recruits Jo-Jo to help him get the kids back.

programme.title: Snip & Snap - S03E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bigweed and Little Seaweed are up to no good again. This time, they have created a Barracuda Machine to take over Snorkland. But then, Bigweed creates two cute purple robots named Snip and Snap, whose plan is to win over the emotions of the Snorks while Bigweed takes over Snorkland. Of Course, they turn out not to be so cute when they make trouble for many Snorks. When they defeat a Snorkeater, they are made heroes while Corky is woefully neglected. When Bigweed takes over, it's up to Corky to set things right again. And they use Snip and Snap to their advantage.

programme.title: Freeze Save Our Town - S03E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A fugitive Snork from the Frozen North comes to Snorkland to get help to save his village from Snorkeaters. It's up to Corky and the gang to help him out. There is a little fish that keeps bothering him, not knowing that this little fish is a Snorkeater-eater! And he turns out to be the best thing to ever happen to Corky and the Snork's village.

programme.title: Junior's Empire - S03E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior finds a book on Famous leader Julius Seastar and decides to run against Casey using Julius's guidelines. Soon, all of the Snorks are rebelling against Junior.

programme.title: The Golden Dolphin - S03E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Corky, Jo-Jo, Casey and All-Star rescue a dolphin that is in trouble. An evil captain is looking for him and tries to catch him as the Snorks help him get to the reef. Jo-Jo calls some whales to help him out, but he is caught anyway. The Snorks go on the boat and they are pursued by the captain. Corky frees the dolphin and makes the captain sink his ship.

programme.title: It's Always Darkest Before the Snork - S03E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Why is it nighttime during the morning hours? That's what everyone wants to know, and everyone tries asking Galeo about what is going on. The Snorks find out that a Giant Snork Nork has rearranged the daylight until he gets what he wants. Gaelo tells them that every 100 years, many Mor-Glows fly across the sky and brightens the darkest clouds but Snorks have taken them for granted and might not ever come back. The Snorks go to find a Mor-Glow, only to have it captured by Snork Nork. Jo-Jo comes to rescue them. It turns out the giant Cyclop was the small Snork Nork in disguise.

programme.title: The Sand Witch - S03E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Sand Witch is terrorizing Snorkland and Corky tries to stop the magic portal. Bigweed messes up his submarine and they both get sucked in. Corky meets a Seastar to help him get out. Bigweed meets the Sand Witch who starts chasing him. The Sand Witch catches up with Corky and Bigweed to try to get out. They get out in time and seals up the portal, but the victory is short-lived.

programme.title: The Shady Shadow - S03E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Dr. Strangesnork creates a machine that steals people's shadows and makes them his slaves. Of course, Willie gets caught in the machine and his shadow is used against him. And the Shadow causes trouble for Snorkland and gets Willie blamed. Willis discovers that his shadow has been causing trouble, but no one believes him.

programme.title: Tooter Loves Tadah - S03E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Tooter meets another tooting snork named Tadah and tries everything to get her to notice him. If only they can get her away from Tubah, the bully. Galeo creates an invention that magnifies his tooter that really blows Tubah out of the water! Tadah leaves with Tubah because of this. When a Clam Cruncher pursues them, Tubah loses out. Tooter makes contact with it and makes it go away.

programme.title: Daffney's Ransom - S03E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks find a rare Neptunian plant and Bigweed wants it. He kidnaps Daffney and hold her for ransom. It seems that Daffney is giving them a hard time with her ways. Bigweed begs Corky and Jo-Jo to take Daffney back!

programme.title: Salmon Chanted Evening - S03E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior finds a treasure map and recruits Casey, Daffney and Tooter to help him find it. They meet a salmon named Wilbur who is ridiculed for being too puny to swim upstream with the other salmon. The only obstacle they face is a big bear who wants to eat them. The Snorks save him and take Wilbur to the top of the river with the other salmon. The big bear catches them, but Wilbur and the Snorks get him back big time. Wilbur repays them by helping them find the golden castle. Onlt it's a golden castle hamburger joint!

programme.title: Reefberry Madness - S03E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bigweed and Little Seaweed disguise themselves as Corky and All-Star and poison the berries. The real Corky brings the Snorks to pick berries. When Casey eats on the berries, she gets an addictive yearning for them. Soon, the Snorks are getting addicted to the berries except Corky. The Snorks get so silly and stoned that they forget their responsibilities. Corky then finds out that Bigweed has kidnapped them all and Corky gets back at him.

programme.title: Casey in Sandland - S03E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Casey finds herself in Sandland with a ruler that looks just like her. They switch places to see how the other half lives. Her magician, Morlock, wants to take over the kingdom. Sandy then finds out that her people suffer the plight of the King.

programme.title: Mummy Snorkest - S03E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks take a trip to the museum and have a good time in the history department. Galeo tells them about the adventures of the great King Tutsnork. The Snorks are recruited to go to the tomb of King Tutsnork to bring back his mummy. The Great Snork Nork, a vampire snork, is also on the prowl for the statue and disguises himself as the mummy. He makes up a phony curse and starts chasing the Snorks. Galeo figures out the whole thing is a scam and uncovers the Nork.

programme.title: A Farewell of Arms - S03E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks meet an outgoing octopus named Quatropuss and Occy is a little bit jealous. He and Occy decide to have a sports competition and he wins each time. The Snorks think that Quatropuss is the best thing to hit since sliced bread, and Occy thinks that no one loves him anymore. Meanwhile, a trap captures the snorks and Quatropuss doesn't have enough legs to open the locks. He finds Occy and asks for his help to free the Snorks.

programme.title: Jo-Jo in Control - S03E19
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Jo-Jo saves the town from a hammerhead shark, but he thinks that the Snorks like him because he is strong. The Snorks try to make him feel important to them. In Sculpture class, Jo-Jo creates a statue of a monster and everyone thinks that aliens have come to attack them. The Snorks then try to make him feel useful and he goes on a helping spree. His strength will destroy the town if the Snorks do not to something.

programme.title: The Day the Ocean Stood Still - S03E20
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Snorkland is visited by a Big UFO. Two friendly aliens come out and tells the Snorks all about their fun planet and what they can do there. Occy realizes that something isn't right, and so does Snip and Snap. Actually, these aliens are really Bigweed and Little Seaweed trying to get Snorks for prisoners. All-Star and Daffney goes with them to check out their so-called planet ""Seaturn"". Snip and Snap find out that the aliens are indeed Bigweed and Little Seaweed and tell Jo-Jo all about them.

programme.title: Chills, Drills and Spills - S03E21
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — In the Snork Pole, a giant oil drill trashes the town. The Snorks, while visiting Espy, travel to the source of the problem- an oil rig boat. Casey and Daffney try to talk some sense to the mean captain, but he tells them to get lost. The Snorks go back to the boat and try to stop the drill, but the Capatin dismisses them again. The Snorks try to throw a rock in the works and it's a success. The captain goes down and gets the rocks off the drill. The Snorks try to stop the captain because his air tube is getting wrapped around the drill. They end up saving the Captain and Espy gets the captain to go elsewhere to drill for oil. Hopefully he has learned a lesson about kindness towards others.

programme.title: The Longest Shortcut - S03E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks are being chased by big slugs. They go in a cave and try to find a way out. All-Star encourages them all of stick together, but Junior says it's every Snork for itself. The Snorks meet a creature who tells them that the only way in or out of the cave is the way they came in. They also find out that the forest is a bad place to go and the Snorks look for them. They learn of a Puffer Dragon and are more worried. Tooter and Occy scare Junior, but they are scared themselves by a puffer dragon. The puffer dragon starts chasing them, but Casey wants to pull the cork out of its head to get rid of it. They finally find a way out.

programme.title: Willie and Smallstar's Big Adventure - S03E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior, Casey, All-Star and Daffney go on a camping trip. Willie and Smallstar wants to go, but Junior tells them that they are too little. They try to prove the older kids wrong by going on their own camping trip. Meanwhile, Junior forgets a Snork light and goes back to get it, only to find Willie and Smallstar missing. They go out to search for them. It turns out that they really can take care of themselves after all, because every creature they meet they fight off. The older kids get themselves in a lobster trap and they call for help. Willie and Smallstar come to their rescue and the Snorks learn a lesson in judging others' abilities because of their size.

programme.title: Taming of the Snork - S03E24
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — An emperor employs Galeo's help in taming his daughter princess Shari. The Snorks visit her in order to get her to act right. Shari is playing practical jokes on them. Junior says that it would take a person as nasty as Shari to get her to see the error of her ways. All-Star and Casey agree and hire Junior to carry out this task. Shari then sees that she is mean and runs off when the truth stares her right in the face. She gets kidnapped by a wampalong who is looking for a princess to marry. The Snorks outsmart the Wampalong by switching brides. Shari maks a promise to be kind and beloved to others.

programme.title: A Snork in a Gilded Cage - S03E25
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Snorks find a little Snaillike creature and a lot of other things as well. They catch him and take them back to Snorkland. Daffney says that it's not right to trap animals, but All-Star learns how right she is when he is captured by a big baby creature. The baby locks him in a small trunk and the Snorks get him out. The baby captures them again, but the baby's momma lets them go saying that he plays too roughly. After this experience, the Snorks let all the animals that they captured go.

programme.title: The Snorkshire Spooking - S03E26
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Governor buys the Snorkshire estate, unaware that the place is haunted. Junior bets that they cannot stand a chance staying the night. While Junior scares them, there are real ghosts on the prowl. They find a treasure chest, only to be scared off by a monster. The ghosts are chased out too, but they are friendly ghosts who just want to keep the treasure. The ghosts and the Snorks go back to the house and find out that Bigweed was behind this caper the whole time. The Snorks and the ghost devise a terrific plan to get rid of the Seaweed thieves.

programme.title: Daffney's Not So Great Escape - S04E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — While looking for both Daffney and Tooter, All-Star, Casey and Corky are caught by three ogres and are used as bait. They buy time while Daffney and Tooter try their best to get help. Daffney then disguises herself as a ghost to help her friends. Her plan fails and the ogres start arguing over who's gonna eat who. The Snorks escape to safety. Daffney finds out that she can do anything if she puts her mind to it.

programme.title: Willie's Best Fiend - S04E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A bored Willie finds a creature named Lizzy and they play together, unknowing that she is a snorkeater. This makes Junior and his family very nervous and they think that Lizzy is evil. When they leave for her house, the family thinks that Willie has been kidnapped. Lizzy wants him to meet her folks, but her folks want to eat him. Lizzy tries to tell them that a Snork can make an excellent best friend and they escape. The Snorks and the Snorkeaters start arguing, but they work together wwhen Willie and Lizzy get in trouble.

programme.title: Dr. Strangesnork's Bomb - S04E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Galeo is made Assistant Governor by Governor Wetworth because of his many inventions. His brother, Dr. Strangesnork, is jealous of him. He decides to use a Snorkfish bomb on the Snorks. His cat tries to tell Corky about the impending danger. The governor gets a package and Corky opens it. The Snorkfish smell is let out by a small bomb sampler. Dr. Strangesnork wants to be the new governor of Snorkland but if he destroys Snorkland, his lab will be destroyed, too. He hasn't thought of those things and the Snorks try their best to find the bomb. Dr. Strangesnork remembers that he hid the bomb in Junior's statue. The bomb does not go off because he didn't arm it! Talk about stupid criminals!

programme.title: Day of the Juniors - S04E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Junior wants to make a lot of money, but he wonders how he can be in two places at one time. A peddler who was refused by Galeo gives Casey a multiplying formula. Junior gets a hold of the formula and produces three Juniors out of photographs. The three Juniors do his work for him, but then things get out of hand when the doubles sell Junior's stuff and get him in trouble. He employs Galeo's help to turn his doubles back into pictures again.

programme.title: Ooze Got the Snorks - S04E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Corky and Jo-Jo are travelling through and they see the Seaweeds trying to release the Big Ooze, which will destroy Snorkland. They get there too late and the Ooze is set free. The Ooze takes over Snorkland and uses electricity to get big. The Ooze also tricks the Seaweeds into getting in a cave where he has captured the Snorks. All-Star brings all the Snorks together to stop the Ooze. Bigweed agrees to help them out against his will. The Snorks get out of their jail by tricking the Ooze, and they swim for a sunken ship. They use his electric power to power the ship and make him shrink down to size. When Bigweed reneges on his word, the Snorks get him.

programme.title: Many Different Resolves - S01E18

programme.title: Wave of Determination - S01E19
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — The two princes' daring plan to rescue Shirayuki and Kazuki is put into motion, requiring brains, brawn, and not a little derring-do.

programme.title: The Temperature of a Smile, a Cherished Place - S01E20
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Shirayuki and the others visit the village of the Lions of the Mountain, where they have a party to celebrate their victory.

programme.title: When I'm With You... - S01E21

programme.title: The Spring of Intent Will Quench Your Thirst - S01E22

programme.title: The Future Because of Who You Are - S01E23

programme.title: My Story, My Path - S01E24
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Sakaki visits Shirayuki on behalf of Prince Raj to inform her that she now dons the official title of "friend of the crown" of Tanbarun. Zen and Shirayuki share their feelings with one another.

programme.title: Encounter... Changing the Color of Fate - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Prince Raj wants to make Shirayuki his concubine because of her red hair, so she leaves her home in Tanbarun and ends up with a fateful encounter.

programme.title: Following the Sound of Your Heart - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Shirayuki goes to a mountain in search of medicinal herbs and has a run-in with a dangerous stranger. Will she be able to escape his clutches?

programme.title: Shining Time of Promise - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — As Shirayuki continues her studies, Zen overworks himself and discovers that not everyone approves of his relationship with Shirayuki.

programme.title: From the Small Hand, a Burgeoning Concerto Resonates - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — It's time for the exam to become an apprentice court herbalist. Will Shirayuki finally be able to enter the castle in her own right?

programme.title: This Path, the Crystallization of Premonition - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — The soldiers at Fort Laxdo have come down with a strange illness, and Shirayuki helps Zen and the others find the cause.

programme.title: The Back Full of Meaning - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Zen's older brother Izana is back at the castle, and he summons Shirayuki. What does Izana want with her?

programme.title: Let Me Hear the Melody of Your Smile - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Zen tells Shirayuki a story from his past about Izana as Shirayuki deals with having the eyes of the court on her.

programme.title: Memories Draw Spirals of the Past… - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Zen assigns Obi to be Shirayuki's bodyguard and thinks back to when Mitsuhide first came to be his attendant.

programme.title: Feelings that Connect and Reach - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Shirayuki's still a little drunk, but with Obi keeping an eye on her, there's no need to worry…

programme.title: Inexperienced Heart, Going Deeper - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — While at work in the castle, Shirayuki makes friends with a girl named Kiharu and her bird Popo. Can Shirayuki help save Popo's family?

programme.title: Encountering… A Color for the First Time - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — After Zen and Shirayuki's encounter at the watchtower, Shirayuki discovers feelings that she didn't know she had.

programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — It's Open Castle Day, when the public is allowed into a corner of the castle, and Shirayuki and the others join in the festivities.

programme.title: The Red that Spins Fate - S01E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2015 · TV-14 — Shirayuki's busy cleaning up the medical wing when Mihaya pays a visit to the castle, and she gets an unexpected invitation from Tanbarun.
