programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — With Moltar on the run, Space Ghost is forced to recruit Tansut as his fill-in director, who causes problems before bringing out guests Kirk Hammett and James Hetfield of Metallica.

programme.title: Late Show - S03E12
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Late Show with David Letterman writers scripted this spoof of late-night talk show convention. Janeane Garofalo reveals her secret power then hypnotist Flip Orley joins Space Ghost until Zorak turns him into David Grohl of the Foo Fighters.

programme.title: Cookout - S03E13
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — After a show open that features Moltar and Zorak arguing the respective merits of Beefaroni and Beefaghetti, Space Ghost enlists the Council of Doom to judge a cooking competition between three nationally-acclaimed culinary experts.

programme.title: Art Show - S03E14
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Performance artist Laurie Anderson riles Space Ghost by revealing that she never watches television, then waxes conspiratorial about cyberspace. Space Ghost endeavors to understand members of the performance troupe Stomp.

programme.title: Woody Allen's Fall Project - S03E15
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — In an apparent tribute to E! Entertainment's well-publicized re-enactments of the O.J. Simpson hearings, viewers are treated to performances of selected moments by the Ghost Planet Dinner Theater Ensemble of Doraville, GA.

programme.title: Rehearsal - S04E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — It's the rehearsal prior to the first episode of Space Ghost Coast to Coast, and no one seems ready at all.

programme.title: Gallagher - S04E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost introduces Space Time Quiz Fun 9000 and his contestants, David Cross and Bob Odenkirk. What follows is a rapid-fire conversation as Odenkirk's growing addiction to power-band blasts results in a steady volley from Space Ghost.

programme.title: Edelweiss - S04E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Zorak is zapped until he can no longer regenerate leaving Space Ghost without a bandleader. Moltar is instructed to fill in for his friend by singing renditions of German folk songs, which puts Beck, the show's lone guest, to sleep.

programme.title: Anniversary - S04E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost marks a special notch in the belt that is the Space Ghost saga with returning guests Bobcat Goldthwait and Judy Tenuta. It includes special appearances by villian-turned-announcer Tansut and the evil Chad Ghostal.

programme.title: Zoltran - S04E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost chats with Robin Leach until he reveals he is a villain named Zoltran. Zoltran blasts Space Ghost by shooting lasers out of his eyes. It doesn't get easier as Merrill Markoe needles him about his age and intergalactic location.

programme.title: Pilot - S04E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Lokar presents a look at the talk show's original pilot, "Birdman Coast to Coast," starring Birdman as host before Space Ghost took the job.

programme.title: Speck - S04E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Reggae star Jimmy Cliff chats with Space Ghost about his new album and touring in South America. Moltar and mechanic-turned-musician Jack Logan share a creepy conversation about items underneath their beds.

programme.title: Zorak - S04E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost presents a tribute to Zorak. Dr. Maxcy Nolan speculates the bandleader may be hiding an extra set of legs under his vest. Exterminator Steve Arnold reveals he says take this before going after insects.

programme.title: Switcheroo '97 - S04E09
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost's sidekicks have hosted a convention behind his back. Moltar and Zorak bring out their own guests Bill Mumy and Mark Hamill. In a jealous rage, Space Ghost announces plans for Space Ghost Con '97, vowing to exclude his co-stars.

programme.title: Mayonnaise - S04E10
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — While attempting to introduce Jon Stewart to the wonders of aroma therapy, Moltar accidentally cuts off his oxygen.

programme.title: Brilliant Number One - S04E11
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost keeps blaming his bad luck and clumsiness on fictitious characters. Every few seconds, a new line from "Antony and Cleopatra" by William Shakespeare appears on the bottom of the screen.

programme.title: Boo Boo Kitty - S04E12
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Self-heralded comedy ghetto resident Michael McKean barely gets a word in with Space Ghost, and David Lander suffers a similar fate. Zorak and Space Ghost's roommate tiff spilling over into the show. A blimp hovers around Ghost Planet.

programme.title: Needledrop - S04E13
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Even though two prominent rappers, Ice-T and Ernie-C, make their 'Space Ghost Coast to Coast' debut, Space Ghost decides to do the 'hip shake' throughout the show. Zorak attempts to hypnotize all the guests, including actor Fred Willard.

programme.title: Sphinx - S04E14
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — 'Beavis and Butthead' and 'King of the Hill' creator Mike Judge kindly asks Space Ghost to 'whack the Rugrats.' Space Ghost agrees to the job, as long as he can get onto one of Judge's shows.

programme.title: Pavement - S04E15
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Indie rock group Pavement, sitting in for an incarcerated Zorak and The Original Way-Outs, makes history as the first band ever to perform on Space Ghost Coast to Coast.

programme.title: Untitled - S04E16
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost, an unofficial member of the P-Funk Mob, sets the groove in motion with George Clinton, but Moltar attempts to wrest the show from Space Ghost's control so he can interview his hero and the star of TV's 'CHiPs,' Erik Estrada.

programme.title: Hipster - S04E17
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost's identical twin brother, Chad, takes over the show and interviews The Millionaire and Sam Butera. Eventually, the police surround the studio and order Chad to come out with his hands up. After Chad bolts, Moltar and Zorak decide to go on a road trip.

programme.title: Piledriver - S04E18
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Grandpa Space Ghost, whose physique is identical to his grandson's and whose voice is identical to WCW wrestler Macho Man Randy Savage, gives an 'Oooo-Yeeaaahhh!' performance despite being clubbed with a chair by Zorak.

programme.title: Suckup - S04E19
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost kisses up to the host of Talk Soup so he can get a better gig.

programme.title: Dam - S04E20
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost Coast to Coast welcomes its first-ever Academy Award winner, Charlton Heston, who, after much prodding, offers his trophy to Space Ghost.

programme.title: Boatshow - S04E21
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — The deep space set comes alive like never before with 11 glorious musical numbers. Space Ghost, Zorak and Moltar are joined by Brak, who performs a melodic Man on the Street duet with the originator of the popular skit, Steve Allen.

programme.title: Brilliant Number Two - S04E22
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost keeps blaming his bad luck and clumsiness on fictitious characters.

programme.title: Telethon - S04E23
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — When the Council of Doom takes your phone calls and the only caller is Brak posing as Seymour Hiney, you know your telethon is in trouble. It takes Space Ghost until the telethon's ending to realize his show is completely bankrupt for good!

programme.title: Dimethylpyrimidinol Bisulfite - S04E24
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost and Zorak try to endorse ointment and potted meat to the home viewing audience. Pat Boone sings Space Ghost's praises, while rapper Chuck D is not impressed with the public-service rap performance by the Rappin' Space Goblin.

programme.title: Joshua - S04E25
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — A parody of corporate videos with a brief appearance at the end of two winners of a haiku contest.

programme.title: Terminal - S05E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost announces he is dying and begins to look for someone to replace him. To confirm the grim prognosis, Dr. Drew Pinsky appears on the show. Zorak becomes excited and begins playing New Orleans jazz, which gets him zapped.

programme.title: Toast - S05E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — After Space Ghost declares his love for Merill Markoe, he receives advice from Adam Corolla. Knowing Space Ghost is smitten, Zorak begins to do everything in his power to win Merrill Markoe as his own, leading to a battle between the two.

programme.title: Lawsuit - S05E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost is the target of a lawsuit filed against him by former co-stars Jan and Jace. The twins employ the services of the infamous Dr. Nightmare to represent their case. Space Ghost acquires attorney Greta Van Susteren.

programme.title: Cahill - S05E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — A vicious storm on Ghost Planet has Space Ghost scared silly. (Note: The episode's name comes from the show's editor, Michael Cahill)

programme.title: Warren - S05E05
programme.desc:
Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost grows angry upon learning that he has been 'imposternated' on Warren's television program, so he goes with Moltar and Zorak to confront him. Warren is actually a very bitter bush. We then meet an evil replica of Space Ghost, or is it Gary Owens...
Note: The premiere airing was an extended edit in which the same events played out three times in a row, running for 35 minutes without commercial breaks. The shorter, 12 minute version was first aired on September 6, 1998. The longer version was later released on "The 1998 Episodes" DVD.

programme.title: Warren (Short Version) - S05E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost grows angry upon learning that he has been 'imposternated' on Warren's television program, so he goes with Moltar and Zorak to confront him. Warren is actually a very bitter bush. We then meet an evil replica of Space Ghost, or is it Gary Owens...(this is the short version, which does not loop 3 times)

programme.title: Chinatown - S05E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — This one starts out with the credits running early. There is a dog for a director, and Zorak plays the organ bag. Space Ghost blasts him. Moltar is at the ballpark, and there is talk about ""ra for Re"" (The Sun God?), and a guy named Roger is mentioned. Space Ghost interrupts Tyra because Zorak messed up the note cards. Zorak sings a crime song, and talks about hot chicks. We then find out that Moltar is at a foreign ballgame. The dog is in the ship, where there is loud music. They take the dog and trade for Moltar, and the crowd hoorays.

programme.title: Rio Ghosto - S05E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Pursuing a movie career, Space Ghost seeks advice from the director of 'Mall Rats,' Kevin Smith, and actor Ben Stiller. Hollywood director Jim Jarmusch also makes an appearance.

programme.title: Pal Joey - S05E09
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Joey, an overzealous ex-intern, annoys Space Ghost with his antics. In retribution, Space Ghost destroys the pest and shuttles his corpse into outer space for disposal.

programme.title: Curses - S05E10
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost is afflicted by the Curse of Kintave and is driven to eat all of his guests. In the end, even Zorak and Moltar cannot escape his ravenous appetite. The svelte Shirley Manson is spared, since she's not much of a meal.

programme.title: Intense Patriotism - S05E11
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost attempts to take Ghost Planet to the United States, and consequently focuses the show on various aspects of America. Zorak fools Space Ghost into thinking that his mantis droppings are his children.

programme.title: Waiting for Edward - S05E12
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Denis Leary with questions like, "Are you a leprechaun?" Moltar destroys Ghost Planet and Space Ghost subsequently appears at a day camp, explaining how he saved Christmas.

programme.title: Chambraigne - S06E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost's obsession with hair care products gets him into trouble when he lathers up with Chambraigne, the shampoo for your brain. Space Ghost tries to convince Bob Costas and the world that Chambraigne truly is an intelli-hancer.

programme.title: Snatch - S06E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — The comedy stakes are high when Space Ghost, Moltar, Zorak and guest Steven Wright are stalked by body-snatching pods. Show producers auctioned off the ending of this episode on eBay.

programme.title: Girl Hair - S06E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Members of Hanson have long hair and Space Ghost is obsessed with combing it. Special appearances by the Tooth Fairy and Santa.

programme.title: Sequel - S06E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — After Space Ghost has been sent to the slammer for years of mistreating Jan and Jace, Birdman is called upon to guest host the show, but spends most of his time lamenting an impending divorce from his wife Galaxy Girl, a.k.a. Sylvia. This is a sequel to "Lawsuit".

programme.title: Curling Flower Space - S06E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Jerry Springer and Sarah Jessica Parker nearly get trampled in this bizarre romp through the minds of Space Ghost, Moltar and Zorak.

programme.title: Table Read - S06E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — The show's voice actors and writers rehearse (in live-action) the episode Fire Ant.

programme.title: Fire Ant - S06E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost and talk show host Conan O'Brien are engaged in riveting and witty repartee when a fire ant bites Space Ghost and everything goes Dada. When first aired, the episode featured a 10-minute sequence in which Space Ghost crawls after an ant over various backgrounds.

programme.title: King Dead - S06E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Jon Benjamin, voice of Ben Katz on Comedy Central's "Dr. Katz,"guests on a show that features rare appearances by Brak and Tansut.

programme.title: Fire Ant (Short Version) - S06E09
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost and talk show host Conan O'Brien are engaged in riveting and witty repartee when a fire ant bites Space Ghost and everything goes Dada.

programme.title: Snatch (Alternate Ending) - S06E10
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Ghost Planet Industries is attacked by replicating pods. The kind that copy your DNA, kill you off, and take over while you sleep. This is the re-aired short version without the Colonial Man eBay ending. This is not the premiere episode.

programme.title: Kentucky Nightmare - S07E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost loses the show to the owner of a liquor store and is forced to use a shark as the show's mascot. A bear wanders onto the set, upsetting the normal routine by attacking Space Ghost. The shark explodes attracting giant Space Bees.

programme.title: The Justice Hole - S07E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost has a temper tantrum and he leaves the show. While he's gone, Zorak, Moltar and Dave Thomas have a great time. Meanwhile, Space Ghost tries to make friends with the superheroes at the Hole of Justice, but they beat him up.

programme.title: Knifin' Around - S07E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Moltar gets his chance to host the show while Space Ghost illegally copies the new Radiohead album. Later, it is revealed that Space Ghost is married to Bjork. Space Ghost ends the episode by knocking her off of a cliff.

programme.title: Flipmode - S07E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost is hosting a mystery dinner theater and the guest star is Busta Rhymes. After causing a massive gas leak, Space Ghost beats Zorak senseless a number of times. Later, they end up at a grocery store, confusing it for a hospital.

programme.title: Sweet For Brak - S07E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost reveals he's annoyed at the success of Brak's spin-off "The Brak Show". Zorak gets his own pilot, "Blood Dumpster", where he chases Space Ghost down a drainage pipe while wielding all sorts of blades.

programme.title: Mommentary - S07E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Special edition of the episode Kentucky Nightmare with commentary provided by the show producers' mothers.

programme.title: Mommentary (2): Creator's Commentary - S07E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — The S.G writers commentate on their mothers' commentary

programme.title: Mommentary (3): Jellybean - S07E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Special edition of "Momentary" with new commentary from the shows producers.

programme.title: Baffler Meal - S08E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost reconsiders his decision to work with a trio of fast-food restaurant mascots, the Aqua Teens, in an attempt to appeal to the hunger in young teens.

programme.title: Whipping Post - S08E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost is angry about a variety of topics, and rants mightily to his guest, comedian Dennis Miller.

programme.title: Eat a Peach - S08E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Moltar and Zorak compete for Space Ghost's attention, while Space Ghost is more concerned with the safety of comedian Todd Barry's automobile.

programme.title: In Memory of Elizabeth Reed - S08E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost welcomes fellow intergalactic entertainer William Shatner, but their interview is cut short when Space Ghost is called into action to take part in an epic space battle.

programme.title: Idlewild South - S08E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost gets hammered during his interview with Jeff Probst, the host of TV's "Survivor".

programme.title: Dreams - S08E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost gets down and dirty with Triumph, the dog who loves to piss everyone off.

programme.title: Live at the Filmore - S08E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost ends up in jail, so once again Zorak and Moltar bail him out with the show's budget.

programme.title: Billy Mitchell - S09E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Billy Mitchell, the first person to reach a perfect score in Pac-Man and Donkey Kong score record holder.

programme.title: Rand Miller - S09E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Rand Miller, creator of Myst.

programme.title: Kenny Wayne Shepherd - S09E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Blues musician Kenny Wayne Shepherd is interviewed.

programme.title: Al Acorn - S09E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — "Mr. pong", Allan Alcorn, is interviewed.

programme.title: Steve Wozniak - S09E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Steve Wozniak, co-founder of Apple.

programme.title: Rob Fulop - S09E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Rob Fulop, creator of several hit Atari 2600 titles such as Demon Attack.

programme.title: Howard Warshaw - S09E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Howard Warshaw, designer of E.T on the Atari 2600, often called "the worst game ever made".

programme.title: Wayne Coyne - S09E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Wayne Coyne, lead singer of the Flaming Lips, is interviewed.

programme.title: Richard Garriott - S10E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Richard Garriott.

programme.title: Stephen Bristow - S10E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews Stephen Bristow.

programme.title: David Crane - S10E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews David Crane, a prolific game programmer who started work on the Atari 2600 and continued all the way up to the controversial Night Trap.

programme.title: Chantal Claret from Morningwood - S10E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Lead singer of the band Morningwood, Chantal Claret, is interviewed.

programme.title: Dee Snider from Twisted Sister - S10E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews the lead singer of twisted Sister, Dee Snider.

programme.title: Barenaked Ladies - S10E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost interviews the Barenaked Ladies.

programme.title: Spanish Translation - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — After declaring his fondness for Mexican food, Space Ghost asks diet guru Susan Powter what superpowers help stop the insanity. Comedian Kevin Meaney discusses the virtues of wearing tight pants, and the Bee Gees stop by for a visit.

programme.title: Gilligan - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Three stranded castaways, Bob Denver (Gilligan), Dawn Wells (Mary Ann) and Russell Johnson (the Professor), take their turns in the video monitor.

programme.title: Elevator - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Self-proclaimed goddess of the galaxy, Judy Tenuta and Space Ghost decide to visit the Elvis Chapel in Las Vegas. Space Ghost talks with Dr. Timothy Leary, a man branded by Nixon as the most dangerous man alive. It's tacos for everybody.

programme.title: CHiPs - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost welcomes two talk-show experts, Bill Carter and Joe Franklin. Carter, author of The Late Shift, explains why Space Ghost was excluded from his book. Franklin, the world's first TV talk show host, gives him a few pointers.

programme.title: Bobcat - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — During an otherwise friendly interview with comedian Bobcat Goldthwait, Zorak reveals Space Ghost's secret identity. Goldthwait agrees to party with Space Ghost after the show. The festivities are spoiled by Zorak and his punk friends.

programme.title: Banjo - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost is nurturing a special pet--Banjo the sea monkey. Zorak sabotages the interview with Schooly D by hypnotically controlling Space Ghost's mind.

programme.title: Punch - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — After model Cyndi Guyer, the female Fabio, explains what she looks for in a man, the Jerky Boys arrive and promptly threaten to punch Space Ghost in the mouth. The undertow of violence subsides with the appearance of model Dian Parkinson.

programme.title: Batmantis - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — A mysterious villain kidnaps Moltar and Space Ghost must solicit the help of Adam West, Lee Meriweather and Eartha Kitt, all from the Batman television series, in an effort to save him. And Space Ghost, it's Zorak as Batmantis!

programme.title: Self Help - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost welcomes Dr. Joyce Brothers, who ends up being more concerned about him. Later, comic Rich Hall gives Space Ghost pointers on how to pick up women that are immediately used by Zorak and Moltar to impress author Anka Radakovich.

programme.title: Gum, Disease - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — The rapport between Branford Marsalis and Space Ghost makes it look as though the band leader of The Tonight Show might be switch shows. Danny Bonaduce talks about his days with the Partridge family and his deep-seated hatred for Osmonds.

programme.title: President's Day Nightmare - S02E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost shows off his versatility by emceeing Cartoon Network's World Premiere Toon In. Members of the Council of Doom appear as judges in a beauty pageant-style competition between five cartoon directors. Blip also makes an appearance.

programme.title: Story Book House - S02E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Lokar hosts a clip show while Space Ghost visits his mother in Florida.

programme.title: Girlie Show - S02E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost pays tribute to Women in the Entertainment Industry. Fran Drescher paralyzes Space Ghost with desire. Carol Channing dispenses advice to soothe his heart but this comfort is ruined by the appearance of rocker Alice Cooper.

programme.title: Hungry - S02E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — Space Ghost welcomes shiny happy Michael Stipe from R.E.M. He shares time-honored difficult-places-to-reach-while-scratching-stories with Lassie. Mujibur and Sirajul mysteriously appear with Space Ghost's pizza.

programme.title: Fire Drill - S02E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1994 · TV-14 — David Byrne of the Talking Heads makes a striking revelation to Space Ghost. Later, Space Ghost attempts to get to the root of the feud between former teen idols Donny Osmond and earlier guest Danny Bonaduce.

programme.title: Change - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — Tim is fired after taking his diappointment in The Phantom Menace out on a young customer. Meanwhile, Daisy struggles to claim her dole money from the job centre.

programme.title: Mettle - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — Sinister sabotage seriously threatens Mike and Tim's chances of winning Robot Wars, while Daisy gets a job in Hell's Kitchen and Brian faces the terrifying prospect of an exhibition.

programme.title: Help - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — Tim faces a race against time when Daisy accidentally jeopardises his career. Elsewhere, Daisy and Marsha decide to get fit, and Brian decides to tell his mother the truth about his chosen career.

programme.title: Gone - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — A night on the town for Tim and Daisy turns into a fight for survival as the dynamic duo come face to face with an old enemy (not to mention a few new ones).

programme.title: Dissolution - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — It's Daisy's birthday but all is not well at 23 Meteor Street. The survival of the group is threatened when Marsha begins to suspect things between Daisy and Tim are not what they seem...

programme.title: Leaves - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — With Marsha gone and the house up for sale, Daisy and Tim hatch a plan to save themselves and their friends from oblivion. However, has Daisy had enough? And does Tim really care?

programme.desc: Action · 1999 · TV-MA — Tim was a broken-hearted skateboarder, Daisy a directionless, wannabe journalist. Fate kicked them onto the streets to meet for the first time in a greasy spoon.

programme.title: Blood Brothers - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus puts a plan in motion to weaken Crassus forces and gain the upper hand. Betrayal threatens to foil the plan.

programme.title: Spoils of War - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — As Crassus leads an onslaught against the rebel-occupied city, Gannicus finds himself trapped behind enemy lines. Tiberius is tasked by Crassus to hold a celebration in honor of a man he despises.

programme.title: Mors Indecepta - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Their forces trapped on an impassable, snowbound ridge, Spartacus and Crixus clash over the method of escape. Crassus discovers it increasingly difficult to control the actions of those closest to him.

programme.title: Separate Paths - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus and the rebels arrive at a crossroads. With the relentless Crassus driving his men hard in the pursuit of Spartacus, the conflict between Tiberius and Caesar escalates.

programme.title: The Dead and the Dying - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Crassus learns that a fellow prominent Roman is attempting to steal the glory of defeating Spartacus; Spartacus aims to secure a bargaining chip he can use against the Romans.

programme.title: Victory - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus and his outnumbered rebels make one last attempt to win freedom in a final battle against the Romans led by Marcus Crassus.

programme.title: The Red Serpent - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — The Romans, in an effort to protect their homeland, seek the help of Thracian warrior Spartacus and his team of fighters. After a violent incident, Spartacus must enter the gladiator ring to face his punishment from the Romans.

programme.title: Sacramentum Gladiatorum - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Enslaved in gladiatorial school, the newly christened Spartacus must try to suppress his desire for vengeance when his new master promises to reunite him with his wife.

programme.title: Legends - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Though Spartacus proved himself during training and now wears the attire of a gladiator, his coarse attitude and relentless quest to see his wife isolates him from his fellow gladiators and Doctore.

programme.title: The Thing in the Pit - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Having performed shamefully in the arena against Crixus, Spartacus is forced to fight in the Pits. Batiatus, determined to profit from Spartacus, may be at risk if his debts aren't repaid.

programme.title: Shadow Games - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Batiatus is presented with a gladiatorial opportunity of a lifetime. Spartacus and Crixus must overcome their mutual hostility to fight as a team against a legendary and unbeaten opponent.

programme.title: Delicate Things - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Lies, distrust and duplicity plague the house of Batiatus and impact the hopes of both Barca and Spartacus, who have benefited from good fortune and envision a future away from the grounds. Barca expects to buy his and his male lover's way out, while Spartacus anticipates his promised reunion with his enslaved wife, part of his reward for a monumental victory in the arena. But just in case things go wrong, Spartacus dreams and schemes an escape plan.

programme.title: Great and Unfortunate Things - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Overcome by the pressure of Batiatus's control, Spartacus must make a choice: leave his past behind and assume the mantle of a champion gladiator, or die.

programme.title: Mark of the Brotherhood - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Batiatus purchases a fresh batch of slaves during an auction to be trained as gladiators and ponders the idea of selling Crixus.

programme.title: Whore - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Batiatus breaks the news that Spartacus is to service the richest woman in Rome.

programme.title: Party Favors - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Numerius is honored with an exhibition match for his birthday celebration at the ludus. Ilithyia gives Numerius a surprising gift, but asks for something in return.

programme.title: Old Wounds - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus hovers on the brink. Meanwhile, Batiatus plots revenge against his enemies

programme.title: Revelations - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Lucretia and Batiatus await the arrival of Glaber with the intentions to receive his patronage, while Spartacus focuses his attention on his plan for revenge.

programme.title: Kill Them All - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — In the season finale, Spartacus enlists the help of an accomplice in order to get his revenge.

programme.title: Fugitivus - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus realizes that becoming the leader of a mass of freed slaves can be challenging and he struggles to keep the rebellious group intact when news of Claudius Glaber's arrival in Capua reaches him.

programme.title: A Place in This World - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus and his men liberate a Roman villa, but its slaves are wary. Oenomaus throws himself into the brutal Pits, and Glaber supports Lucretia’s prophecies, despite Ilithyia’s protests.

programme.title: The Greater Good - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus is forced to mediate when the gladiators are close to divide into groups after news of Naevia's fate reaches them. Lucretia exchanges a long-held secret for some information and an attack puts the rebels at risk.

programme.title: Empty Hands - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus seeks the safety of the woods for his surviving men while Crixus finds himself revisiting past horrors. Meanwhile, Lucretia spies Ilithyia's affairs.

programme.title: Libertus - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — In an ironic twist of fate, a gladiator from the house of Batiatus will stand in the way of Spartacus trying to free Crixus from Roman captivity. Ilithyia's scheming puts her marriage to Glaber at risk.

programme.title: Chosen Path - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus and his rebels train hard to keep their new sanctuary safe while Glaber's forces are made stronger with the enlistment of some new deadly recruits. Lucretia and Ilithyia become close again.

programme.title: Sacramentum - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus and his group of rebels attempt to free those who became slaves by falling in foreign wars while Lucretia manages to recruit one of her husband's former gladiators.

programme.title: Balance - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — While Spartacus finds an opportunity to get revenge, Glaber is surrounded by intrigue.

programme.title: Monsters - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2010 · TV-MA — Spartacus has to once again use his leadership skills to convince his band of rebels to unite against the Roman assault. Lucretia struggles to get rid of those men standing in the way of her fate.

programme.title: Dr. Juice - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso helps sisters make fresh orange juice.

programme.title: For Your Nose Only - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso teaches a boy how to blow his nose and wash his hands afterward.

programme.title: The Man With the Golden Retriever - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso teaches a girl how to safely greet a dog.

programme.title: The Chairs Are Not Enough - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso shows twins how to play musical chairs.

programme.title: Quantum of Sandwich - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso teaches a boy how to make a peanut-butter-and-jelly sandwich.

programme.title: Thunder Muffin - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso helps a girl make carrot muffins for a school bake sale.

programme.title: Colors Royale - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso shows a girl how to mix yellow and blue paint to make green.

programme.title: Cleanfingers - S02E18
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso teaches a boy the importance of washing his hands before eating dinner.

programme.title: A View to a Mask - S02E19
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso helps a boy make a Halloween mask.

programme.title: Pumpkin Eyes - S02E20
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Oso carves a pumpkin for Halloween.

programme.title: The Living Holiday Lights Part 1 - S02E21
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Special Agent Oso is anxious to receive a special holiday assignment and be awarded a special present. However, he is a bit worried that Agents Dotty and Wolfie don't seem to have time to spend with him. Not only that, Oso doesn't even have a family of his own. The biggest surprise is that Oso doesn't just have one special holiday assignment--he has three! Each one consisting of a different winter holiday to celebrate with family. First, Oso travels to France to help a girl named Celeste put up the advent wreath for Christmas. Next, he helps a Jewish boy in Israel named Noah set up the menorah for Hanukkah. Finally, Oso heads to the United States to help a boy named Braden set up the kinara for Kwanza. Will Oso complete all three assignments in time and receive his special holiday gift?

programme.title: The Living Holiday Lights Part 2 - S02E22
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Professor Bufo has asked Oso to come to the space center for help. Bufo accidentally locked himself in the rocket and Oso must get the keys to unlock the door. He finds the keys and tries looking for the right one to unlock the rocket when Paw Pilot calls in a special alert. Oso helps a boy, Liam, make snow angels to show his grandma. Will Liam and Oso be able to make the angels in the snow before Liam's grandma leaves for the airport?

programme.title: For Angels With Snow - S02E23
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Professor Bufo has asked Oso to come to the space center for help. Bufo accidentally locked himself in the rocket and Oso must get the keys to unlock the door. He finds the keys and tries looking for the right one to unlock the rocket when Paw Pilot calls in a special alert. Oso helps a boy, Liam, make snow angels to show his grandma. Will Liam and Oso be able to make the angels in the snow before Liam's grandma leaves for the airport?

programme.title: Dr. Snow - S02E24
programme.desc: Action · 2009 · TV-Y — Dotty teaches Oso how to use a special agent cable jacket to go down a tube and open a door. Oso receives a special alert after opening the wrong door and getting covered with ping pong balls. He helps a boy named Ethan make a snow globe so he can watch snowflakes fall whenever he wants. Will Ethan get his snow globe made before bedtime?

programme.title: License to Sled - S02E25

programme.title: Live and Let Heal - S02E33

However, neither one knows how to snap as well as Uncle Eric can. Can Oso teach Nicole and Spencer how to snap their fingers before the concert begins?

A girl, Anastasija, is having dinner at a restaurant with her parents. Anastasija wants to order a healthy meal by her self, but she couldn't read the menu. It will be up to Oso to teach her how to order her own dinner.
