programme.title: Timothy & The Rainbow Truck - S18E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bill and Ben tell Timothy he needs to find a truck that is blue and red and yellow and brown. Bill and Ben insist the truck is real, so Timothy sets off to look for it.

programme.title: Marion and the Dinosaurs - S18E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Marion sees some real, live dinosaurs and gets the fright of her life.

programme.title: Samson at Your Service - S18E24
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Samson takes Gordon's express coaches to the Blue Mountain Quarry by mistake and causes confusion and delay. In the end, he realises that he is not too proud to ask for help.

programme.title: Samson Sent for Scrap - S18E25
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Scruff breaks down and has to be sent to the Steamworks, Samson must collect up the track-side scrap. But Samson takes his new responsibilities a little too seriously.

programme.title: Millie & The Volcano - S18E26
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Harvey and the new engine Samson are putting the dinosaur models in place for the Earl's new Dinosaur Park. One of the dinosaurs swings towards Millie and gives her a fright.

programme.title: Who's Geoffrey? - S19E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Thomas invents a new engine to take the blame for an embarrasing accident, everyone wants to know more about `Geoffrey'. He has no troubling with inventing what he looks like, but finds himself in a quandary when the Fat Controller asks to meet the newcomer.

programme.title: The Truth About Toby - S19E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Ignoring Henrietta's constant reminders to fill up with coal, Toby sets off alone for the scrapyard but runs out of coal when he gets there. Among all the scrap, his efforts to attract attention are hard to see. When the other engines do finally spot him, they get the wrong impression and think that he is being scrapped!

programme.title: Lost Property - S19E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The island of Sodor gets a visit from the railway inspectors. Thomas, Annie and Clarabel are keen to show what they can do, but encounter nothing but problems. It looks as though they may get a bad report, until Annie discovers that the really grumpy inspector has left his gold watch on her seat.

programme.title: Henry Spots Trouble - S19E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Henry hears that the Fat Controller's grandchildren have chickenpox and worries whether it can infect engines too - especially when everyone he meets seems to be covered in spots!

programme.title: A Cranky Christmas - S19E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Sir Topham Hatt sends Thomas to the docks to collect a very important Christmas parcel. When unloading the ship, Cranky drops the parcel and fears that he broke the contents within. He hides the parcel, but it's soon found and Thomas sets off to deliver it. When Thomas slips on the icy tracks, he thinks that he broke the contents of the parcel. Sir Topham Hatt opens the parcel and reveals materials for the community's ice skating rink-unbroken!

programme.title: Snow Place Like Home - S19E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Kevin gets stuck in the snow and Victor sets out to rescue Kevin.

programme.title: The Beast of Sodor - S19E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Spencer is stranded on Sodor because of the snowy weather and delights in telling the other engines about meeting the abominable snowman. Henry is frightened by the story and Spencer continues to play on his fear. However, when they encounter a man covered in snow, it's Spencer who is most afraid! Thankfully, the seemingly abominable snowman turns out to be Sir Topham Hatt.

programme.title: Toad & the Whale - S19E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Toad, Oliver's brake van, spots a stranded whale on the beach, the Fat Controller alerts the Search and Rescue Centre, who decide to take it by rail to Brendam Docks where they can release it back into the water. Oliver may not like Toad's singing but it keeps the whale nice and calm en route.

programme.title: Very Important Sheep - S19E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Percy is late collecting some sheep for an agricultural fair and is in such a hurry to get going that he doesn't realise that he has made a hole in the back of his wagon. One by one the sheep escape without Percy realising until Thomas catches up with him.

programme.title: Salty All At Sea - S19E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Salty is being sent to help out at a port on the mainland, but the bridge is out and he must travel by ship. Suddenly all those scary stories about sea monsters that he loves to tell begin to scare him too.

programme.title: Den and Dart - S19E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Best friends Den and Dart work together at the Dieselworks and are rarely separated, but when Mavis has an accident, the Fat Controller sends Den to work at the quarry until she is repaired. Den worries about taking on a new job on his own, especially when Mavis warns him how troublesome the trucks can be.

programme.title: Helping Hiro - S19E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas feels guilty when he accidentally causes Hiro to be derailed and sent to the Steamworks, but when he sets off for the woods in the hope of finding material to speed up the repair work, he forgets to tell anyone where he is going.

programme.title: Slow Stephen - S19E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Stephen, the oldest engine on Sodor, cannot keep pace with the other engines and Gordon hates having to slow down for him.

programme.title: Two Wheels Good - S19E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A mission to take the Duke and Duchess to Callan Castle settles a dispute about the best number of wheels for an engine.

programme.title: Reds vs. Blues - S19E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas is a popular engine on match days because he is the same color as the football team's uniforms.

programme.title: Best Engine Ever - S19E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Emily really admires Caitlin, who shunts her to the castle when she breaks down. But later when Caitlin's brakes fail, Emily has a chance to save her hero from an accident.

programme.title: The Little Engine Who Raced Ahead - S19E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Philip, an energetic diesel boxcab, arrives to work on the Fat Controller's railway and challenges Gordon to race. Philip sets off, unaware that Gordon is not competing.

programme.title: Phillip to the Rescue - S19E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When James pulls a very long train and comes off the rails, Philip races to stop him falling off a bridge.

programme.title: Sidney Sings - S20E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — One day, Percy has an accident and the Fat Controller assigns Sidney to deliver a new set of wheels from the docks. Thomas comes up with a song to remind Sidney of his job, but Sidney gets distracted and he ends up going to numerous other places on the island.

programme.title: Toby's New Friend - S20E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Philip sees Toby for the first time and is under the impression that Toby is a diesel boxcab. He tries to befriend him, but Toby finds him too overwhelming. Philip persists however, insisting they have a race to the quarry, believing that friends have to like all of the same things.

programme.title: Henry Gets the Express - S20E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Gordon is late pulling the express Henry is given the job instead and Gordon has to take goods for the rest of the day, causing much annoyance and turmoil for him.

programme.title: Diesel and the Ducklings - S20E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Diesel struggles to maintain his rough demeanour after he finds some ducklings. Thomas comes across this and blackmails him to behave by threatening to tell 'Arry and Bert about Diesel's ducklings. Diesel tries to be kind, but he becomes split between being threatened by Thomas and looking tough in front of 'Arry and Bert.

programme.title: Bradford the Brake Van - S20E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Troublesome Trucks are causing lots of trouble for poor Thomas. Samson's new brake van Bradford arrives from the Mainland and offers to keep them in order. He does so with skill and all of the engines want to travel with him. Things take a turn for the worse though as Bradford constantly urges the engines to strictly follow the rules, causing delays with their trains.

programme.title: Saving Time - S20E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Samson boasts to the other engines that he has been given a unique and important job by going to the Blue Mountain Quarry, only for Thomas to prove him wrong as he has been given the same task. Determined to prove himself special, Samson tries to save time by taking as many trucks as he can to the docks.

programme.title: Ryan and Daisy - S20E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Fat Controller gives Ryan and Daisy new jobs, but Daisy does not feel like taking on the extra work. To get out of it, she manipulates Ryan into taking care of her new responsibilities. Ryan agrees, but has so many jobs at once that it results in confusion and delay.

programme.title: Pouty James - S20E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — James is showing off too much, so the Fat Controller takes away his coaches, telling him to change his attitude. The others only think he is being sulky. James is shut up in the shed until he promises to behave, though he is being so grumpy about pulling goods trains that he still causes trouble.

programme.title: Blown Away - S20E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When a storm arrives on the Little Western, Skiff tries to warn everyone about the storm. Whilst Captain Joe goes off to check on the pirate ship, Skiff's anchor breaks away and the sailboat is sent running down the branch line until he hits a fallen branch. Meanwhile, Duck and Oliver are tasked with bringing all the passengers home safely and Skiff realises it is up to him to save them and the passengers from certain disaster.

programme.title: The Way She Does It - S20E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Fat Controller asks Daisy to take special passengers, making her so excited she boasts to other engines about it. Her stubbornness to impress them gets in the way and she does not allow any of her other passengers into her, only to find out her special passengers are puppet show managers and her other passengers were going to it.

programme.title: Diesel's Ghostly Christmas (1) - S19E19
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Diesel starts causing trouble at Christmas time and he gets visited by the Ghost of Christmas Past.

programme.title: Diesel's Ghostly Christmas (2) - S19E20
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Diesel now meets up with two other ghostly engines. The Ghost of Christmas Present and the Ghost of Christmas Future, and he later finds the Fat Controller still at Knapford during the Earl's Christmas party at Ulfstead Castle.

programme.title: Letters to Santa - S20E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Percy must deliver Santa's Christmas letters to Vicarstown urgently, but a sack of letters is left behind at Dryaw. Harold tries to take them to Percy, but the little engine only thinks he is only mocking his speed. After a snow heap blocks off a tunnel, Harold takes the mail to Vicarstown instead, but ends up getting stuck on the Mainland afterwards. Percy later finds him and decides to repay Harold for his good deed.

programme.title: Love Me Tender - S20E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Donald and Douglas argue with each-other as they clear snow from the tracks. The argument becomes so heated that the two pull in opposite directions, resulting in Douglas' tender breaking away and Douglas being stranded in the snow. Donald soon realises this and hurries to find his twin.

programme.title: The Railcar and the Coaches - S20E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas is put on quarry duty and there is little passenger traffic on the Harwick Branch Line, so Daisy takes his passengers. Daisy only belittles Annie and Clarabel as she passes by their shed. One day, she has to use them and the coaches get their own back, though their plan does not work as intended.

programme.title: Thomas The Babysitter - S19E21
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas, Annie and Clarabel have to deal with a noisy baby.

programme.title: Rocky Rescue - S19E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Rocky derails, the Sodor Search and Rescue Team have to work together to rescue him.

programme.title: The Other Side of the Mountain - S19E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Bertie is sent on a diversion that passes on the other side of the mountain, Thomas gets jealous that he can't go there.

programme.title: No Help At All - S19E24
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bill and Ben are fed up with Timothy so they trick the Fat Controller into sending Timothy to help at Brendam Docks.

programme.title: Goodbye Fat Controller - S19E25
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Percy overhears some workmen talking and concludes that the Fat Controller is leaving the railway, much to the shock of the other engines.

programme.title: Wild Water Rescue - S19E26
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Percy is to take the Mayor to the Sodor Search and Rescue Centre to celebrate their one-thousandth rescue, but jealous Diesel wants the job and sends Percy to an old quarry.

programme.title: Mucking About - S20E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas enjoys the competition of Max and Monty but begins to question his friendship as Max and Monty mess about while working, affecting Thomas' work. Edward advises Thomas to ignore them. His suspicions prove correct as Max and Monty dump their waste on the rails, causing Thomas to derail.

programme.title: Cautious Connor - S20E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Connor boasts of being a fast engine, but one day, he breaks down on the Island of Sodor and goes to the Steamworks to be repaired. Connor starts to get worried it will happen again if he goes too fast and after that, Connor starts to become the slowest engine on the island. They even start to worry that Connor would never go fast again.

programme.title: All in Vain - S20E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — James is asked to take the Mayor and the Fat Controller to a party at Callan Castle, but has to do other jobs first and every job he does, he gets dirtier and dirtier. He finally has the chance for a washdown, but James is horrified to find a scratch in his paintwork. He goes to the Steamworks for the scratch to be painted, but leaves before the paint dries and is mortified to find leaves, twigs and dust stuck to his paintwork.

programme.title: Buckled Tracks and Bumpy Trucks - S20E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — One sunny day, the tracks buckle and bend and Dowager Hatt gives the Fat Controller a new hat, which everyone calls a safari hat. The Fat Controller gets sick of everyone teasing him and tries to find a way to get rid of it. Meanwhile, a piece of rubbish from Whiff's trucks falls out and lands on the ground causing a fire. Belle derails due to the buckled rails, meaning a solution has to be found.

programme.title: Tit for Tat - S20E18
programme.desc:
Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Based on the story of the same name from Small Railway Engines.
Some visitors come to the island to take photos of engines. They visit the Arlesdale Railway and take pictures of the small engines, but Bert is cross that they will not take pictures of him. As they are driving, they spray Bert with mud and Bert wants to take revenge on them. He devises a plan by giving one of them a soaking ride.

programme.title: Mike’s Whistle - S20E19
programme.desc:
Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Based on the story of the same name from Small Railway Engines.
Duck's driver boils an egg in his whistle, which is now clogged and makes a funny noise. The engines tease Duck about his whistle, especially Mike who says engines without whistles are improper engines. Later, he pulls passengers on the line and encounters a cow. He blows his whistle so hard that it flies far away into a field. Mike insists they look for his lost whistle, but the passengers decide to whistle for him instead.

programme.title: Useful Railway - S20E20
programme.desc:
Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Based on the story of the same name from Small Railway Engines.
Mike is annoyed of always being stuck behind animals, Rex boasts to the small engines about how easy wool deliveries are. The Small Controller gives him the first wool train. Willie the tractor driver accidentally drops his load of wool onto the tracks, which causes Rex to derail.

programme.title: Henry in the Dark - S20E21
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Henry is accidentally given some "glow-in-the-dark" paint at the Steamworks and is confused as to why everyone he comes across runs away from him. It is shown that his paint is glowing and laughs at the misunderstanding. When the others tease him for being a scaredy engine, Henry devises a plan to get them back.

programme.title: Three Steam Engines Gruff - S20E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — One night, Percy is frightened by a strange sound from under the bridge at the Watermill. Toby is worried, though Thomas does not believe it to be true, until he too hears the sound. Toby and Percy believe it is a troll telling the story of how three goats had to cross a bridge with a troll under it. All three engines become terrified of passing the bridge until it is revealed the sound was only coming from a cow stuck under the bridge.

programme.title: Engine of the Future - S20E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When a rail Zeppelin called Hugo comes to Sodor, everyone at first is very impressed. However, Stephen is concerned they will be replaced by engines like Hugo, making the engines worry about their future. They take their anxiety out on Hugo, making him feel unwelcome.

programme.title: Hugo and the Airship - S20E24
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — After word of an airship resembling Hugo spreads, Hugo feels he should be able to fly just like it. He gets some encouragement from Skiff and tries to take off into the sky like an airship on Gordon's Hill, like his non-rail aerial counterpart.

programme.title: The Missing Breakdown Train - S20E25
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Judy and Jerome are upset that they are never taken out any more as Rocky is now the official crane of the island. Ryan, who feels sorry for them, takes Judy and Jerome out for a change of scenery. He takes them to Arlesburgh Harbour which they find boring after a while, leading to Duck and Oliver taking them around the island. Eventually, Daisy has an accident and Ryan has to find them.

programme.title: Skiff and the Mermaid - S20E26
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Skiff hears word of a mermaid statue arriving at a museum at Arlesburgh Harbour, believing it is real. Later on when the Fat Controller and his grandchildren want to have a ride in Skiff, he mistakes a whale's tail in the water for a mermaid and ends up dragging the Fat Controller on him to the sea in search of it. The Fat Controller does not know how to drive him, resulting in the two of them getting stuck on an island at Bluff's Cove.

programme.title: Springtime for Diesel - S21E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Diesel is always bumping into people and laughing, but when he does it to Daisy, her springs need fixing. In the Dieselworks, thinking that she is asleep, Diesel explains why he did it - it's his way of trying to make friends!

programme.title: A Most Singular Engine - S21E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Diesel makes mischief between Daisy and Harvey by telling them both that the other is boasting of being unique. However, the two become friends while assisting each other on a job, and Diesel does not understand why.

programme.title: Dowager Hatt's Busy Day - S21E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — While the Fat Controller is sick, his mother runs the railway and creates chaos by getting everyone to do the wrong jobs! Oblivious to all the mayhem, Dowager Hatt supervises the hanging baskets at Knapford Station - until Emily gets involved.

programme.title: Stuck in Gear - S21E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A branch gets stuck in the open gears of his crane, but Harvey is too shy to ask for help. Instead, he tries to fix it himself and ends up derailing himself inside a tunnel.

programme.title: Runaway Engine - S21E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Millie is given extra work around the estate and gets agitated when Stephen and Glynn forget to clear up the garden waste. When Stephen also manages to hurt her feelings, and can't find her the next day to apologise, he thinks that she must have run away.

programme.title: P.A. Problems - S21E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Fat Controller splashes out on a new public address system, but the engines and passengers are struggling to hear the announcements. Holidaymakers end up at the quarry, quarry workers end up at the beach and Lord Callan ends up with an unexpected delivery of pigs!

programme.title: Hasty Hannah - S21E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — While Henrietta is getting her seats refurbished, Toby is given a replacement carriage named Hannah. However, she is so headstrong and reckless that Toby gets fed up with her urging him to go faster and faster. But when he abandons her and she joins up with James, she learns to her cost that going too fast for a little carriage is not at all wise.

programme.title: Cranky at the End of the Line - S21E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — After Cranky is teased about his age, he works twice as hard and through the night to impress the Fat Controller. But the harder he works, the more mistakes he makes. When a big, new, shiny crane arrives, he thinks that his days at Brendam Docks are over!

programme.title: New Crane on the Dock - S21E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Carly the new crane is so keen that she takes on all the work. After Cranky finds himself with nothing to do, he works harder and faster in a bid to keep up with her. But as the two cranes frantically try to outdo one another, their hooks become entangled and they find themselves stuck fast and unable to move...

programme.title: Unscheduled Stops - S21E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Bertie breaks down while they are racing, Thomas takes on his passengers. One elderly man says that Bertie always drops him off between stops. Soon Thomas is getting requests for lots of other unscheduled stops, which makes him run late and upsets his own passengers and the Fat Controller.

programme.title: Phillip's Number - S21E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When he is teased about having 68 painted on his side, Philip tries to discover why he was given that number. Later, when he manages to avoid an accident after 68 sheep stray onto the line, Philip decides it is his lucky number!

programme.title: The Fastest Red Engine on Sodor - S21E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Rosie is painted red she is challenged to a race by fellow red engine James. A screeching sound leads Rosie to suggest that James should get his brakes checked, but he is too proud to do that, which leads to trouble.

programme.title: A Shed for Edward - S21E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Edward's shed is being repaired he is first sent to Philip's shed, then the Steamworks, then Brendam Docks, but they are all too noisy for him to get a good night's sleep!

programme.title: The Big Freeze - S21E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Cold weather stops a delivery of coal arriving on Sodor, so the Fat Controller orders all engines to stay in their sheds. Thomas, however, thinks he has enough coal for one more run, but he gets stranded in the snow whilst the diesels take over the steam engine's jobs to keep the railway running.

programme.title: Emily in the Middle - S21E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Emily gets stuck in the middle while helping Donald and Douglas.

programme.title: Terence Breaks the Ice - S21E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Terence takes a shortcut across a frozen lake while collecting Christmas trees.

programme.title: The Christmas Coffeepot - S20E27
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Marion hears a voice behind a tree and assumes the tree is talking. She tries to tell everyone, but nobody believes her. Thomas becomes curious and investigates, only to rediscover Glynn the Coffeepot Engine. He and Percy are worried he will be scrapped, but it turns out he will be restored by the Earl.

programme.title: Daisy's Perfect Christmas - S21E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Daisy is sad when her Christmas doesn't go exactly as planned.

programme.title: Over the Hill - S20E28
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Stephen becomes jealous of all the attention Glynn is receiving from the Earl and becomes worried he will become a stationary attraction at his new railway museum. To determine who will be the exhibit, Stephen challenges Glynn to a race.

programme.title: Confused Coaches - S21E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Spencer and Gordon upset their passengers when their competitive behavior gets extremely uncontrollable, causing them to accidentally board each other's coaches.

programme.title: Number One Engine - S22E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas is in China racing Hong-Mei in a bid to become the No. 1 Engine.

programme.title: Forever and Ever - S22E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — With all the changes, Gordon is feeling a little blue. Luckily his new friend Nia is there to show him that not all change is bad.

programme.title: Confusion Without Delay - S22E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A new engine named Rebecca arrives on Sodor, and not to feel inferior to the others, which are very fast, always starting early, because they are afraid of being late.

programme.title: Trusty Trunky - S22E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas learns that elephants in India really can shunt trucks.

programme.title: What Rebecca Does - S22E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Rebecca is always kind and smiles at everyone but does not feel as special as the other engines.

programme.title: Thomas Goes to Bollywood - S22E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — During his period of work on the Indian railway, Thomas attends the shooting of a Bollywood film.

programme.title: Thomas in the Wild - S22E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas takes a film crew to a nature reserve in China.

programme.title: Thomas and the Monkey Palace - S22E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The head of the Indian railways tells Thomas to go and get some coconuts to give them to the passengers. Thomas, however, is intrigued by the Palace of the Monkeys.

programme.title: An Engine of Many Colours - S22E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — James has a crash and hears there might not be enough red paint.

programme.title: Outback Thomas - S22E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas' tales get him lost in the outback.

programme.title: School of Duck - S22E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Duck tries to find a new classroom for the schoolchildren of Harwick.

programme.title: Tiger Trouble - S22E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas, Rajiv and Shankar have to save some tigers from being captured by one of Rajiv's passengers.

programme.title: Seeing is Believing - S22E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Merlin comes to Sodor from the Mainland for the first time. He thinks that when he shuts his eyes nobody can see him. Percy hears everyone talking about the 'invisible' engine and wonders why he hasn't seen him. But how can you see an engine that's invisible?

programme.title: Apology Impossible - S22E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Fed up with the other engines pushing him around, Philip refuses to give way when he and James end up facing each other on a one-track bridge. As James refuses too, it's a stalemate. But with engines stacked up behind them and the bridge in danger of collapsing, Philip decides that sometimes the littlest engine can actually be the bigger engine!

programme.title: The Water Wheel - S22E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Hong-Mei tells Thomas that the water wheel he is carrying is made from bamboo and is very important. But in his eagerness to discover other things made from bamboo, Thomas forgets about his mission and ends up taking a shortcut via a low bridge, which knocks the water wheel off his flatbed and sends it rolling off across the Chinese countryside!

programme.title: Samson and the Fireworks - S22E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Soon there will be an annual fireworks show, which Samson is very scared of.

programme.title: Runaway Truck - S22E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — A truck runs out of control down the line, and Yong Bao and Thomas must stop it.

programme.title: Thomas' Animal Ark - S22E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — It's Christmas Eve. The boiler that keeps the animals warm has broken, and the ship that carries the new one can not arrive because of bad weather.

programme.title: Cyclone Thomas - S22E19
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas wants to be just like Isla, a Flying Doctor’s plane who transports Dr. Claire to remote places where it’s hard for patients to get to hospitals and doctors for treatment.

programme.title: Kangaroo Christmas - S22E20
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas is shocked that Christmas in Australia happens in summer, and goes on an adventure to reunite a baby kangaroo with its mother.

programme.title: Thomas and the Dragon - S22E21
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Yong Bao asks Thomas to bring the dragon that will serve for the festivities in the big city square.

programme.title: Rosie is Red - S22E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — It's Valentine's Day, and Sir Topham organizes a surprise to Lady Hatt thanks to the unaware help of Rosie and Thomas.

programme.title: The Case of the Puzzling Parts - S22E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Sidney is shunting a flatbed of engine parts, but he can't remember what he's supposed to be doing with them. Paxton thinks this sounds like a mystery - the kind that can only be solved by a special agent.

programme.title: Banjo and the Bushfire - S22E24
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas offers a lift to a ranger while working in the Australian Rainforest. Thomas is excited to learn from her about all the animals that live there, but he is too loud and impatient to be really useful.

programme.title: Counting on Nia - S22E25
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Nia is a really clever engine and knows about all sorts of things, but when Sir Topham Hatt asks her to take Annie and Clarabel and pick up some passengers from Knapford Station while Thomas is at the Quarry, Nia has great trouble finding the right platform.

programme.title: Hunt the Truck - S22E26
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bill and Ben’s latest game consists of them hiding trucks and making the other engines hunt for them.

programme.title: Free the Roads - S23E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Bulgy wishes for passengers to take the bus instead of a train and gets his wish after accidently tainting a water tower.

programme.title: Crowning Around - S23E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Rajiv learns that he can be really useful with or without his crown.

programme.title: Chucklesome Trucks - S23E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The engines fear Rebecca is in for a tough time when she is tasked with pulling Troublesome Trucks.

programme.title: The Other Big Engine - S23E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas meets another big blue engine in Brazil that reminds him of Gordon.

programme.title: Heart of Gold - S23E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Toby fills in for Stephen at Ulfstead Castle and stops a pair of thieves from stealing King Godred's crown.

programme.title: Batucada - S23E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas finds a way to take part in the Brazilian carnival music.

programme.title: Gordon Gets the Giggles - S23E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Gordon becomes worried when he gets a serious case of the giggles.

programme.title: Thomas Makes a Mistake - S23E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas causes confusion and delay by not seeking help when he makes a mistake.

programme.title: Diesel Do Right - S23E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Diesel plays a trick on Rebecca to try to get the other engines in trouble for a change.

programme.title: Grudge Match - S23E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Raul wants to beat Thomas in a game, but his competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: Steam Team to the Rescue - S23E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The steam engines must work overtime to unload cargo from the docks when a series of accidents put all of the diesel engines out of action.

programme.title: Panicky Percy - S23E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Percy causes confusion and delay by panicking over nothing.

programme.title: All Tracks Lead to Rome - S23E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas is keen to prove to his new friend Gina that he is an expert in all things Italian, until he gets lost down an old mine.

programme.title: Mines of Mystery - S23E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas wants to impress his friends by finding an amazing discovery; it's not long before his wish is granted, although not in the way he had expected.

programme.title: Laid Back Shane - S23E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Shane is having too much fun to stop and refuel; that is, until he runs out of coal and is stranded in the hot, red desert.

programme.title: Rangers of the Rails - S23E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Emily takes the Sodor Rangers camping but gets derailed.

programme.title: Wish You Were Here - S23E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas misses his best friend Percy while working on the Chinese railway.

programme.title: Out of Site - S23E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Brenda learns that it's important to work as a team and not just care about her own jobs.

programme.title: First Day on Sodor! - S23E19
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Darcy makes some mistakes on her first day, but she soon makes up for it when everyone sees what she can really do.

programme.title: Lorenzo's Solo - S23E20
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Lorenzo takes a larger coach in order to pull the opera singer Dame Bella, but soon finds himself lost without his good friend Beppe.

programme.title: Deep Trouble - S23E21
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Max and Monty's antics on a construction site can get them into trouble.

programme.title: Too Loud, Thomas! - S23E22
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas wants to perform opera like Lorenzo and Beppe, but finds it a lot more difficult than he first thought.

programme.title: Diesel Glows Away - S23E23
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Thomas and the Royal Engine - S24E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas is selected to take the Fat Controller to London for a Royal Appointment, but with no knowledge of how to get there, their journey is filled with confusion and delay.

programme.title: Emily's Best Friend - S24E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Emily worries she does not have a best friend, but when the other engines help her out of a tricky situation, she realises she has been surrounded by best friends all along.

programme.title: Thomas' Fuzzy Friend - S24E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas discovers a missing dog on the railway and tries to find it a new home.

programme.title: The Great Little Railway Show - S24E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When a Railway Show for little engines comes to Sodor, an overly excited Percy finally sees his chance to shine.

programme.title: Thomas and the Forest Engines - S24E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Thomas heads to Brazil where he must collect a shipment of wood from a eucalyptus plantation. When he arrives, he meets Marcio and Marcia, a pair of wood burning engines.

programme.title: Emily to the Rescue - S24E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — When a pretend emergency turns into a real emergency, there is only one engine who can save the day!

programme.title: Shankar's Makeover - S24E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — The Fancy Costume Contest comes to town and all the engines are excited about getting dressed up and taking part. All except Shankar, who doesn't want to enter.

programme.title: Nia and the Unfriendly Elephant - S24E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Nia is excited to be given the task of bringing a new elephant to Sodor Animal Park. Nia loves animals, but this time the feeling is not mutual.

programme.title: James the Super Engine - S24E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 1984 · TV-Y — Rebecca tells James he could be a comicbook super-engine. He takes her seriously and Rail Rocket is born.

programme.title: Extra, Extra - S07E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — The trio's living arrangements are mischaracterized in a newspaper article, causing the girls shame but making Jack a hero with his friends.

programme.title: Jack Gets His Own Restaurant - S07E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Mr. Angelino offers Jack the opportunity to fulfill his dream of owing his own restaurant.
