programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Child Emperor rescues Waganma. The heroes take on threat-level Dragon monsters in a deadly fight.

programme.title: Ultimate Lifeform - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The heroes battle monsters while Terrible Tornado faces Gyoro-Gyoro. Orochi appears before Saitama.

programme.title: The Strongest Man - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Saitama is a guy who’s a hero for fun. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years. Though he’s now so strong he can defeat any opponent with a single punch, lately he feels as if, in exchange for overwhelming power, he’s lost something even more important.

programme.title: The Lone Cyborg - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — A monster is moving toward City Z, one that has been created by the mysterious organization known as The House of Evolution. Genos, a young cyborg, attempts to stop it, but gets in over his head before Saitama happens along.

programme.title: The Obsessive Scientist - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of Evolution and its founder Dr. Genus, a scientist with dangerous ideas on artificial human evolution. Meanwhile, Dr. Genus learns of Saitama’s amazing strength and has plans of his own for One-Punch Man.

programme.title: The Modern Ninja - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — A group of battlesuit-clad terrorists called "The Paradisers" appears in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead. Calling for the redistribution of wealth, the group targets the fat-cat Zeniru, who in turn dispatches his bodyguard to defeat them. Unfortunately, Saitama is on the same errand.

programme.title: The Ultimate Master - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Though he’s been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him. Determined to get a little recognition, he decides to become a pro hero, but first he must pass the Hero Association tests and become a full-fledged member.

programme.title: The Terrifying City - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero and he has yet to do anything heroic. When Genos informs him that C-class heroes who don't fight bad guys are dropped from the hero registry after a week of inaction, Saitama heads out on patrol, yet can't find any criminals or monsters to stop.

programme.title: The Ultimate Disciple - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z, forcing the Hero Association to ask its S Class heroes to respond. When all their efforts prove in vain, Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: The Deep Sea King - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrive on the shores of City J intent on invading the land. When the hero sent to fight them is defeated easily by the Deep Sea King himself, Saitama and Genos head for the city to help.

programme.title: Unyielding Justice - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot’s brutal attacks. Which of them has what it takes to be a true hero?

programme.title: Unparalleled Peril - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth. Though the crisis could occur anytime in the next six months, the heroes are surprised to hear the roar of explosions that very hour!

programme.title: The Dominator of the Universe - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S Class heroes. Despite their powers, they can't seem to finish it off. Meanwhile, Saitama has boarded the enemy ship on his own.

programme.title: The Strongest Hero - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama! With the fate of humanity in the balance, will the two champions at last find in each other the worthy opponent they've been searching for?

programme.title: Return of the Hero - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Saitama is out shopping with Genos in tow when the pair come across G4, a demonic robot on a mission to eliminate King. Elsewhere, Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.

programme.title: Human Monster - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association through terrifying means, Hellish Blizzard gives Saitama an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master’s stalker, Speed-o’-Sound Sonic.

programme.title: The Hunt Begins - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S Class hero Tank-top Master. Meanwhile, Silverfang shutters his dojo to begin his own hunt of his former disciple.

programme.title: Metal Bat - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Assigned to guard a VIP and his son, Metal Bat couldn't be less thrilled. But when the group is suddenly attacked all hell breaks loose. Meanwhile, Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.

programme.title: Martial Arts Tournament - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Monsters from the Monster Association launch simultaneous attacks on all the human cities, attempting to overwhelm the forces of the Hero Association. Meanwhile, the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament kicks off.

programme.title: The Uprising of the Monsters - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C. Elsewhere, countless monsters are wreaking havoc in multiple areas, but the Hero Association is being overwhelmed by the sheer number of threats.

programme.title: Class S Heroes - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — As the Super Fight tournament heads for its grand finale, the Class S heroes battle to hold back the tide of monster incursions. Meanwhile, Atomic Samurai is setting in motion a plan of his own.

programme.title: The Strong Ones Fight Back - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. Having now become a monster, he’s aiming to force the Super Fight competitors to turn into monsters themselves. When several do, it’s up to Suiryu to take them on alone.

programme.title: The Ultimate Dilemma - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Just as Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair, Saitama suddenly appears to help him out. But despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t seem to shake.

programme.title: The Encircling Net of Justice - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The Monster Association issues a challenge to the Hero Association, telling them they have only three days to rescue the hostage Waganma. Elsewhere, Garou tries to recover from his constant fighting, but things don’t quite go as planned.

programme.title: Everyone's Dignity - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he’s covered in wounds and nearly at his limit. The hero hunter still has his incredible ability to read opponents’ fighting styles, but there are surprises in store for all.

programme.title: Cleaning Up the Disciple's Mess - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Silverfang and Bomb catch up with Garou while the hero hunter is battling Genos, starting a whirlwind battle that draws in more and more combatants as it marches towards its hair-raising climax!

programme.title: Strategy Meeting - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The heroes plan a rescue of a child kidnapped by monsters, while Garou awakens deep underground.

programme.title: Monster Traits - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — On his way to hunt heroes, Garou dines and dashes at a restaurant, but is chased by Saitama.

programme.title: Organism Limits - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Garou fights Insect God and King the Ripper, while Tareo gets kidnapped. Dr. Kuseno visits Saitama.

programme.title: Counterattack Signal - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The heroes prepare for battle without Silverfang and Genos. Garou attacks the Monster Association.

programme.title: Monster King - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The S-class heroes race to rescue a child hostage as Garou awakens in the Monster Association’s lair.

programme.title: Motley Heroes - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Class-S heroes plan the Monster Association assault, but Amai Mask arrives and clashes with them.

programme.title: Counterstrike - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Heroes arrive in Z City but face a monster ambush. A-class aids while Gyoro-Gyoro watches the fight.

programme.title: Ninja Tale - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Tempest Wind and Hellfire Flame, who were ninjas but are now monsters, battle with Flashy Flash.

programme.title: Brave Child - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Child Emperor finds Waganma and faces Phoenix Man, using his ultimate weapon to protect him.

programme.title: Immortal Bloodbath - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Zombieman faces Vampire, a descendant of a supernatural bloodline, in a brutal, deadly showdown.

programme.title: Top Dragons - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — Child Emperor rescues Waganma. The heroes take on threat-level Dragon monsters in a deadly fight.

programme.title: Ultimate Lifeform - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — The heroes battle monsters while Terrible Tornado faces Gyoro-Gyoro. Orochi appears before Saitama.

programme.title: Unyielding Justice - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-14 — As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot’s brutal attacks. Which of them has what it takes to be a true hero?

programme.title: Journey - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — While Momonga has some doubts, he accepts Nphirea Balear's request under the condition that the members of the Swords of Darkness join them. Though her urge to kill keeps distracting her, Clementine continues to slowly find her way to Nphirea.

programme.title: Wise King of Forest - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga and his group continue to Carne Village. There they see that the villagers are working toward fortifying their defenses against possible future enemies. Nphirea meets up with Enri and asks her about this man named Ains Ooal Gown.

programme.title: Twin Swords of Slashing Death - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — After Momonga registers Hamusuke with the guild, he goes to Nphirea's home to find that his client has been kidnapped. The zombified remains of the Swords of Darkness litter the storage room. And there, Momonga finds the tortured body of Ninya.

programme.title: The Dark Warrior - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga and Narberal begin their respective battles against Clementine and Khajit. Momonga takes this chance to learn about the mechanics of fighting in this world, but in the end, he must show Clementine the consequences of offending him.

programme.title: True Vampire - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga finds out that Shalltear has revolted against him, due to something that had happened while she was on her mission with Sebas and Solution. The story rewinds a bit and goes over that very event. What could possibly change her loyalty to him?

programme.title: Confusion and Understanding - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga does damage control at the guild while he assesses the reason for Shalltear's revolt. Coming to the conclusion that she is under an incurable status effect, Momonga goes to the treasury to retrieve some of the powerful weapons of Nazarick.

programme.title: The Bloody Valkyrie - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Though Shalltear's skill set puts Momonga at a complete disadvantage, he steps forward into battle. He gave various world items to his guardians to ensure the safety of Nazarick in his absence. Now, all that is left is a battle of life and death!

programme.title: Player VS Non Player Character - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga reminds Shalltear that he is the master of Nazarick and that his name carries the weight of all the supreme beings of Ains Ooal Gown. After the battle comes to a close, Momonga quickly takes action to strengthen the defenses of Nazarick.

programme.title: The Dawn of Despair - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Officers of the Slane Theocracy gather to discuss recent losses. The noblemen of Estize plot to push back the Empire. Ains surveys a world map as his plans are set in motion. Shalltear recovers from her ordeal.

programme.title: Departure - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Cocytus gives a declaration of war to all the tribes of the Lizardmen, expecting an easy takeover. However, the Lizardmen decide to try to unite their tribes against their common foe.

programme.title: Lizard Men, Gathering - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Zenberu tests Zaryusu's strength in combat, while the latter defends Crusch's honor. The Lizardmen chiefs conduct a war council, and formulate a strategy to defend themselves against their common enemy.

programme.title: Army of Death - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The alliance of the Lizard men win the battle and defeat the army of undead. The defeat guardian Cocytus and the new ability to learn from their mistakes, prove that the guardians can adapt to new situations. Ainz Ooal Gown therefore changes his tactics, ordering Cocytus to bring the Lizard men to their knees and under the rule of the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

programme.title: The Freezing God - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — At the outpost in the Tob Forest, Ains strategizes with his guardians, and imposes Shalltear's penance upon her. The Lizard Man chiefs assemble and receive Cocytus on the battlefield for their final showdown.

programme.title: Those Who Pick Up, Those Who Are Picked Up - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Sebas happens upon a near-lifeless woman, and takes her under his protection. Brain, left defeated by his encounter with Shalltear, meets up with Gazef. Members of the Blue Rose take measures against a drug plantation

programme.title: Blue Roses - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Gazef finds Climb practicing with his sword outside the castle, and asks to spar with him. Renner and Lakyus examine the coded document recovered by Evileye. Sebas finds himself beset upon from all sides over Tuare.

programme.title: A Boy's Feeling - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Climb delivers Lakyus's message to Evileye and Gagaran, who offer guidance to the young man. Climb happens upon some men beating up a boy in the street, who is then rescued by Sebas, from whom he seeks training.

programme.title: Soaring Sparks of Fire - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Sebas begins his raid of the brothel from one side, while Climb and Brain enter from the other side. While Climb covers the exit alone, he is confronted by Succulent and Cocco Doll trying to flee and a desperate fight begins.

programme.title: Disturbance Begins in the Royal Capital - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Ains calls on Sebas to answer for his actions, and to discuss what is to become of Tuare. Renner meets with the Blue Rose, then Marquis Raeven, to consult with them about her planned attacks against Eight Fingers.

programme.title: Jaldabaoth - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Demiurge takes charge of Nazarick's forces, laying out the mission to strike at Eight Fingers. Meanwhile, Lakyus details a similar mission to her squad captains. Sebas, Climb, and Brain raid Six Arms' compound together.

programme.title: The Final Battle of the Disturbance - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Evileye petitions Momon to help her, and he begins fighting the disguised Demiurge. As Climb and the others try to get Tuare out of the compound, they face resistance. Renner convenes an emergency strategy meeting.

programme.title: The Ultimate Trump Card - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The guardsmen and adventurers face a daunting array of demons until Momon arrives and takes charge. Brain once again comes face to face with Shalltear. While Evileye is occupied, Demiurge reveals his plan to Ains.

programme.title: A Ruler's Melancholy - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — With the events of Re-Estize Kingdom and the Lizard Men behind them, the loyal servants of Nazarick return to their daily routines. Ains, however, is worried about the work/life balance of his NPCs. They work day in and day out without rest...

programme.title: Carne Village Once More - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — As Nazarick decides on their next steps, the village of Carne focuses on rebuilding their homes. Enri and her goblin troop are busy protecting the villagers, training the vigilante troop, and manning the fields. All the while, unrest builds in the forest.

programme.title: Enri's Upheaval and Hectic Days - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Enri meets Agu, who tells everyone that the Giant of the East and Demon Snake of the West are gathering forces to fight the master of the Monument of Ruin. Enri and the others take action, but little does she know how crazy the day will become...

programme.title: Giant of the East, Demon Snake of the West - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Ains decides to go and see the Giant of the East and Demon Snake of the West himself. If they are similar to Hamusuke, they may have some worth as experimental subjects. They may also be useful in testing Lupisregina's capabilities with the village.

programme.title: Two Leaders - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The "Giant of the East" has come to attack Carne Village, but the villagers are willing to put their lives on the line to protect their home and families. While the goblin troop defends the front gates, Enri and Nphirea defends the village from behind.

programme.title: Invitation to Death - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The Tomb of Nazarick continues their plan for world domination and Ains visits the Baharuth Empire as Momon of Darkness. Meanwhile, Count Femel hires a large number of Workers to explore a certain tomb recently discovered in Re-Estize Kingdom.

programme.title: Butterfly Entangled in a Spider's Web - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The foolish workers that have entered the Tomb of Nazarick greatly anger Ains Ooal Gown. Albedo and the others have already finished preparations for their welcome and Lord Ains watches on, determined that not a single one leaves his tomb alive.

programme.title: A Handful of Hope - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The worker group Foresight is teleported to the fighting arena in the sixth floor to challenge the great Ains Ooal Gown. Ains tries to restrain his smoldering fury as he disposes the last of the filthy thieves that dare trample into his treasured Nazarick.

programme.title: War of Words - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Ainz sends Aura and Mare to the Empire with a message. Come and apologize or watch as your country burn to the ground. With no other option, Emperor Jircniv heads toward Nazarick with the head of a noble in tow. Though, things are not as they seem.

programme.title: Preparation for War - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Re-Estize Kingdom prepares for war after receiving a declaration from the Empire that they will claim the land near E-Rantel for the Sorcerer King Gown. Gazef knows the magic caster's strength, but he cannot stop what has already been set into motion.

programme.title: Another Battle - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Carne Village is in a pinch once again. An army led by the first prince of Re-Estize has appeared, demanding to be let in so the villagers can be questioned about Ains Ooal Gown. Enri must make a decision for the village and its people.

programme.title: Massacre - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The war is finally starting. The Empire plans to use this chance to see the depths of the Sorcerer King's strength and the Kingdom is confident that their have fully prepared themselves for this war. Gazef stands ready. Now, let the despair begin.

programme.title: Player vs Player - S03E13
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Gazef challenges Ains to a duel that is impossible to win and Ains decides to accept. The battle will soon come to an end and the fate of E-Rantel will be decided. Even amongst the bloodshed, Gazef and Ains both hold the other in deep respect.

programme.title: Ains Ooal Gown Nation of Leading Darkness - S04E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — As Ains muddles his way through ruling his new kingdom, he continues to ponder over a particularly important question. Everyone in his kingdom and the Tomb of Nazarick is also waiting for his answer. What kind of kingdom does he wish to create?

programme.title: Re-Estize Kingdom - S04E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Albedo personally makes her way to Re-Estize Kingdom as an envoy of the Sorcerer Kingdom. Meanwhile, the people of Re-Estize continue to do what they can to recover from the recent war and prepare for the future. Though not everyone has peace in mind.

programme.title: Baharuth Empire - S04E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The major powers in other countries grow increasingly wary about the Sorcerer Kingdom. Especially the emperor of the Barahuth Empire, who might go bald from the stress induced by the overwhelming power of Ains Ooal Gown. On which side will he stand?

programme.title: The Ruler of Conspiracy - S04E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — While Albedo and the others make their moves toward world domination, Ains has his own little plan. He wants to cultivate true adventurers to explore the unknown, like the players in Yggdrasil. His recruitment efforts bring him to the Baharuth Empire...

programme.title: In Pursuit of the Land of Dwarves - S04E05
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — After his visit to the Empire, Ains decides to go and create a friendly relationship with the Dwarf Kingdom. Sadly, he only finds an empty city when he gets there. Deep within the tunnels, he meets a dwarf named Gondo who tells him happened.

programme.title: The Impending Crisis - S04E06
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Ains decides to lend a hand to the dwarves fighting against the Quagoa, but not for free. He wants to gather Gondo and the other runesmiths for the Sorcerer Kingdom. At the same time, Ains happens to find the perfect chance to teach Shalltear a thing or two.

programme.title: Frost Dragon Lord - S04E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The Clan Lord discovers that Ains and his group are approaching the royal capital and asks the frost dragons for help. The Dragon Lord sends his son to intercept the party, while Ains decides to split up the group to confront the Quagoa and frost dragons.

programme.title: An Unexpected Move - S04E08
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — While various things are happening in the neighboring countries, Philip continues to wallow in failure within the Re-Estize Kingdom. After meeting with some nobles from his new faction and he suddenly comes up with a brilliant idea...

programme.title: Countdown to Extinction - S04E09
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — The Sorcerer Kingdom declares war against the Re-Estize Kingdom and gives them exactly one month to prepare. Ains plans to show the world what happens to the enemies of Ains Ooal Gown. However, a few in Nazarick consider this massacre excessive.

programme.title: The Last King - S04E10
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Ains and his army marches towards the royal capital to finally annihilate the Re-Estize Kingdom. Various forces prepare themselves for the coming onslaught. Before the last battle, Zanac rides alone to meet with Ains for a peaceful discussion.

programme.title: Well-prepared Traps - S04E11
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — To gain more information, Ains and Albedo use themselves as bait as they approach the royal capital. Azuth comes to defend the capital and quickly separates the two. While the two of them exchange blows in the air, a mysterious figure comes to visit Ains.

programme.title: Invasion of the Royal Capital - S04E12
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Everyone in the Re-Estize Kingdom makes their final preparations as the Sorcerer Kingdom's army invades the royal capital. Some try to escape and some just wait to die. But there are a few among them who wish to fight until the very end.

programme.title: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom - S04E13
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Princess Renner decides to stay with her father and struggle against the Sorcerer King until the very end. Climb follows the orders of the princess and sneaks out of the royal palace only to be surprised at what he greets him when he returns.

programme.title: End and Beginning - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga is a regular salaryman who leads a guild in an DMMO-RPG known as Yggdrasil. After twelve years of playing the game, the servers are finally shutting down. Momonga logs in for the last time, seeing the game to its end. However, after the clock strikes midnight, nothing changes.

programme.title: Floor Guardians - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Grateful that they weren't cast aside, the floor guardians experience the rule of their true master for the first time. Momonga quickly assess the situation and works toward protecting the tomb from invaders while contemplating what he must do.

programme.title: Battle of Carne Village - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga continues his efforts to protect Nazarick from the unknown forces he may be up against in this world. As he manipulates the Mirror of Remote Viewing, he notices a village being attacked and decides to test his strength against humans.

programme.title: Ruler of Death - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-MA — Momonga finds that the attackers of Carne Village were Slane Theocracy soldiers dressed as people from the Baharuth Empire. As the attack to lure and eliminate Gazef Stronoff continues, Momonga takes this chance to continue his tests...

programme.title: Two Venturers - S01E05

programme.title: Terrible Two-Some - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2015 · TV-Y — Gekko has to babysit Catboy and Owlette after Romeo zaps them with his new invention and uses it to make everyone act like babies.

programme.title: The Host Club Declares Dissolution - S01E25
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club participates in the annual school festival. Tamaki's father and grandmother turn up there. However, the arrival of Eclair Tonnerre, a woman who Tamaki was told to take care of by his grandmother, brings an unforeseen turn of events. Haruhi also learns of Tamaki's history, and his entrance into the Suoh family.

programme.title: This is Our Ouran Fair - S01E26
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club must race against time to keep Tamaki in Japan and save the club from disbanding. However there are a few bumps along the way, as well as a wild horse ride, fighting with Ootori family police and Grand Tonnerre taking over lots of businesses. After Hikaru gets hurt, Haruhi rides the carriage and runs after Tamaki. Haruhi convinces Tamaki to return to the Host Club and reaches for his hand, but Tamaki is stopped by Eclair Tonnerre. Haruhi falls from the carriage and off a bridge. Eclair lets go of Tamaki's arm and Tamaki thanks her before jumping from the car to save Haruhi. In the end, Haruhi, dances with all the members of the Host Club.

programme.title: Starting Today, You Are a Host - S01E01
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Haruhi Fujioka, scholarship student, is immediately mistaken for a boy when she arrives at elite private school Ouran Academy. Searching for a quiet place to study, she stumbles across the Host Club, and, in an attempt to escape, accidentally breaks a ¥8 million vase. To pay back the debt, Haruhi becomes a member—needing to be "requested" by at least one hundred customers before she can leave. However, one by one the Host Club members discover her true gender; all except Tamaki, who accidentally sees her in her underwear before he gets the hint.

programme.title: The Job of a High School Host - S01E02
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club finds out that one of their regular customers, one of the few that skips from host to host regularly, is having trouble with her fiancé. The group then cooks up a plan to help, involving a dance, a kiss, and a big spotlight. Unfortunately, in the process, Haruhi has her first kiss; but not with the fiancé, but with the fiancée.

programme.title: Beware the Physical Exam - S01E03
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The time has come for the school's physical examinations, so the club must find a way to protect Haruhi's Big Secret. Their attempts fail miserably until Kyoya steps in, with a doctor who promises not to reveal her secret. Meanwhile, someone accused of attempting to "make a pass" on one of the female students, Dr Yabu (literally, Quack Doctor) is actually searching for his daughter after she and her mother left him due to financial problems. Kyoya points out that, if the man's family is really that poor, the girl would be attending Ouran Public High, rather than the prestigious and very expensive Ouran Academy. Tamaki gives him directions, explaining that, even though he might get hurt later, it's up to him to find the truth.

programme.title: Attack of the Lady Manager - S01E04
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club must deal with their new self-asserted manageress, Renge, a French otaku who claims to be Kyoya's fiancée. Renge has an overt obsession with video games, anime, manga, and cosplaying. She decides to make a movie for the host club, coming up with "parts" for them, such as Tamaki's "lonely prince" act and Honey's "evil on the inside" act. She gathers two yakuza (mafia) to play villains for the host club's "final fight," apparently a scheme where they band together to fight them. Haruhi attempts to protect Renge from their meager attacks, dislodging her contact in the process, causing her to appear to be crying in pain. Tamaki hurries over, angry at the thought some one has hurt her, only to find out that it was her contact that fell out. Haruhi finally helps Renge understand that there's more than stereotypes, and Renge immediately switches crushes from Kyoya to Haruhi. In the end though, the movie that was made by Renge was sold throughout the whole academy by Kyouya by saving the film before breaking the lens and lessening the violence.

programme.title: The Twins Fight - S01E05
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The twins beg to be allowed to visit Haruhi's home, but she refuses. Haruhi comments about the differences between Hikaru and Kaoru, which triggers a fight between the inseparable siblings, even making them dye their hair different colors, blue and pink, in order to be told apart. When Haruhi finally stands up to their fighting, saying "if they've never fought before, they might need help stopping," Kaoru is about to give Hikaru a cursed doll with his name written on the back - but when Haruhi steps in, he gives it to her instead. However, when she turns it over, the back says "Fail," - alerting the host club it was all a trick to be allowed to visit Haruhi's house.

programme.title: The Grade School Host is the Naughty Type - S01E06
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — An elementary school brat, Shiro Takaoji, seeks help from the Host Club's King to win the heart of women, but what he doesn't say makes all the difference in how much help he gets. He attempts to run away, calling Tamaki a "fake king", and Tamaki and the others infiltrate the elementary school, discovering that Shiro has a crush on a girl who would soon be moving away. Tamaki explains to him he didn't wish to please women, but only to please one woman - the girl he has a crush on. He had joined the Classical Music Club to make her happy and play the piano with her. Shiro learns his part of the piano duet he was supposed to have played with her, and the host club ends up allowing him and the girl to have a small concert in the host club lounge. The episode ends with Shiro entertaining at the host club, warning the clients not to tell his girlfriend; she'll get jealous if she hears he's hanging out with such beautiful women.

programme.title: Jungle Pool SOS - S01E07
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club drags Haruhi to an artificial tropical beach, but an accident separates Honey from the rest of the gang. Mori and Haruhi separate from the rest of the group to look for him, Mori eventually carrying her due to her slowness and clumsiness. Haruhi wonders aloud about Mori's and Honey's relationship, and then twins explain that they are in fact cousins by marriage. Meanwhile, Kyouya's guards, called in to look for Honey, end up mistaking Haruhi as the "small boy" Kyouya had described, and, under his orders, attempt to arrest any "suspicious people", as they believe that Mori looks suitably suspicious. Honey swings in on a vine, amazing Haruhi with his martial arts ability. The gang returns, ending the episode with Haruhi noting, much to the surprise of the twins and Tamaki, that she would enjoy visiting a real beach.

programme.title: The Sun, the Beach, and the Host Club - S01E08
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club visits the "real beach" in Okinawa upon Haruhi's request, but, Kyoya having invited customers, Haruhi is still unable to wear a swimsuit - much to the others disappointment. The twins devise a game to see who can find out what Haruhi is afraid of first, drawing Tamaki in with the explanation that only close friends show each other their weaknesses. Kyoya hypes up the competition by offering up photos of Haruhi in middle school. One accident occurred that caused a fight between the Host Club members. Kyouya, however, made Haruhi realize what her mistakes were and she eventually apologized for her wrongdoings. Tamaki wins secretly in the end, during a thunderstorm. However, the rest of the host club walks in at the most inopportune moment, as he covers her ears and places a blindfold on her to "block the thunder." The group ends up leaving with Tamaki chasing after them, trying in vain to convince them that he's not a pervert.

programme.title: A Challenge from Lobelia Girls' Academy - S01E09
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — St. Lobelia Girl's Academy's Benio Amakusa, head of the Zuka Club, chances upon Haruhi and, instantly recognizing that she is a girl, tries to convince her to join her school and her club. Convinced that Haruhi will leave them, the boys dress up as girls to show Haruhi that she "can have big brothers AND big sisters - all in one!" Haruhi reveals that she came to Ouran for a reason, and says that she was never planning to leave for Lobelia in the first place.

programme.title: A Day in the Life of the Fujioka Family - S01E10
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Interested in the unknown ways of a "commoner's lifestyle", the Host Club makes an unannounced appearance at Haruhi's house to meet her family and see how she lives. Tamaki realizes how independent Haruhi is and some of the reasons why.

programme.title: Big Brother is a Prince - S01E11
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Tamaki enlists the help of Renge in teaching Nekozawa to become the princely figure his little sister is convinced he is and help him face his fear of light, eventually leading to him saving his sister from a large, unfriendly cat, leading her to be convinced of his bravery despite the wig and cloak that he wears.

programme.title: Honey's Three Bitter Days - S01E12
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Honey gets his first cavity, and the number one rule until the cavity is fixed is no sweets. He then takes his frustration out on Mori, who is being strict on Honey, but Honey realizes that Mori was punishing himself for not telling Honey to brush his teeth twice.

programme.title: Haruhi in Wonderland - S01E13
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Haruhi's dream about the day of her admission into Ouran High School becomes a trippy Alice in Wonderland-esque fantasy. Her friends try to tell Haruhi something important, but she only realizes it when in court. At the end of the dream, she meets her mom, who tells her to "enjoy a dream like student life." She wakes up with tears in her eyes, and sees the club dressed up in costumes that look like the ones they wore in her dream.

programme.title: Covering The Famous Host Club - S01E14
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The ailing Newspaper Club wants to obtain an interview with the popular Host Club in order to save it from being disbanded due to the lack of public interest. Or so it seems. The newspaper club tell lies in their papers, so the club leader wants to interview the host club because he thinks that Tamaki is using his parents' power to control the popular students, and wants to tell the whole school that. Apparently he thinks of Tamaki as his mortal enemy.

programme.title: The Refreshing Battle of Karuizawa - S01E15
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — During summer vacation, Haruhi gets a part-time job in a pension at Karuizawa. She feels guilty at first for not saying anything to the rest of the Host Club, until they drop in unannounced. A contest erupts when they realize there is only one remaining room at the pension. Hikaru and Kaoru win by using their brotherly love act. When Haruhi's middle school friend visits, things take a turn for the worst.

programme.title: Operation Haruhi and Hikaru's First Date - S01E16
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Hikaru gets jealous of Haruhi's former classmate while at the pension. Kaoru pretends to be sick for the date, and instead sets up a date for Hikaru and Haruhi to try to get Hikaru to think of other people which Tamaki does not take too well. During their date, Hikaru runs off somewhere, and a thunderstorm occurs. Worried about Haruhi, Tamaki calls Hikaru, and tells him that Haruhi is afraid of thunder, letting everyone know Haruhi's weakness. In the end, Hikaru apologizes to Haruhi, who is hiding under a table in a church, during the thunderstorm and comforts her while she is crying. He apologizes for the way he acted, but Haruhi thinks he is Kaoru.

programme.title: Kyoya's Reluctant Day Out - S01E17
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Kyoya, half-asleep, is dragged into a commoner's department store by Tamaki and the rest of the boys, who aim to study the life of ordinary people, and therefore understand more about Haruhi - or play. Kyoya ends up meeting Haruhi there, alone, and they find it interesting how each other views their lives. Towards the end, Tamaki makes a call for a "lost child", who turns out to be Kyoya, which makes Kyoya even angrier at Tamaki than he already is.

programme.title: Chika's 'Down with Honey' Declaration - S01E18
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Honey has a younger brother Yasuchika, but he has a huge grudge against his sibling. It turns out the reason for his brother's grudge is that Honey eats too many cakes, causing Yasuchika to freak out.

programme.title: Lobelia Girls' Academy Strikes Back - S01E19
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The girls from St. Lobelia's Zuka Club finally manage to rope Haruhi into their academy, and it is up to the Host Club boys and Ranka to save her from Benio Amakusa stealing her first kiss - until Kyouya reminds them of Haruhi's real first kiss in a previous episode. The episode ends with the Lobelia's Zuka Club chasing Haruhi around the stage, attempting to steal her second kiss.

programme.title: The Door the Twins Opened - S01E20
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — A prequel that tells the story of how the twins were convinced to help form the club, including the "Which One is Hikaru?" game that they always played, including their past with the maid who led them to believe that no one would ever be able to tell them apart, and the cruel trick that they played on a girl in middle school.

programme.title: Until the Day It Becomes a Pumpkin - S01E21
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Haruhi's class has a Halloween event - The Halloween Special Fear Trial Tournament- in which groups do their best to scare the living daylights out of each other! The class rep isn't so keen on this idea, though, and enlists Haruhi to help him. Kaoru, meanwhile, contemplates a sad truth. Nekozawa decides to scare the group of Haruhi, Kaoru, Hikaru, and the class rep.

programme.title: Mori-senpai Has an Apprentice Candidate - S01E22
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — When the son of a gangster, Ritsu Kasanoda, seeks Mori for tips on how to change his scary image and gain friends, the Host Club immediately jumps at the opportunity to change his image, making many humorous results of their efforts. The members of the Host Club also frequently call him Casanova and bossa nova. However, Ritsu ends up discovering Haruhi's secret.

programme.title: Tamaki's Unwitting Depression - S01E23
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — After Ritsu walks in on Haruhi changing, he later joins the Host Club, but as a customer. When he insists on Haruhi as his host, the other hosts get nervous and the clients get excited. Tamaki starts to realize his feelings for Haruhi, and Ritsu nearly goes insane, while Haruhi remains blissfully oblivious.

programme.title: And so Kyoya Met Him - S01E24
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Kyoya recalls when he first meets Tamaki two years ago, and how he only became friends with him due to Tamaki being the heir to the Suou family businesses. He initially put up with Tamaki's odd requests, traveling all over Japan, but eventually snapped. From that point on, however, Kyoya could be his real self in front of Tamaki and they became true friends.

programme.title: The Host Club Declares Dissolution - S01E25
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club participates in the annual school festival. Tamaki's father and grandmother turn up there. However, the arrival of Eclair Tonnerre, a woman who Tamaki was told to take care of by his grandmother, brings an unforeseen turn of events. Haruhi also learns of Tamaki's history, and his entrance into the Suoh family.

programme.title: This is Our Ouran Fair - S01E26
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club must race against time to keep Tamaki in Japan and save the club from disbanding. However there are a few bumps along the way, as well as a wild horse ride, fighting with Ootori family police and Grand Tonnerre taking over lots of businesses. After Hikaru gets hurt, Haruhi rides the carriage and runs after Tamaki. Haruhi convinces Tamaki to return to the Host Club and reaches for his hand, but Tamaki is stopped by Eclair Tonnerre. Haruhi falls from the carriage and off a bridge. Eclair lets go of Tamaki's arm and Tamaki thanks her before jumping from the car to save Haruhi. In the end, Haruhi, dances with all the members of the Host Club.

programme.title: Starting Today, You Are a Host - S01E01
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Haruhi Fujioka, scholarship student, is immediately mistaken for a boy when she arrives at elite private school Ouran Academy. Searching for a quiet place to study, she stumbles across the Host Club, and, in an attempt to escape, accidentally breaks a ¥8 million vase. To pay back the debt, Haruhi becomes a member—needing to be "requested" by at least one hundred customers before she can leave. However, one by one the Host Club members discover her true gender; all except Tamaki, who accidentally sees her in her underwear before he gets the hint.

programme.title: The Job of a High School Host - S01E02
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club finds out that one of their regular customers, one of the few that skips from host to host regularly, is having trouble with her fiancé. The group then cooks up a plan to help, involving a dance, a kiss, and a big spotlight. Unfortunately, in the process, Haruhi has her first kiss; but not with the fiancé, but with the fiancée.

programme.title: Beware the Physical Exam - S01E03
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The time has come for the school's physical examinations, so the club must find a way to protect Haruhi's Big Secret. Their attempts fail miserably until Kyoya steps in, with a doctor who promises not to reveal her secret. Meanwhile, someone accused of attempting to "make a pass" on one of the female students, Dr Yabu (literally, Quack Doctor) is actually searching for his daughter after she and her mother left him due to financial problems. Kyoya points out that, if the man's family is really that poor, the girl would be attending Ouran Public High, rather than the prestigious and very expensive Ouran Academy. Tamaki gives him directions, explaining that, even though he might get hurt later, it's up to him to find the truth.

programme.title: Attack of the Lady Manager - S01E04
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club must deal with their new self-asserted manageress, Renge, a French otaku who claims to be Kyoya's fiancée. Renge has an overt obsession with video games, anime, manga, and cosplaying. She decides to make a movie for the host club, coming up with "parts" for them, such as Tamaki's "lonely prince" act and Honey's "evil on the inside" act. She gathers two yakuza (mafia) to play villains for the host club's "final fight," apparently a scheme where they band together to fight them. Haruhi attempts to protect Renge from their meager attacks, dislodging her contact in the process, causing her to appear to be crying in pain. Tamaki hurries over, angry at the thought some one has hurt her, only to find out that it was her contact that fell out. Haruhi finally helps Renge understand that there's more than stereotypes, and Renge immediately switches crushes from Kyoya to Haruhi. In the end though, the movie that was made by Renge was sold throughout the whole academy by Kyouya by saving the film before breaking the lens and lessening the violence.

programme.title: The Twins Fight - S01E05
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The twins beg to be allowed to visit Haruhi's home, but she refuses. Haruhi comments about the differences between Hikaru and Kaoru, which triggers a fight between the inseparable siblings, even making them dye their hair different colors, blue and pink, in order to be told apart. When Haruhi finally stands up to their fighting, saying "if they've never fought before, they might need help stopping," Kaoru is about to give Hikaru a cursed doll with his name written on the back - but when Haruhi steps in, he gives it to her instead. However, when she turns it over, the back says "Fail," - alerting the host club it was all a trick to be allowed to visit Haruhi's house.

programme.title: The Grade School Host is the Naughty Type - S01E06
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — An elementary school brat, Shiro Takaoji, seeks help from the Host Club's King to win the heart of women, but what he doesn't say makes all the difference in how much help he gets. He attempts to run away, calling Tamaki a "fake king", and Tamaki and the others infiltrate the elementary school, discovering that Shiro has a crush on a girl who would soon be moving away. Tamaki explains to him he didn't wish to please women, but only to please one woman - the girl he has a crush on. He had joined the Classical Music Club to make her happy and play the piano with her. Shiro learns his part of the piano duet he was supposed to have played with her, and the host club ends up allowing him and the girl to have a small concert in the host club lounge. The episode ends with Shiro entertaining at the host club, warning the clients not to tell his girlfriend; she'll get jealous if she hears he's hanging out with such beautiful women.

programme.title: Jungle Pool SOS - S01E07
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club drags Haruhi to an artificial tropical beach, but an accident separates Honey from the rest of the gang. Mori and Haruhi separate from the rest of the group to look for him, Mori eventually carrying her due to her slowness and clumsiness. Haruhi wonders aloud about Mori's and Honey's relationship, and then twins explain that they are in fact cousins by marriage. Meanwhile, Kyouya's guards, called in to look for Honey, end up mistaking Haruhi as the "small boy" Kyouya had described, and, under his orders, attempt to arrest any "suspicious people", as they believe that Mori looks suitably suspicious. Honey swings in on a vine, amazing Haruhi with his martial arts ability. The gang returns, ending the episode with Haruhi noting, much to the surprise of the twins and Tamaki, that she would enjoy visiting a real beach.

programme.title: The Sun, the Beach, and the Host Club - S01E08
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The Host Club visits the "real beach" in Okinawa upon Haruhi's request, but, Kyoya having invited customers, Haruhi is still unable to wear a swimsuit - much to the others disappointment. The twins devise a game to see who can find out what Haruhi is afraid of first, drawing Tamaki in with the explanation that only close friends show each other their weaknesses. Kyoya hypes up the competition by offering up photos of Haruhi in middle school. One accident occurred that caused a fight between the Host Club members. Kyouya, however, made Haruhi realize what her mistakes were and she eventually apologized for her wrongdoings. Tamaki wins secretly in the end, during a thunderstorm. However, the rest of the host club walks in at the most inopportune moment, as he covers her ears and places a blindfold on her to "block the thunder." The group ends up leaving with Tamaki chasing after them, trying in vain to convince them that he's not a pervert.

programme.title: A Challenge from Lobelia Girls' Academy - S01E09
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — St. Lobelia Girl's Academy's Benio Amakusa, head of the Zuka Club, chances upon Haruhi and, instantly recognizing that she is a girl, tries to convince her to join her school and her club. Convinced that Haruhi will leave them, the boys dress up as girls to show Haruhi that she "can have big brothers AND big sisters - all in one!" Haruhi reveals that she came to Ouran for a reason, and says that she was never planning to leave for Lobelia in the first place.

programme.title: A Day in the Life of the Fujioka Family - S01E10
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Interested in the unknown ways of a "commoner's lifestyle", the Host Club makes an unannounced appearance at Haruhi's house to meet her family and see how she lives. Tamaki realizes how independent Haruhi is and some of the reasons why.

programme.title: Big Brother is a Prince - S01E11
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Tamaki enlists the help of Renge in teaching Nekozawa to become the princely figure his little sister is convinced he is and help him face his fear of light, eventually leading to him saving his sister from a large, unfriendly cat, leading her to be convinced of his bravery despite the wig and cloak that he wears.

programme.title: Honey's Three Bitter Days - S01E12
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Honey gets his first cavity, and the number one rule until the cavity is fixed is no sweets. He then takes his frustration out on Mori, who is being strict on Honey, but Honey realizes that Mori was punishing himself for not telling Honey to brush his teeth twice.

programme.title: Haruhi in Wonderland - S01E13
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Haruhi's dream about the day of her admission into Ouran High School becomes a trippy Alice in Wonderland-esque fantasy. Her friends try to tell Haruhi something important, but she only realizes it when in court. At the end of the dream, she meets her mom, who tells her to "enjoy a dream like student life." She wakes up with tears in her eyes, and sees the club dressed up in costumes that look like the ones they wore in her dream.

programme.title: Covering The Famous Host Club - S01E14
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — The ailing Newspaper Club wants to obtain an interview with the popular Host Club in order to save it from being disbanded due to the lack of public interest. Or so it seems. The newspaper club tell lies in their papers, so the club leader wants to interview the host club because he thinks that Tamaki is using his parents' power to control the popular students, and wants to tell the whole school that. Apparently he thinks of Tamaki as his mortal enemy.

programme.title: The Refreshing Battle of Karuizawa - S01E15
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — During summer vacation, Haruhi gets a part-time job in a pension at Karuizawa. She feels guilty at first for not saying anything to the rest of the Host Club, until they drop in unannounced. A contest erupts when they realize there is only one remaining room at the pension. Hikaru and Kaoru win by using their brotherly love act. When Haruhi's middle school friend visits, things take a turn for the worst.

programme.title: Operation Haruhi and Hikaru's First Date - S01E16
programme.desc: Anime · 2006 · TV-14 — Hikaru gets jealous of Haruhi's former classmate while at the pension. Kaoru pretends to be sick for the date, and instead sets up a date for Hikaru and Haruhi to try to get Hikaru to think of other people which Tamaki does not take too well. During their date, Hikaru runs off somewhere, and a thunderstorm occurs. Worried about Haruhi, Tamaki calls Hikaru, and tells him that Haruhi is afraid of thunder, letting everyone know Haruhi's weakness. In the end, Hikaru apologizes to Haruhi, who is hiding under a table in a church, during the thunderstorm and comforts her while she is crying. He apologizes for the way he acted, but Haruhi thinks he is Kaoru.

programme.title: Santa / Trophy / Makeup - S01E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Who is this jolly man with a white beard and reindeer? The aliens aim to find out. Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee also try ice hockey, then play with makeup.

programme.title: Trains / Barbershop / Gnome - S02E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — All aboard. Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee learn about trains. Later, they investigate a barbershop and try to make sense of a garden gnome.

programme.title: Florist / Fashion / Teeth - S02E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The three aliens explore a fragrant flower shop, learn a thing or two about high fashion and take a trip to the dentist. Open wide.

programme.title: Pool / Dinner Party / Skiing - S02E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — While dressed as pirates, the aliens splash around the pool. Later, they enjoy a fancy dinner party and explore a ski chalet.

programme.title: Joke Shop / Outback / Fire Hall - S02E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Knock, knock. Who's there? Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee. The trio gets silly at a joke shop before visiting the Outback and suiting up as firefighters.

programme.title: Baby Shower / Yard Sale / Aquarium - S02E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — What exactly is a baby shower? Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee aim to find out. Also, the aliens visit a yard sale and an aquarium.

programme.title: Dance / International Games / Shopping - S02E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The aliens move their bodies rhythmically while listening to music. In other words, they dance. Also on tap: athletic competition and shopping.

programme.title: School / Holiday / Lucha Libre - S02E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The aliens head back to school, where they learn they have a lot to learn. Later, they visit a hospital and try out Mexican wrestling.

programme.title: Car / Sleep / Golf - S02E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee get a crash-course in cars, learn to get the most out of their sleep routine and go for a hole-in-one at the golf course.

programme.title: Airplane / Water Park / Mail - S02E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — After learning all about airplanes, Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee make their own water park and then try delivering letters and packages around town.

programme.title: Music / Bowling / Gardening - S02E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The trio makes music together, visits a funky bowling alley and spends a little time experimenting with plants.

programme.title: Museum / Bollywood / Castle - S02E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Ancient art and natural wonders beware: The aliens are learning about museums. Also in this episode: Bollywood and the fine art of storming castles.

programme.title: Ballet / Energy / Leprechauns - S02E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The aliens give ballet dancing a try. They also learn how different kinds of energy are produced and then dress up as leprechauns.

programme.title: Glasses / Trial / Scary - S02E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — From seeing more clearly to just looking cool, glasses have many uses. Later, the aliens put on a trial and investigate why some things are scary.

programme.title: Bicycle / Gymnastics / Camping - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee try out three perilous human pastimes: bike-riding, gymnastics and camping. Hey, nobody said being an alien was easy.

programme.title: Playground / Art / Gum - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The intrepid aliens go hunting for fun at a playground, try to understand art and find themselves perplexed by this chewy substance called "gum".

programme.title: Gym / Birthday / Restaurant - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Reporters Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee blast their abs at a gym, crash a birthday party and enjoy some fine dining at a restaurant. Bon appetit, aliens!

programme.title: BBQ / Office / Halloween - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The reporters check out a tasty BBQ. Yum! Later, they investigate a surprisingly fun office building and experience the chaotic joy of Halloween.

programme.title: Pizza / Magic / Cleaning - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee venture into a pizza parlor, experiment with mind-bending magic and learn how humans clean up their messes.

programme.title: Arcade / Dumplings / Presents - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee go for a high score at an arcade. Later, they gorge on a feast of dumplings and search for the perfect present.

programme.title: Junkyard / Spa / Love - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The aliens have a smashing good time in a junkyard, observe humans relaxing at a spa and try to make sense of something called "love."

programme.title: Movie / Kindergarten / Sick - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Lights, camera, action! The aliens head to the movie theater. Later, they experience the wonders of kindergarten and learn about feeling sick.

programme.title: Baby / Supermarket / Tea - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — A talking baby doll causes major confusion, a trip to the market leads to mass mayhem - and the trio takes time for tea.

programme.title: Wedding / Loch Ness / Soccer - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Hey, who invited these guys? Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee crash a wedding. The trio also goes fishing and gets their kicks on the football field.

programme.title: Skateboard / Mannequin / Survival - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The interplanetary explorers give skateboarding a shot, step into a mannequin's shoes and learn about surviving in the wild.

programme.title: Toyshop / Laundromat / Yoga - S01E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — A trip to the toy store may be more fun than the aliens can handle. Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee also explore a laundromat before giving yoga a try.

programme.title: Santa / Trophy / Makeup - S01E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — Who is this jolly man with a white beard and reindeer? The aliens aim to find out. Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee also try ice hockey, then play with makeup.

programme.title: Trains / Barbershop / Gnome - S02E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — All aboard. Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee learn about trains. Later, they investigate a barbershop and try to make sense of a garden gnome.

programme.title: Florist / Fashion / Teeth - S02E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — The three aliens explore a fragrant flower shop, learn a thing or two about high fashion and take a trip to the dentist. Open wide.

programme.title: Pool / Dinner Party / Skiing - S02E03

programme.desc: Animation · 2020 · ALL — What exactly is a baby shower? Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee aim to find out. Also, the aliens visit a yard sale and an aquarium.

programme.title: Patter of Little Feet - S02E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mr. Carlson's wife Carmen announces that she is pregnant. Mr. Carlson is overjoyed, and certain that Carmen feels the same way. However, Mama Carlson points out the potential dangers of middle-aged pregnancy and recommends an abortion.

programme.title: Baby, If You've Ever Wondered - S02E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — The new ratings book arrives, and WKRP has climbed from 16th to 14th place in the Cincinnati market. Everyone is happy about the gain except Andy, who knows that the station has not improved enough, in part because of his own unwillingness to fire incompetent employees like Herb and Les.

programme.title: Bailey's Big Break - S02E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When WKRP needs an assistant news reporter, Bailey applies for the job and gets it. Les, who doesn't want to work with anyone, least of all a woman, tries to keep Bailey from going on the air.

programme.title: Jennifer's Home for Christmas - S02E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Jennifer tells her friends that she has nothing special planned for Christmas, and that she doesn't have a tree this year. Everyone begins to suspect that she might be alone for the holidays.

programme.title: Sparky - S02E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mr. Carlson hires baseball manager Sparky Anderson to host a new sports-talk show.

programme.title: God Talks to Johnny - S02E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Johnny thinks he's heard God's voice talking to him, everyone, including Johnny, thinks he's going insane.

programme.title: A Family Affair - S02E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Andy's sister Carol visits Cincinnati, and Andy sets up a date for her and Johnny. But Carol winds up going out with Venus instead, and Andy becomes instinctively angry about it.

programme.title: Herb's Dad - S02E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb's father, a lifelong salesman who shares Herb's taste in clothes, runs away from the Shady Hills Rest Home and visits the station.

programme.title: Put Up or Shut Up - S02E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Bailey convinces Jennifer to accept a date with Herb in the hope that he'll get scared and back down.

programme.title: The Americanization of Ivan - S02E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Bailey and Les attend a press conference given by a group of visiting Russian hog experts. One of the Russians falls for Bailey and asks her to help him defect to the United States.

programme.title: Les' Groupie - S02E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Les goes out on a date with a female fan, who proceeds to move into his apartment and take over his life.

programme.title: In Concert - S02E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — At a concert by the Who in Cincinnati on December 3, 1979, eleven kids were trampled to death when the crowd rushed to get seats. The first part of this episode takes place before that concert; the second act takes place the day after, and presents the characters' reactions to the tragedy.

programme.title: The Doctor's Daughter - S02E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Johnny's daughter shows up and moves in, and Johnny has to decide whether to express his disapproval of the shiftless boyfriend she's brought along.

programme.title: Filthy Pictures (1) / Filthy Pictures (2) - S02E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mr. Carlson convinces Jennifer and Andy to pose in bathing suits for a "Surf's Up in Cincinnati" poster. After the photo session, the photographer secretly takes nude photos of Jennifer while she's changing.

programme.title: Venus Rising - S02E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Venus is offered a job as program director of WREQ radio, but is disillusioned when he discovers how the station is run and why they want to hire him. Meanwhile, Herb circulates a rumor that he, too, has received a job offer.

programme.title: Most Improved Station - S02E24
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Everyone starts bickering after the station loses a broadcasting award.

programme.title: The Airplane Show - S03E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Trying to compete with WPIG's traffic helicopter, Les starts doing traffic reports from a World War I biplane piloted by a crazy war veteran.

programme.title: Jennifer Moves - S03E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — The staff helps Jennifer move into her new $125,000 house in the quiet suburb of Landersville. But she soon finds out that life in Landersville isn't as pleasant as she thought it would be.

programme.title: Real Families - S03E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Herb's family is featured in the show "Real Families", he is sure that they can serve as an example of a clean living family. Unfortunately, the image Herb wants to convey is different from the reality shown on screen.

programme.title: The Baby - S03E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mr. Carlson's wife goes into labor and the WKRP staffers all visit the hospital to be there when she gives birth.

programme.title: Hotel Oceanview - S03E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Andy, Mr. Carlson and Herb visit Dayton to try and land the advertising account for Vicky Von Vickey jeans. While Mr. Carlson worries about the notorious Dayton poisoner, Herb romances an old high school acquaintance and Andy has trouble with his slide projector.

programme.title: A Mile in My Shoes - S03E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Herb is called for jury duty, Andy takes over as sales manager and soon discovers just how tough it is trying to sell advertising time or collect from deadbeat clients. Meanwhile, Venus becomes acting program director and has to deal with Les's plan to disguise himself as a black man so that he can do a series of reports based on the book Black Like Me.

programme.title: Bah, Humbug - S03E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Once again, Mr. Carlson plans to give the staffers almost no Christmas bonuses. But in a dream brought on by eating one of Johnny Fever's brownies, the ghosts of Christmas past, present and future visit him to show him the error of his ways.

programme.title: Baby, It's Cold Inside - S03E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — On a day when the furnace has broken down, Mama Carlson pays a surprise visit to the station and catches Johnny drinking in the broadcast booth.

programme.title: The Painting - S03E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — At Mr. Carlson's church auction, Herb buys a painting that Bailey loves. He tries to get Mr. Carlson or Bailey to buy it from him...until he learns that it might be valuable.

programme.title: Daydreams - S03E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Mr. Carlson rehearses a dull speech in front of the WKRP staff, all the staffers drift off into daydreams about what they would most like to be: Herb as a Latin-American dictator, Jennifer as a '30s movie star, Les as a reporter covering the Blitz in 1940, Bailey as the President of the United States, Andy as a radio Mafioso, Venus as a standup comedian, and Johnny as a rock star.

programme.title: Frog Story - S03E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb has accidentally spray-painted his daughter's pet frog Greenpeace pink, and brings the frog to the station trying to find a way to save its life. Meanwhile, Les convinces Johnny that he is suffering from the dreaded "schistosomiasis."

programme.title: Venus and the Man - S03E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — The station's cleaning woman asks Venus to convince her big, tough teenage son not to drop out of school.

programme.title: Dr. Fever and Mr. Tide (Part 1) / Dr. Fever and Mr. Tide (Part 2) - S03E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Johnny signs a contract to host a music TV program unaware that the songs will be disco.

programme.title: Ask Jennifer - S03E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Herb's choice as host of a new call-in advice show proves unable to go on the air, Jennifer takes over and becomes an instant success.

programme.title: I Am Woman - S03E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When it is announced that the Flimm Building is to be torn down, Bailey starts a campaign to have the building declared a Cincinnati landmark. Everyone pitches in to help, until Mr. Carlson gets his mother's permission to build a new and better building.

programme.title: Secrets of Dayton Heights - S03E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — The Secret Service refuses to grant Les credentials for a Presidential press conference, suspecting him of having radical affiliations. It turns out that the man who raised Les wasn't his father, and that his real father was a card-carrying Communist.

programme.title: Out to Lunch - S03E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb's three-martini business lunches with an ad agency representative are causing him to mess up even more than usual, and it begins to seem that his use of alcohol as a sales tool is turning into a drinking problem.

programme.title: A Simple Little Wedding - S03E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — In honor of their 25th anniversary, Arthur and Carmen Carlson plan to get married again. They want a small, private ceremony, but Mama Carlson has other ideas.

programme.title: Nothing to Fear But... - S03E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Everyone is in the grip of urban paranoia after the station is robbed.

programme.title: Till Debt Do Us Part - S03E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When Johnny learns that his first ex-wife is planning to remarry, he is overjoyed at the thought of not having to pay alimony, and celebrates by inviting Bailey to take a trip with him. But he feels less happy about the situation when he meets the obnoxious womanizer his ex-wife is going to marry.

programme.title: Clean Up Radio Everywhere - S03E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Dr. Bob Halyers, head of the organization Clean Up Radio Broadcasting (CURB), visits Mr. Carlson with a list of obscene songs that he wants the station to stop playing.

programme.title: An Explosive Affair (Part 1) - S04E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When the station receives a bomb threat, Johnny and Venus broadcast from the remote transmitter tower.

programme.title: An Explosive Affair (Part 2) - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Andy is unable to warn Johnny and Venus when he realizes that the bomb is at the transmitter.

programme.title: The Union - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — The staff of WKRP considers joining a union and Andy is caught in the middle.

programme.title: Rumors - S04E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — While his apartment is being fumigated, Johnny stays with Bailey, causing everyone at the station to jump to conclusions.

programme.title: Straight from the Heart - S04E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb secretly checks into the hospital for heart tests.

programme.title: Who's on First? - S04E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — With Herb in the hospital, Mr. Carlson pretends he is Herb and is impersonated by Les for an advertising client.

programme.title: Three Days of the Condo - S04E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Johnny receives a large legal settlement and buys a condominium.

programme.title: Jennifer and the Will - S04E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — When her elderly friend dies, Jennifer must handle the will and the man's nasty relatives.

programme.title: The Consultant - S04E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — A sleazy radio consultant threatens to deliver a bad report to Mrs. Carlson unless Andy subscribes to his service.

programme.title: Love, Exciting and New - S04E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Andy becomes afraid of Mrs. Carlson's intentions for him.

programme.title: You Can't Go Out of Town Again - S04E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mr. Carlson and his wife travel to his college reunion.

programme.title: Pills - S04E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb's new sponsor is selling amphetamines to teenagers over the air by calling them diet pills.

programme.title: Changes - S04E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — To prepare for an interview with a black magazine, Venus adopts a new wardrobe and manner.

programme.title: Jennifer and Johnny's Charity - S04E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Johnny asks Jennifer to help him raise money to rebuild a homeless shelter.

programme.title: I'll Take Romance - S04E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb arranges a date for Les but doesn't realize that the dating service is a front for prostitution.

programme.title: Circumstantial Evidence - S04E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Venus is in hot water when an ex-lover leaves him with stolen property.

programme.title: Fire - S04E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Herb and Jennifer are trapped in an elevator when a fire breaks out in the Flimm Building.

programme.title: Dear Liar - S04E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Bailey's news story about a children's clinic is revealed to be fictional.

programme.title: The Creation of Venus - S04E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Andy tells Mrs. Carlson about how he hired Venus.

programme.title: The Impossible Dream - S04E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Les plans to go to New York to pursue his dream of becoming a prominent broadcast journalist.

programme.title: To Err Is Human - S04E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mr. Carlson wants to fire Herb, but Jennifer intervenes.

programme.title: Up and Down the Dial - S04E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Mrs. Carlson announces plans to switch the station's format to all news.

programme.title: Pilot (1) - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1978 · TV-PG — Andy Travis, a young program director from Santa Fe, takes over at Cincinnati radio station WKRP and changes the format to rock and roll.

programme.title: The Peeper Transport Tubes / Abby Loses Her Glasses - S02E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 2018 · TV-Y — The Peepers deliver stuff around the hotel through a series of tubes. It goes well until they mix up their deliveries and get jammed at the intersection. / Abby's glasses get knocked off her face by a ball, and get carried away by a series of animals. She struggles to see as a result.

programme.title: Game Time with Mo and Bo / Grumbles Goes Down the Drain - S02E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 2018 · TV-Y — Mo and Bo are heavily focused on video snakes and ladders on a tablet, thus they cause some trouble when they play and walk simultaneously. / Grumbles bathes in Abby's bath tub but suddenly thins, and get pulled into the drain where he travels through pipes across the hotel.

programme.title: Teeny Terry Is ... TeenyMan! / Mo and Bo and the Missing Button Trail - S02E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 2018 · TV-Y — Teeny Terry wants to be a hero but he lacks confidence. Thus Abby decides to secretly help him by doing heroic acts but making him think he does them. / Abby and some of her Fuzzly pals have a walk in the woods, and drop buttons to mark their path. But they get lost when the buttons get covered in snow.

programme.title: Mo and Bo on a Roll / Dance Dance Grumbles - S02E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 2018 · TV-Y — Mo and Bo put on roller skates, but their being new to the equipment causes them to roll away for miles. / Abby and Bozzly try to teach Grumbles how to dance.

programme.title: Super Strength Curly / Super Sitter Abby - S02E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 2018 · TV-Y — Abby and the Fuzzlies are making fruit jellies, but when Princess Flug mixes in glitter-goo, it gives Curly special powers! / Abby is babysitting Grumbles' cousin Mumbles but is having a hard time following the Fuzzly babysitting rules.

programme.title: Otis and the Snack Machine / Abby's Runaway Care Case - S02E11

programme.title: Third Inning: The Faith of Fifty Million People - S01E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 1994 · TV-14 — Third Inning, The Faith of Fifty Million People, examines the century's second decade, which was dominated by the Black Sox scandal. George Herman "Babe" Ruth makes his first major league appearance (as a member of the Boston Red Sox) and a wave of immigration helps fill the stands with new fans, eager to "become American" by learning America's game.

programme.title: Fourth Inning: A National Heirloom - S01E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 1994 · TV-14 — Fourth Inning, A National Heirloom, concentrates on Babe Ruth, whose phenomenal performance thrilled the nation throughout the 1920s and rescued the game from the scandal of the previous decade.

programme.title: Fifth Inning: Shadow Ball - S01E05
programme.desc: Documentary · 1994 · TV-14 — Fifth Inning, Shadow Ball, tells the story of the Negro Leagues in the 1930s. The title refers to a common pre-game feature in which the players staged a mock game with an imaginary ball. Though unintended, the pantomime was an apt metaphor for the exclusion of blacks from major league play at that time.

programme.title: Sixth Inning: The National Pastime - S01E06
