programme.title: Enter, the Maestro - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — While saving Earth from a potentially catastrophic meteorite, the Hulks come face to face with a future version of Hulk who might not be the hero they think he is.

programme.title: The Tale of Hercules - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks travel to ancient Greece and team up with Hercules to stop Pluto from turning everyone on Earth to stone.

programme.title: Banner Day - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk allows himself to be turned back into Bruce Banner but then struggles with the decision when Ronan launches an alien attack.

programme.title: Wheels of Fury - S02E18
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. attempt to help Iron Man subdue Mainframe in a gladiatorial roller derby game for the fate of the planet, but are faced with a challenge when they discover only She-Hulk knows how to skate.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (1): The Dino Era - S02E19
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk chases Leader back in time to the Jurassic era, but their actions result in present Earth being taken over by dinosaurs. Hulk battles Leader in the past to save all of time.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (2): Smashgard - S02E20
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk follows Leader back in time to the Viking Era and teams up with young Thor and Loki. The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. fight to stop "All Father" Leader from taking over the planet.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (3): Dracula - S02E21
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk follows Leader back in time to the Victorian era and unites the Howling Commandos against Dracula, who wants to shroud the Earth with Leader's gamma cloud, allowing vampires to prey night and day.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (4): The Hydra Years - S02E22
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Chasing Leader through time to WWII, Hulk teams up with Captain America to stop Red Skull. In the present, the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. fight to free the world from HYDRA.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (5): The Tomorrow Smashers - S02E23
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Finally catching up to Leader in the present, Hulk reunites with the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. However, he's unexpectedly whisked into the future by teenage Smashers who battle the Leader's threats.

programme.title: Spirit of Vengeance - S02E24
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — While escorting Abomination to stand trial for his crimes, the Hulks run into Ghost Rider, who has come to make both Abomination and Red atone for the wrongful deeds of their past.

programme.title: Planet Monster (1) - S02E25
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk is torn between his two teams -- the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and the Avengers -- as both team up to save Earth from a Kree armada led by the Supreme Intelligence.

programme.title: Doorway to Destruction (1) - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk's best pal Rick Jones begins making a web-series to show the world Hulk is a hero and Big Green gets his first chance to prove it when Annihilus invades Earth!

programme.title: Doorway to Destruction (2) - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The newly formed Agents of S.M.A.S.H. -- including a Hulked-out Rick Jones aka A-Bomb -- invade the Negative Zone to stop Annihilus once and for all.

programme.title: Hulk Busted - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the Leader hijacks Iron Man's Hulkbuster suits to destroy the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., the team and Iron Man must learn to trust each other and work together to defeat the Leader.

programme.title: The Collector - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Perceived by the public as "menaces," Hulk and Spider-Man are the only ones left to save the planet from destruction when The Collector captures every last hero on earth.

programme.title: All About the Ego - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks face their biggest foe yet when they travel into space to battle Ego the Living Planet, who threatens to tear Earth apart! To survive, they have to tackle the second biggest ego in the galaxy -- Red Hulk's.

programme.title: Savage Land - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — A-Bomb is eager to prove himself to an over-protective Hulk and finds an unlikely mentor in Red, but when Sauron and his army of dinosaurs begin to flood Earth with lava, A-Bomb finds himself facing a true trial by fire.

programme.title: Incredible Shrinking Hulks - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks are miniaturized to one-inch heroes who must stop the towering Leader from shrinking every city on Earth.

programme.title: Hulks on Ice - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk and Red-Hulk must stop fighting each other long enough to team up with Thor and prevent Laufey and the Frost Giants from taking over the nine realms.

programme.title: Of Moles and Men - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulk's presence in Vista Verde may be doing the city more harm than good. In order to prevent any danger to its citizens, the Hulk goes underground and becomes the savior to the Moloids but the Hulk soon learns that he might be the one who needs saving!

programme.title: Wendigo Apocalypse - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — As the curse of the Wendigo begins spreading across the team. A-Bomb narrates this heroic episode turned horror flick joined by Marvel's biggest clawed Hero, Wolverine. Together, they must all stop the curse from spreading and do everything in their power to prevent from becoming Wendigos themselves.

programme.title: The Skaar Whisperer - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Skaar gets a lesson in civility from Doc Sampson while the Hulks battle Absorbing Man, who takes on Gamma energy to turn himself into an unstoppable force.

programme.title: Into the Negative Zone - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk begrudgingly teams up with The Thing to take the fight to the Leader's doorstep when his arch-nemesis puts the lives of the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. on the line.

programme.title: Red Rover - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — An irritated Red Hulk accidentally drops Devil Dinosaur in Dr. Doom's backyard, prompting the mad dictator to launch a full assault on the Hulks.

programme.title: The Venom Inside - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Venom is on the prowl and has his sights set on big targets. Hulk must save the day...without smashing as his friends are possessed by Venom. How will the Hulks take on this menacing parasitic villain who's only goal is to destroy Spider-Man?

programme.title: Galactus Goes Green - S01E15
programme.desc:
Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk thinks Galactus is coming to Earth to consume it. But he's really in search of a new Herald and finds great potential in the under-appreciated She-Hulk!
Note: The episode was first released as a cross-promotional bonus feature in the "Avengers Assemble: Assembly Required" DVD (Oct. 8, 2013).

programme.title: The Trouble With Machines - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks have crashed their Jump Jet more times than they can count, and it's out for revenge now that the Leader has given it artificial intelligence.

programme.title: Abomination - S01E17
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Abomination, a villain from Red Hulk's past, plans to take out the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. one-by-one so he can exact the ultimate revenge and frame the team for destroying Vista Verde.

programme.title: Mission Impossible Man - S01E18
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks meet their biggest fan -- Impossible Man! But he also proves to be their biggest problem when he summons the giant dragon, Fing Fang Foom, to battle them.

programme.title: For Asgard - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Skaar accidentally triggers Ragnarok and incites the ire of Asgard. Detained by the all-seeing, all-knowing guardian of the Bifrost, Heimdall, the Hulks must save Skaar and battle Thor. Soon the heroes find they must put aside their differences to fight against Malekith and save the realm.

programme.title: Stranger in a Strange Land - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — To help the aspiring magician, A-Bomb get a lesson in hard work, Hulk puts him under the tutelage of the Sorcerer Supreme Dr. Strange -- but when the dreaded Dormammu abducts his teacher, A-Bomb has to use what he learned to save Earth!

programme.title: Deathlok - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the Hulks thwart a villain from attacking a girl in the mall, they unintentionally start an alien invasion Deathlok was sent to stop.

programme.title: Inhuman Nature - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — A-Bomb's crush on a mysterious girl leads the Hulks to the secret home of the Inhumans, an isolationist race that threatens to wipe out mankind.

programme.title: The Hunted - S01E23
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Annoyed with his fellow Hulks, Hulk takes off for some alone time and stumbles onto an island of monsters where he inherits a family that's far peskier than his own.

programme.title: Monsters No More - S01E24
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The world finally accepts the Hulks as heroes, but before they can enjoy their success, a surprise attack from The Leader and his agents of C.R.A.S.H. threaten to destroy Vista Verde and the Hulk's reputation with it! The Hulks must save the town from villains they cannot see and from a threat that lies within the Hulks themselves.

programme.title: Planet Leader - S01E25
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Following the incident caused by the Agents of C.R.A.S.H., the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. get transported to Skaar's home planet Sakaar where they must stop Leader from controlling the entire planet and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. themselves.

programme.title: Planet Hulk (1) - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — While looking for a way back to Earth, the Hulks discover the Leader stowed away on board the ship. Retribution must wait as the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. have to fight Ronan the Accuser and his Kree soldiers to save an old foe: Ego the Living Planet. But when Galactus comes to consume Ego the Living Planet, the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. must put themselves at risk to save the lives of their two enemies.

programme.title: Planet Hulk (2) - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. must work together with Ego the Living Planet to fight with Galactus and his latest herald Firelord.

programme.title: The Hulking Commandos - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — On Halloween, the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. have to work with Nick Fury's Howling Commandos to prevent Dormammu from breaking into our dimension and turning all of humanity into Mindless Ones.

programme.title: Fear Itself - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks must face each of their greatest fears in order to stop the Null from crossing through a worm hole to reap ruin upon Earth.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. team up with their old friends the Guardians of the Galaxy to stop the Skrulls from using the Hulks' gamma powers to create super-powered Skrulks!

programme.title: Future Shock - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks finally return to Earth only to discover that they're centuries too late as the High Evolutionary devolved all humans into primitive beasts. He devolves the Hulks too, but Skaar is unaffected and steps up to save the team and all of mankind.

programme.title: A Druff is Enough - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When A-Bomb brings an alien aboard the ship, he puts the team at risk when it starts taking over, jeopardizing the team's only shot at getting back to Earth.

programme.title: Homecoming - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the team triumphantly returns to Earth, despite being accused of destroying Vista Verde, they find the town under rule of a new general: General Abomination.

programme.title: Spidey, I Blew up the Dinosaur - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the Leader blows Devil Dinosaur up into gigantic proportions and lets him loose on New York City, it's up to Spider-Man and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. to stop him.

programme.title: The Strongest One There Is - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the other Hulks try to leave A-Bomb out, he starts to doubt his strength as an agent of S.M.A.S.H., and realizes that he must use his other attributes to help the team when the Hulks are challenged by Xemnu the Titan, an intergalactic fighting champion. Find out if the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. can defeat Xemnu and prevent him from destroying the Earth.

programme.title: The Doppelsmashers - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the Hulks are framed by Abomination for attacking the S.H.I.E.L.D. Tri-Carrier, they must face evil gamma-powered doppelgangers of themselves in order to save Nick Fury.

programme.title: The Big Green Mile - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks are locked up by Abomination in the super villain prison where many of their enemies now reside.

programme.title: The Green Room - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. track the Leader to a deserted island but get stuck in a deadly maze, where they are forced to battle the Hulk's dark side -- in physical form.

programme.title: The Defiant Hulks - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk reluctantly fills in as Mayor of Vista Verde while Red and Skaar leave the team to start their own webcast as super villain bounty hunters - their first target: Abomination.

programme.title: Enter, the Maestro - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — While saving Earth from a potentially catastrophic meteorite, the Hulks come face to face with a future version of Hulk who might not be the hero they think he is.

programme.title: The Tale of Hercules - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks travel to ancient Greece and team up with Hercules to stop Pluto from turning everyone on Earth to stone.

programme.title: Banner Day - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk allows himself to be turned back into Bruce Banner but then struggles with the decision when Ronan launches an alien attack.

programme.title: Wheels of Fury - S02E18
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. attempt to help Iron Man subdue Mainframe in a gladiatorial roller derby game for the fate of the planet, but are faced with a challenge when they discover only She-Hulk knows how to skate.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (1): The Dino Era - S02E19
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk chases Leader back in time to the Jurassic era, but their actions result in present Earth being taken over by dinosaurs. Hulk battles Leader in the past to save all of time.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (2): Smashgard - S02E20
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk follows Leader back in time to the Viking Era and teams up with young Thor and Loki. The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. fight to stop "All Father" Leader from taking over the planet.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (3): Dracula - S02E21
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk follows Leader back in time to the Victorian era and unites the Howling Commandos against Dracula, who wants to shroud the Earth with Leader's gamma cloud, allowing vampires to prey night and day.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (4): The Hydra Years - S02E22
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Chasing Leader through time to WWII, Hulk teams up with Captain America to stop Red Skull. In the present, the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. fight to free the world from HYDRA.

programme.title: Days of Future Smash (5): The Tomorrow Smashers - S02E23
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Finally catching up to Leader in the present, Hulk reunites with the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. However, he's unexpectedly whisked into the future by teenage Smashers who battle the Leader's threats.

programme.title: Spirit of Vengeance - S02E24
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — While escorting Abomination to stand trial for his crimes, the Hulks run into Ghost Rider, who has come to make both Abomination and Red atone for the wrongful deeds of their past.

programme.title: Planet Monster (1) - S02E25
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk is torn between his two teams -- the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and the Avengers -- as both team up to save Earth from a Kree armada led by the Supreme Intelligence.

programme.title: Doorway to Destruction (1) - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk's best pal Rick Jones begins making a web-series to show the world Hulk is a hero and Big Green gets his first chance to prove it when Annihilus invades Earth!

programme.title: Doorway to Destruction (2) - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The newly formed Agents of S.M.A.S.H. -- including a Hulked-out Rick Jones aka A-Bomb -- invade the Negative Zone to stop Annihilus once and for all.

programme.title: Hulk Busted - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — When the Leader hijacks Iron Man's Hulkbuster suits to destroy the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., the team and Iron Man must learn to trust each other and work together to defeat the Leader.

programme.title: The Collector - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Perceived by the public as "menaces," Hulk and Spider-Man are the only ones left to save the planet from destruction when The Collector captures every last hero on earth.

programme.title: All About the Ego - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks face their biggest foe yet when they travel into space to battle Ego the Living Planet, who threatens to tear Earth apart! To survive, they have to tackle the second biggest ego in the galaxy -- Red Hulk's.

programme.title: Savage Land - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — A-Bomb is eager to prove himself to an over-protective Hulk and finds an unlikely mentor in Red, but when Sauron and his army of dinosaurs begin to flood Earth with lava, A-Bomb finds himself facing a true trial by fire.

programme.title: Incredible Shrinking Hulks - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — The Hulks are miniaturized to one-inch heroes who must stop the towering Leader from shrinking every city on Earth.

programme.title: Hulks on Ice - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2013 · TV-Y7 — Hulk and Red-Hulk must stop fighting each other long enough to team up with Thor and prevent Laufey and the Frost Giants from taking over the nine realms.

programme.title: Werewolves of Dunneglen - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max, Virgil, and Norman travel to Scotland, where there are reported sightings of werewolves. While there, Norman and Virgil are imprisoned and Max meets a man and discovers that he is a werewolf. They do some investigating and learns that a scientist is stealing the blood of natural werewolves to perfect the means of turning herself into an ultimate powerful werewolf. Max outsmarts and defeats her. The man and his pact of werewolves head off into the forest to live in peace.

programme.title: Out in the Cold - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Space aliens take over a science station in the arctic and assume the identities of the researchers in order to carry out their devious plan. The aliens can only survive in freezing cold temperatures and they want to make the earth their new home by altering the entire planet's climate by creating another ice age. It is up to Max, Norman, and Virgil to stop them.

programme.title: The Maxnificent Seven - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Virgil, Norman, and Max travel across the world to recruit the help of different heroes to join them in their crusade to destroy the crystal of souls. During this journey, Max starts to become uncertain about his destiny and wonders if he should be the one to lead this group.

programme.title: Pandora's Box (1) - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Lava Lord escapes from his prison after the destruction of the crystal of souls and is out to seek his vengeance on the one who imprisoned him, Skull Master. An all out war breaks out in the center of the earth between the armies of Skull Master and Lava Lord. Virgil tells Max that now is the time to strike in order to fullfill his destiny of destroying Skull Master. With Norman, they travel to Skull Mountain where things start to go wrong. They are separated from each other and Virgil is captured by Skull Master. Norman and Max regroup and attempt to find Virgil. When the two find him, they are horrified to discover that Virgil has turned to evil by joining the side of Skull Master. TO BE CONTINUED

programme.title: A Bellwether in One's Cap - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — 11-year-old Max receives a baseball cap that turns out to be the key to a series of teleport ""portals"" left by the ancient Lemurians, which as the foretold ""Mighty One"" he must use to defeat the evil Skull Master.

programme.title: The Brain-Suckers Cometh! - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max, Virgil, and Norman must prevent the earth from being invaded by brain sucking space aliens. The only way to do this is for Max to make amends with Ernie, his nerdy loudmouth lab partner from school. Ernie is the only one that can crack the computer codes on the aliens' disks

programme.title: Snakes & Laddies - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — When Max brings an ancient necklace back from Egypt and gives it to a girl named Jiffie, it turns out to have a curse that causes her to be kidnapped for sacrifice to a snake god.

programme.title: Day of the Cyclops - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — While vacationing with his mom in Turkey, Max is accused of stealing a baseball cap and gets the cosmic cap taken away from him and is imprisoned. Norman attempts to free Max from the prison, but they encounter and must do battle against a giant Cyclops. Meanwhile, Virgil and Max's mom search desperately for the missing cap.

programme.title: Let Sleeping Dragons Lie! - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Skull Master tricks a sorcerer by the name of Ravendark who is cursed within a cave to reawaken and release an evil dormant dragon from the earth saying that this will finally give him freedom. What Ravendark doesn't know is that he is not freeing himself by releasing the dragon that will tear the earth apart, but he is freeing Skull Master. Max, Virgil, and Norman fail in preventing the dragon from waking up. Now they must convince Ravendark to put it back to sleep.

programme.title: Rumble in the Jungle - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — While on an expedition in the Congo, Max's mom uncovers and is captured by a lost civilization of talking gorillas who enslave human beings. Max with the help of Virgil and Norman set out to rescue his mom and the enslaved humans.

programme.title: The Mother of All Adventures - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max's mom brings a figurine back from Haiti that turns out to be filled with zombie parasites.

programme.title: Norman's Conquest - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Norman struggles with his fear of facing Spike an old adversary of his family who murdered his father when he was a boy escaping from an ice prison. Spike vowed a thousand years to finish off Norman as well, and he intends to keep that promise.

programme.title: Less Than 20,000 Squid Heads Under the Sea - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max, Virgil, Norman, and a rich Texan go traveling underwater in submarine to battle a a giant octopus that is capturing and destroying ships. While underwater, the group encounters a squid civilization.

programme.title: Bring Me the Head of Mighty Max - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Skull Master uses the crystal of souls to awaken the former soulless undead inhabitants of the Lost City of Atlantis to retrieve the cosmic cap from Max along with his head. When the underwater zombies arrive on the scene, Norman and Max decide to stand their ground to combat them. Virgil tells them that this is totally pointless and dangerous because the zombies cannot be killed, as they are soulless and already dead. His warnings are ignored, so Virgil decides to take the cap away from Max to save the lives of both the Mighty One and Norman. He travels through the portals to find a place where he could destroy the cap. Max and Norman remember that the cap is indestructible and Virgil already knows that. That Virgil is going to find any futile means to destroy the cap even if it means sacrificing himself in the process. Can Max and Norman get there in time to save their fowl feathered friend?

programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max, Virgil, and Norman travel to Scotland, where there are reported sightings of werewolves. While there, Norman and Virgil are imprisoned and Max meets a man and discovers that he is a werewolf. They do some investigating and learns that a scientist is stealing the blood of natural werewolves to perfect the means of turning herself into an ultimate powerful werewolf. Max outsmarts and defeats her. The man and his pact of werewolves head off into the forest to live in peace.

programme.title: Out in the Cold - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Space aliens take over a science station in the arctic and assume the identities of the researchers in order to carry out their devious plan. The aliens can only survive in freezing cold temperatures and they want to make the earth their new home by altering the entire planet's climate by creating another ice age. It is up to Max, Norman, and Virgil to stop them.

programme.title: The Maxnificent Seven - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Virgil, Norman, and Max travel across the world to recruit the help of different heroes to join them in their crusade to destroy the crystal of souls. During this journey, Max starts to become uncertain about his destiny and wonders if he should be the one to lead this group.

programme.title: Pandora's Box (1) - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Lava Lord escapes from his prison after the destruction of the crystal of souls and is out to seek his vengeance on the one who imprisoned him, Skull Master. An all out war breaks out in the center of the earth between the armies of Skull Master and Lava Lord. Virgil tells Max that now is the time to strike in order to fullfill his destiny of destroying Skull Master. With Norman, they travel to Skull Mountain where things start to go wrong. They are separated from each other and Virgil is captured by Skull Master. Norman and Max regroup and attempt to find Virgil. When the two find him, they are horrified to discover that Virgil has turned to evil by joining the side of Skull Master. TO BE CONTINUED

programme.title: A Bellwether in One's Cap - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — 11-year-old Max receives a baseball cap that turns out to be the key to a series of teleport ""portals"" left by the ancient Lemurians, which as the foretold ""Mighty One"" he must use to defeat the evil Skull Master.

programme.title: The Brain-Suckers Cometh! - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max, Virgil, and Norman must prevent the earth from being invaded by brain sucking space aliens. The only way to do this is for Max to make amends with Ernie, his nerdy loudmouth lab partner from school. Ernie is the only one that can crack the computer codes on the aliens' disks

programme.title: Snakes & Laddies - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — When Max brings an ancient necklace back from Egypt and gives it to a girl named Jiffie, it turns out to have a curse that causes her to be kidnapped for sacrifice to a snake god.

programme.title: Day of the Cyclops - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — While vacationing with his mom in Turkey, Max is accused of stealing a baseball cap and gets the cosmic cap taken away from him and is imprisoned. Norman attempts to free Max from the prison, but they encounter and must do battle against a giant Cyclops. Meanwhile, Virgil and Max's mom search desperately for the missing cap.

programme.title: Let Sleeping Dragons Lie! - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Skull Master tricks a sorcerer by the name of Ravendark who is cursed within a cave to reawaken and release an evil dormant dragon from the earth saying that this will finally give him freedom. What Ravendark doesn't know is that he is not freeing himself by releasing the dragon that will tear the earth apart, but he is freeing Skull Master. Max, Virgil, and Norman fail in preventing the dragon from waking up. Now they must convince Ravendark to put it back to sleep.

programme.title: Rumble in the Jungle - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — While on an expedition in the Congo, Max's mom uncovers and is captured by a lost civilization of talking gorillas who enslave human beings. Max with the help of Virgil and Norman set out to rescue his mom and the enslaved humans.

programme.title: The Mother of All Adventures - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max's mom brings a figurine back from Haiti that turns out to be filled with zombie parasites.

programme.title: Norman's Conquest - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Norman struggles with his fear of facing Spike an old adversary of his family who murdered his father when he was a boy escaping from an ice prison. Spike vowed a thousand years to finish off Norman as well, and he intends to keep that promise.

programme.title: Less Than 20,000 Squid Heads Under the Sea - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Max, Virgil, Norman, and a rich Texan go traveling underwater in submarine to battle a a giant octopus that is capturing and destroying ships. While underwater, the group encounters a squid civilization.

programme.title: Bring Me the Head of Mighty Max - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 1993 · TV-Y7 — Skull Master uses the crystal of souls to awaken the former soulless undead inhabitants of the Lost City of Atlantis to retrieve the cosmic cap from Max along with his head. When the underwater zombies arrive on the scene, Norman and Max decide to stand their ground to combat them. Virgil tells them that this is totally pointless and dangerous because the zombies cannot be killed, as they are soulless and already dead. His warnings are ignored, so Virgil decides to take the cap away from Max to save the lives of both the Mighty One and Norman. He travels through the portals to find a place where he could destroy the cap. Max and Norman remember that the cap is indestructible and Virgil already knows that. That Virgil is going to find any futile means to destroy the cap even if it means sacrificing himself in the process. Can Max and Norman get there in time to save their fowl feathered friend?

programme.title: The Williamsburg Mystery - S03E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The team are in Colonial Williamsburg, Virginia to help restoring an old house. Spike ignoring his reading problem lands him in a mess of trouble when two crooks posing as Colonial soldiers raids a Colonial home for directions to a secret cave where a valuable diary is buried. Luckily, Spike makes it out OK, but he has to put his pride in check, while Mr. T and the team get to the bottom of this colossal Colonial caper. Mr. T's Moral Lesson: Not being afraid to ask for help if you have a problem.

programme.title: Mission of Mercy - S03E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — After a successful charity meet, Mr. T takes the team to the city of Samana to receive a cargo ship full of food, water and surplus aid to the village. Unfortunately, a crooked businessman named Saber hires mercenaries to hijack the ship and plan on selling the goods on the black market. Mr. T must now lead his team to find Saber and put him and his gang behind bars, and at the same time to teach the team about how situations in other countries are much different then where they live and rely on surviving in the desert. Mr. T's Moral Lesson: Being grateful for the food you have.

programme.title: Mystery of the Open Crates - S03E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Heading back to Chicago, Mr. T visits an old friend named Jimmy Stone, the owner of a youth center. At the same time, Courtney visits the gym to hopefully train with gold medalist Sally Owen, which Courtney finds out is more interested in herself than others. Sally's actions would later get her barred for life, but the real big issue is a shady drug dealer named Speedy and his henchmen who plan on framing Jimmy in which to use the youth center for his drug operations. Jimmy helped T get out of a gang during his youth and it's up to T to help him stop Speedy before everything comes tumbling down. Mr. T's Moral Lesson: Picking the people you admire more carefully.

programme.title: The Playtown Mystery - S03E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Just because someone's young, it doesn't make them worthless nor unbelievable. Jeff and Woody know that for a fact now. Back then, while the team was having a free tour of the Play Town amusement park, Spike saw two of its mascots, Marvin Mouse and Dingy Dog, acting suspicious and no one wanted to believe him. In truth, they were career criminals dressed as mascots in order to retrieve gold bars from an active gold refinery in Play Town's Frontier Town section. Mr. T's Moral Lesson: Never underestimating someone because of their age.

programme.title: The Comeback Mystery - S03E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Heading back to New York City, the team does charity work and a new member of the team named Grant Kline has just signed up. Grant done athletic programs at the same high school as Jeff, but he has a falling out with his old friends, a group of bullies called the Chain Gang and their leader, Blade. They had Grant keep quiet about their activities or they will tell the police about his previous mistake of helping the Chain Gang steal a car, putting him in a precarious position. Mr. T hopes to help Grant erase his past and correct his mistakes in order to break the links to the Chain Gang. Mr. T's Moral Lesson: Making the right kind of friends.

programme.title: The Cape Kennedy Caper - S03E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — An out-of-this-world caper occurs at Kennedy Space Center in Florida's Cape Canaveral. Robin brought her camera to take pictures for her school which Woody tries to take without permission. Suddenly, Robin sees two spies trying to take a photo from inside the shuttle. The spies have been hired by terrorists to blow up the shuttle as soon as it reaches orbit. Unfortunately for Robin, she got captured and it's up to Mr. T and the team to stop the launch, save Robin, and bring the spies to justice in this mystery of a final frontier. Mr. T's Moral Lesson: Respect for other people's property.

programme.title: Mystery of the Golden Medallion - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — A new member of the gymnastics team tries to fit in. Elsewhere, men in black suits smash gold medals apart as if looking for something valuable inside them. This takes the team searching around San Francisco for answers to their first mystery.

programme.title: Mystery of the Forbidden Monastery - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — When Sky Red Fern sends the team a phony invitation to a meet, she puts herself and her teammates in danger.

programme.title: Mystery of the Mind-Thieves - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — As the team visits Seattle, Kim's father, Mr. Nakamura, a software designer, is on urgent business with other scientists. However, a mysterious person using a mind-controlling device steals the minds of the scientists including Mr. Nakamura to obtain certain knowledge. The team plans to find out the mystery and save the scientists and their minds from this evil foe.

programme.title: Mystery on the Rocky Mountain Express - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — A very mysterious and very deadly virus has been stolen from the Salt Lake City Institute. It's up to Mr. T and his gymnastics team to locate the virus and to catch the crooks that stole it!

programme.title: The Hundred-Year-Old Mystery - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Mr. T and the team are in Mississippi planning to turn a rundown plantation called "Magnolia House" into a gymnastics camp, but a gang of street car thugs called the Ghost Riders threatened to eliminate the team. Jeff's bragging to a pretty girl gets overheard by the Ghost Riders, who use that information which puts the team in danger. Rumor has it that the original owner of Magnolia House left something behind, and the team has to figure out what it is.

programme.title: The Crossword Mystery - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — While in Washington, D.C., Ms. Bisby does a crossword puzzle finding a clue to the puzzle. However, once the word was said, Ms. Bisby falls into a hypnotic state. And she's not the only one. Two college professors are also hypnotized.

programme.title: The Ninja Mystery - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The team has a meet in New York City not too far from a movie location. At the same time, a mysterious ninja is robbing stores nearby and is looking for something in particular. The team has to unravel the mystery before the ninja makes a clean getaway.

programme.title: Dilemma of the Double-Edged Dagger - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Mr. T was placed under arrest while the team was in Mexico City where strange thefts from a museum happened. With Mr. T in jail, the team try to help by finding the real criminals and uncover an ancient pyramid. Once inside, the team discovers 4 Aztec warriors standing in their way.

programme.title: Secret of the Spectral Sister - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Mr. T and his team uncover a pair of stock swindlers who have master-minded a plan to steal evidence from the O'Neill family that can potentially be used against them.

programme.title: Mystery of the Silver Swan - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Bisby's late-night run-in with a classic car called the "Silver Swan" prompts the team staying at Lake Tahoe to investigate. Unknowingly, a local car dealer, museum staff and the car maker's original owner are part of an illegal automobile ring planning to sell duplicate copies of the Silver Swan and other vehicles. Robin tries to do everything for the team so she can get credit for this caper as well as the upcoming meet.

programme.title: Case of the Casino Caper - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — While en route to Las Vegas, the team discovers an illegal military operation. Meanwhile, Courtney is torn between leaving the team and going to military school.

programme.title: Fade Out at 50,000 Feet - S01E12
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The team takes a rest in Miami and sees an air show starring Jeff's cousin "The Great Marco". During his air show stunt, which involves dropping a sports car by parachute, he turns up missing causing Jeff to worry. Meanwhile, Woody has fallen for a woman named Vanetta Price whose involved in something Woody doesn't want to know. His jealousy almost got him and the team in hot water as they make their way into the Everglades to try and solve this swamp of a mystery.

programme.title: Riddle of the Runaway Wheels - S01E13
programme.desc: Animation · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The team heads into Monterey Bay to see an auto stunt show done by the Turbo Team in order to impress a Hollywood director to use their cars for his movie. At the same time, Robin develops a crush on the team's leader. However, a woman and two men are after something and plan on using the Turbo Team's prize automobile, the UltraCar to take it. Mr. T's wheels are spinning to solve this mystery before this caper speeds out of control.

programme.title: Buck Hill Inn - S01E06
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — The teams visit the Buck Hill Inn, a place possessed by evil with a long history of violence, murders, suicides and multiple reports of ghost sightings and strange noises. The teams compete in dares at the East Room/The Lamp Room, Main Lobby/Corridor Of Arches, Kitchen, Room 354, Basement Men's Washroom, Washroom Junction, Staff Quarters 3rd Floor, and the Basement Office.

programme.title: Eastern State Penitentiary - S01E07
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — A new batch of contestants face their worst fears in the abandoned Eastern State Penitentiary, one of the most haunted places in the US. How many of them will make it through the dares and collect their prize money, and how many will run from the prison in terror?

programme.title: USS Hornet - S01E08
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — The teams visit the USS Hornet, a 41,000-ton aircraft carrier and compete in dares in the Officer's Berth, Catapult Room, The Brig, Central Intelligence Center Deck, and the Engine Room.

programme.title: Fort Gaines - S01E09
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — Welcome to Fort Gaines on Massacre Island. This weeks dares take place in the West Bastion Cistern, Quarter Master's Room, Ammunition Room, Infirmary, The Collapsed Bastian Tunnel, and the POW Cell.

programme.title: La Guerre Plantation - S01E10
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — Welcome to Fort Gaines on Massacre Island. This weeks dares take place in the West Bastion Cistern, Quarter Master's Room, Ammunition Room, Infirmary, The Collapsed Bastian Tunnel, and the POW Cell.

programme.title: Mina Dos Estrellas Part One - S02E01
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — Welcome to the Mina Dos Estrellas Mine, built in 1903 by European gold diggers. This mine soon fell pray to the wrath of the legendary creature called Nahual.

programme.title: Mina Dos Estrellas Part Two - S02E02
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — A new group of contestants return to the Mina Dos Estrellas Mine, built in 1903 by European gold diggers, and said to have fallen prey to the wrath of the Nahual. The Nahual are creatures from Mesomerican legend, either witches or spirits that can change shape, taking on the forms of animals. Will any of the contestants make it through to the end, or will they all be driven away by their fears, as were the last group who attempted to stay there?

programme.title: Hacienda Tabi - S02E03
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — A new group of people take the challenge to face their worst fears. Their location is the Haceinda Tabi, a former colonial outpost in the Yucatan. Clashes between the Spanish conquistadors and the Mayan people often ended in blood, and in time the once vibrant Mayan culture was lost, its people little better than slaves to their Christian overlords. But perhaps their spirits live on within these crumbling walls. And by the end of the night, each of the people visitng the location will know their answer to this question, "Is the Hacienda Tabi haunted?"

programme.title: Ki Sugar Mill - S02E04
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — Seven people will face their greatest fears at the haunted Ki Sugar Mill. First built in 1876, this South Pacific sugar mill was plagued by strange deaths and terrible accidents, making it one of the most paranormally active sites in the world. Will the seven contestants make it to the end, or will some fall out, their fear greater than their will to see it through?

programme.title: Serenity Lake Sanatorium - S02E05
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — Six people agree to confront their worst nightmares and spend the night in a haunted hospital. They're sent to Canada's Serenity Lake Sanatorium, a former TB clinic, where thousands of patients, and even staff members lost their lives to the disease.

programme.title: Boettger Brewery - S02E06
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — Four complete strangers investigate the haunted former Boettger Brewery and the owner's mansion which is connected to it. Those who complete their dares and remain in the location until released will win a cash prize, while those who succumb to terror leave with nothing except a better understanding of where their breaking point is.

programme.title: West Virginia State Penitentiary - S01E01
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — a small number of young adults spending the night in the penitentiary, attempting to document any paranormal activities. The West Virginia State Penitentiary's design is similar to the facility at Joliet with its castellated Gothic, stone structure, complete with turrets and battlements, except only half the size.[1][2] Unfortunately, the original architectural designs have been lost.

programme.title: St. Agnes Hospital - S01E02
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — The location and real name of St. Agnes Hospital were closely guarded secrets to keep away curiosity seekers. Once the show aired though, word quickly got out. The fate of the real "St. Agnes" is being decided. Will it be a golf course? An amusement park? An office complex? Time will tell.The Real Location was released after season 1 came out it is Fairfield State Hospital, CT

programme.title: Duggan Brothers Cement Factory - S01E03
programme.desc: Game Show · 2000 · TV-14 — The members have to visit and hear about the Curse of the Concrete Company and the Blood Moon, while participating in dares such inthe Boiler Room, Basement, Storage Room, Sunken Crusher/Rat Tunnel, Cricket/Elevator Room, the Scrubber, the Cement Catwalk, the Furnace/Kiln Tunnel, and the Suicide Ramp.
